source_en:
Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Generosity endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his valiant struggle to protect the land from TDs, emptied his own coffers and called upon the people to donate. The gathered wealth was displayed in the <color=Highlight>cottage by the windmill</color> and used to fortify defenses which, at only a modest cost, repelled the TD assault.
In giving, one finds reward.
new_translation_vi: Hãy để bệ đá này làm minh chứng!

source_en:
Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Wisdom endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon", in his time, devoted himself to the study of the knightly path in <color=Highlight>Silver Moon Grove</color>. Over the years, he wrote volumes on what he learned, so that future knights might follow his teachings.
To the wise, fate serves; to the foolish, fate rules.
new_translation_vi: Hãy để bệ đá này làm minh chứng!

source_en:
Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Courage endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his youth, singlehandedly fought a victorious battle against an entire pack of ferocious TDs near <color=Highlight>the great tree to the northwest of Egla Town</color>.
Courage is the knight's final weapon.
new_translation_vi: Hãy để bệ đá này làm minh chứng!

source_en:
Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Mercy endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once stood vigil to <color=Highlight>the west of Mistveil Bay</color>, guarding the merchants who passed through. There, he drove away the fierce TDs and vanquished the ruthless Alari family.
To show mercy to the innocent, one must be merciless to the wicked.
new_translation_vi: Hãy để bệ đá này làm minh chứng!

source_en:
Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Honor endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once dueled on <color=Highlight>the bridge leading to the Thorncrown Rises near Egla Town</color>, where he bested a hundred challengers.
Honor is a fine blade tempered in the fires of challenge.
new_translation_vi: Hãy để bệ đá này làm minh chứng!

Tempted by the offer, you sign the contract, only to find it's all a lie. No job, no money, nothing.
You recall the noble's mockery... In their eyes, you are but a circus clown.
new_translation_vi: Bị cám dỗ bởi lời đề nghị, bạn ký hợp đồng, chỉ để nhận ra đó hoàn toàn là một lời nói dối. Không việc làm, không tiền bạc, chẳng có gì cả.

It is this insurmountable challenge that stirs the thirst for victory in your blood.
You accept the third trial: to confront the guardian of Septimont, Arsinosa.

Exhaustion takes over. You have given everything, but still cannot defeat Arsinosa.
She doesn't spare you another look before turning away. You fall at the center of the arena alone.

Adorning yourself like this... Hah, you're just wearing a fake crown to cover your cowerdice.
What else wouldn't you abandon if you can toss away your home and your name!
Please, leave, now!

Your will crumbles. There you stand, gazing up at that towering peak men call "Strength," frozen at the hill's very foot.
Perhaps a simple life is your best choice.

source_en:
A strange book found floating in the Sea of Ghosts... maybe it's the key to a hidden bookcase door.
This book cannot be opened, its contents will not be revealed... Perhaps that's for the best.

source_en:
Two strange books found floating in the Sea of Ghosts.
One seems to record the past, its cover ravaged by seawater, and the waterlogged pages stick together, making it impossible to open. The past cannot be retraced, yet the abyss insists on drawing you back in time.
The other records the present as it happens, its cover formless, its pages sealed. There is no need to look further, for you are writing the "present."
Past and Present come together, leading to the Future.
new_translation_vi: Hai cuốn sách kỳ lạ được tìm thấy trôi nổi trong Sea of Ghosts.

source_en:

source_en: A heartwarming fairytale sketchbook, telling a story of princesses embarking on an adventure. Even though caged, the maidens' hearts were still brimmed with hopeful fantasies.
new_translation_vi: Một cuốn sổ phác thảo truyện cổ tích ấm áp, kể câu chuyện về những nàng công chúa bắt đầu cuộc phiêu lưu. Dù bị giam cầm, trái tim của những thiếu nữ vẫn tràn đầy những tưởng tượng đầy hy vọng.

source_en: An eerie sketchbook, its pages inscribled with a haunting song, scribbled in twisted handwriting. What once were vivid fantasies have now turned into silent tears, dripping across its surface and leaving behind blurry and heartbreaking stains.
new_translation_vi: Một cuốn sổ phác thảo kỳ lạ, các trang giấy được viết bằng một bài hát ám ảnh, nguệch ngoạc bằng nét chữ vặn vẹo. Những gì từng là tưởng tượng sống động giờ đã biến thành những giọt nước mắt thầm lặng, nhỏ xuống bề mặt của nó và để lại những vết ố mờ nhạt và đau lòng.

source_en:
Date: [--02]
The <ano=CSC>Court of Savantae</ano> Laboratory is an abandoned site in the Whining Aix's Mire. Due to the use of specialized materials developed by the CSC in the main structure, the building is well-preserved and undergoes minimal weathering and corrosion. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the lower levels of the site to create an artificial Tacet Field for experimental purposes.
There are a few abandoned devices left in the experimental area. Low-frequency lighting systems are positioned at specified distances and angles, ensuring consistent illumination in the experimental area.
At the center of the experimental area, multiple bundled cables secure a spherical metal device. These cables also transmit input and output data from the spherical metal device, and identical frequency detection devices are arranged around the spherical metal device. 

These devices are typically operated with dial plates. Clockwise rotation increases electric energy, causing a metal frame to rapidly rotate around the central device for frequency detection.

Date: [--16]
Assembling machinery in a modular way... this "Automata Mechanics" is quite something. Thanks to it, we easily built our new lab. Of course, we couldn't do it without the financial support of that Fractsidus Overseer. Annoying to have someone meddling in our research, given his generous contributions, it's all tolerable.
After all, no choice left. Got expelled from headquarters, so the only way was to move to the Whining Aix's Mire. Sure, the workload increased, but there's an advantage. No one's gonna bother coming to this remote place.
I still remember the moment Professor Heisen announced the trial's success at the meeting. He told us, "I'm getting old, but there's still plenty I can do. And you, you're still young with endless possibilities. I believe each one of you, genius or not, would rather leave your mark in history than end up living an uneventful life in a place like this."
If successful, our names could be immortalized with Professor Heisen's in history, known for generations to come even as ordinary people.
We were once prohibited from research due to the so-called "dangerous activities", expelled from headquarters. We were resentful and frustrated. But now, we've let go of those pointless emotions, focusing solely on paving the way to the future.
Setting aside personal stories, I think, it's more because we've all witnessed "miracles".

NO. SY-A038
Date: [---]

Subject A038 has been assigned to a 6m x 6m x 6m artificial controllable Tacet Field. Regular environmental checks must be conducted every 6 hours for the artificial Tacet Field.
Entry into the designated area is strictly limited to experiment personnel and any devices or tools that do not meet standard specifications are forbidden to prevent interference with the subject.

Preliminary observations indicate that Subject A038, who was born in the artificial Tacet Field, is able to survive stably.
However, it is worth noting that the subject has yet to exhibit any specific physical features or vocal behaviors. It appears to lack a physical form and can only be observed through specialized means.
At present, A038 shows no discernible behavioral objectives and remains mostly stationary with low levels of aggression and activity.
Due to significant deviations from our initial expectations, further research is required to gain a deeper understanding of the subject.
Note: High sensitivity to frequency has been observed. Strict control of standard frequency specifications within the experimental area is imperative.
Given the unique nature of A038, additional time is necessary to establish appropriate parameters and data language in order to gain valuable insights into its information. This process will require a considerable amount of time given our current technology and available data.

WARNING: Any leakage of experimental information through any means is strictly prohibited. Taking photos or recordings of the subject without express permission from Professor Heisen is strictly forbidden.
This concludes the initial observations recorded for Subject A038. To obtain more comprehensive information on the subject, future experiments and analyses are crucial.
new_translation_vi: SỐ. SY-A038

source_en:
Date: [--08]
We've reached the final stage of our research, but it seems we've slowed down our progress. Colleagues are leaving one after another. Even Professor Heisen said he's going back to be with his family... He did say that, right? 
Somehow, I'm not so sure about this. I just vaguely remember he mentioned something like this at some point, but did he actually tell us that? Or did he whisper it in my ears?

During long, boring nights like this one, this little thing is my only companion. It's hard to believe how much it has grown and changed. Metal parts now adorn its once simple form: steel plates, cogs, clocks, detection devices, blue liquids, white lab coats... and… Is that a diesel generator? Anyway, I can finally see it with my own eyes, without the aid of observation devices.

Hello? How are you feeling today? You seem surprisingly energetic. But it's no wonder, being trapped your entire life. Longing for freedom, I imagine. 
Our lab is rarely this quiet. I think no one would notice if I broke the rules a little bit. 
Ah... I see. So this is how your body feels to the touch. 
Is that how you laugh? This is the first time I've heard your voice... It sounds familiar, like my colleagues.
I can see it... It’s the Gate we've been searching for. 
Why am I feeling dizzy? My body, it’s so soft now… like water... not my own.
My consciousness, floating in the air...
Hello everyone… So you've all entered the Gate already…
"Don't cross over," you say… What do you mean?
No, something's not right... 
The Miracle we witnessed... This shouldn't be happening...

Today, Master Dollmaker told me stories about Mommy and Daddy again. He said they were brave Patrollers who were betrayed by some really bad people. 

Master Dollmaker only seems to get happy when he talks about this. He promised me that he'd bring them back to me, and when that happens, they'll get their revenge. 

I do miss Mommy and Daddy, but I don't remember much about them. Do they want to become puppets? And get revenge? I don’t know. But if they came back, we'd be happy every day. Right?
new_translation_vi: Hôm nay, Master Dollmaker lại kể cho tôi nghe những câu chuyện về Mẹ và Cha. Ông ấy nói họ là những Patroller dũng cảm đã bị một số kẻ thực sự xấu xa phản bội.

source_en:
Sparrow here. Day 14 of our undercover investigation. Canary and I managed to get hold of the date and location of the transaction, but we've yet to find any key evidence.
Based on various intel, we suspect that Cuckoo has already planted a mole inside the nest. Meaning our cover could be blown at any given time.
With our hatchling barely out of its shell, I had instructed Canary to abort the mission and return to the nest for the sake of safety, to which she refused... She suggests that nowhere is safe if the mole has already planted a target on our backs, rather our optimal plan of action is to stick together and seek out the evidence and the mole as quickly as possible.
We have already entrusted the hatchling to the care of a junior with whom we place our complete trust. We now have no worries. We can and must bring evil to justice.
new_translation_vi: Sparrow đây. Ngày thứ 14 trong cuộc điều tra bí mật của chúng tôi. Canary và tôi đã xoay sở để nắm được ngày và địa điểm giao dịch, nhưng chúng tôi vẫn chưa tìm thấy bất kỳ bằng chứng quan trọng nào.

source_en:
Close... So close... 
Almost there. Almost.
My own memories failed me, and Yinlin is no longer an option. 
I've spent over a decade on these two puppets. I live for finishing this project.
I'll do whatever it takes, even teaming up with those I once despised. 
Sacrifices will be made. I will see it through, no matter what.
new_translation_vi: Gần... Rất gần...

source_en:
Master Dollmaker,

Do you remember this notebook? You said it was a gift from my parents when you became a Patroller. It contained their wisdom and advice, and it was your most treasured possession. It was my greatest inspiration, too.

I've completed my training today. I am now a qualified Patroller. I've decided to become an undercover agent, following in my parents' footsteps. While this may deviate from your expectations of me advancing in the Public Security Bureau, I feel drawn to this path. I may not come back here very often from now on. 

Lately, I've been hearing worrying rumors from the Séance Society. I understand you're facing challenges in your research, but if you've resorted to working with criminals, then you'll be no better than them.

If you stumble upon this message in our camp, please destroy it after reading. I don't know if you'll ever find it, but I hope you do.

I miss our talks, Master Dollmaker. I've been thinking about my parents, and there is something I have to tell you. Please, let's talk again.
new_translation_vi: Master Dollmaker,

source_en:
Landmark Building Faces Environmental Concerns? Expert Assures Central Spire is Safe

With the completion of the Central Tower, many worry that this over one-thousand-meter skyscraper might harm the environment or cause structural issues. Professor Anderson, an expert from the Architecture Institute, provides some clarity.

“We conducted a ten-year study on the site's soil and groundwater,” says Anderson. “For such a massive building, we had to ensure the site could support its weight long-term. Our research shows the geological conditions here can sustain the building for over a century, with minimal tilt and settlement.”

Anderson also mentions the use of new materials, allowing the foundation to support a building up to two thousand meters. “However, the current height meets all needs.”
Regarding concerns about shading, Anderson adds, “We ensured a fifty-meter distance between the tower and nearby buildings. The upper levels are designed in a spiral to maximize natural light.”

...Mom! This building is so tall!
Today, our school took us on a tour. The guide told us that this is the tallest building in the world!
Tonight, the view from the top will be even better! But our class won't get to visit the rooftop until tomorrow night, so we have to wait another day.
Mom, do you think that when I stand on the rooftop, I'll be closer to Dad?
Will he be able to see me from up there as a star?
I asked the guide about it today, but she didn't answer.
The food tonight is delicious. It's my first time eating in a restaurant this high up! The utensils here are different from the ones we use at home...

Robotic Voice: Systems Activating... Performing Onboard Analysis... Alert: Leg Components, Not Found. Main Motor Module, Malfunctioning... Requesting Shutdown...

Exhausted Voice: Home... It's been a while since I last went home. I hope my family's still doing okay... It's raining, and the rain won't even give me an answer.

—

source_en:
We went beneath the banyan tree, where darkness shrouded Grandma and me.
Grandma led me with knowing grace, to hang the moons in their rightful place.
A glowing orb above the leaves, banishing shadows, making forest so bright.
Moon O moon, where do you hide? <color=yellow>Behind a waterfall's cascading slide?</color>
With gentle hands she'd guide my head, as we gathered moons before bed.
Moon O moon, where do you roam? <color=yellow>At the moon pool's alluring home?</color>
Moon in hand I came back and read, by her side she taught me to heed.
Moon O moon, where do you rest? <color=yellow>Perched upon a tree stump's crest?</color>
Naughty Hoochiefs watched in glee, trying to catch the moons so free.
Moon O moon, where do you play? <color=yellow>In a cave where dry branches sway?</color>
All moons gathered but she was gone, leaving me an everlasting dawn.
I gazed at golden moons so bright, and left for the city that very night.

Precautions for Induction Energy Storage Module
    1. Operators should pay attention to the fact that the different colors of the Induction Cell correspond to different voltages and must be matched with the corresponding energy storage slots.
    2. The voltage of the Induction Cell can be changed through the variable sensing device to meet the demand.
    3. Due to lack of maintenance, there may be obstacles near the module, which should be cleared before use.
    Example:
    Ruins (can be cleared directly)
    Bush Trap (can be destroyed by bursting Tacetite)
    Tacetite (can be destroyed by activating Tacetite Lightning)

source_en:
After my mentor passed away, I have been practicing swordsmanship on this mountain for twenty years. Cold or hot, rain or shine, I have been wielding my blade, hoping to one day reach the ultimate state of swordsmanship. During this time, I have defeated countless enemies with this Sword, including martial artists who held contempt for me like I held to them, and terrifying TDs that arose from nowhere. Every day, I had to endure endless battles and hatred.
I am convinced that this Sword is sharp enough to defeat enemies, but not possible to resolve the confusion in my heart... It seems that I need a new weapon. As for this Sword, I will leave it to someone destined for it.

Twenty years have passed, and I believe I have gained a deeper understanding of swordsmanship. I have abandoned the light, sharp Sword, and opted instead for this heavy Broadblade. It lacks the intensity and agility of Sword and even appears somewhat clumsy. However, these are merely prejudices born from a lack of insights into blades. Actually, the mix of impetus and inertia of Broadblade is like a dance, always catching my foes off guard. The seemingly plain and unadorned moves are, in essence, a product of exquisite control of strength.
However, as I gaze upon the Broadblade in my hand, I am acutely aware that neither it nor I can ever truly reach the pinnacle of perfection, and that I must continue my search... This blade, I shall leave it to someone more suited. 

Over the hasty course of twenty years, I have gradually come to understand the essence of swordsmanship. It is not about being confined to the form of the weapon in my hand, nor about the countless techniques I have spent my life mastering.
As long as there is a blade in my mind, any kind of weapon and technique can achieve the purpose of defeating the enemy.
Take this "blade" as an example. No matter how far the enemies may be, they cannot escape from its sharp edge. Besides, it is swifter than any technique! It can be said to be the epitome of a blade. Unfortunately, I realized this far too late. My aging body can no longer control it for much longer. Thus, I have hidden it somewhere in the depths of Port Town of Guixu. I hope someone flexible enough may find it.
As for myself, perhaps in the final stages of my life, I will take on a student and impart to him my lifelong understanding of the art of swordplay.

To remember where I buried them, <color=Highlight>I took three photos from this hilltop</color> — if there is truly someone destined, then perhaps they can make use of these photos to find these three knives that recorded my life.

...Don't just focus on the superficial details; we must look beyond them to uncover the truth. This is what I've always been telling my students. However, I must admit, I too have been misled by the superficiality. For a long time, I've been attempting to improve the antibodies, hoping that they can aid us in exploring the Dim Forest more efficiently. I also aimed to use them to cure Hoohoo. Yet, my research has yielded no results so far. What should I do? It appears that Hoohoo's time is running short. It's more than a Tacet Discord but a true friend. The antibodies I make merely postpone its symptoms and fall short of a complete cure. Is this contamination irreversible? Can I find a way to neutralize it?
...Recently, I discovered that the purified spore cores we've extracted no longer contaminate their surroundings, so I tried to add them to the antibodies. Hoohoo showed no adverse reactions after taking them, and its health condition even improved. Perhaps this time, I've successfully made an effective antibody! However, there's been a surge in spores nearby lately. That's not a good sign...

source_en:
A small military transport aircraft crashed during a cruise towards ■■■. The cause of the crash was under investigation. At approximately 8,000 feet, the Flight made an initiation of a descent towards ■■■. The aircraft disintegrated as it crashed to the ground. All crew members were killed in the accident.
Shortly after the departure, the Flight reached 8,400 feet at 13:46. The craft issued a "Deviated from Course" alert at 14:40:25, after which it drove out of cruising altitude. The crew failed to respond to the alert.
Last recorded status: 
Standard pressure altitude: 4,234 meters; Course: 108 degrees. 
No recorded radar signal afterward.
The aircraft is entitled to a valid flight certificate with no necessity for large-scale repair during the last inspection. All crew members possess valid and legal licenses to operate the Flight. Normal safety inspection procedure conducted before boarding.
Along the cruise, all navigation and surveillance facilities functioned normally until 14:41:36 the flight plan was interrupted by temporary haywire indicators. Upon the investigation of the wreckage, the aircraft found no attack trace by EMP. Unable to identify the probable cause of the accident under the Waveworn Phenomenon, the Board demands an urgent change in approaches to investigate this case.
The follow-up investigation is ongoing.
...
30 days after the crash of ■■■ Transport Flight, the black box was retrieved for further investigation on the tapes and recording. It's acknowledged that the crew members had taken safety precautions to record all anomalies.
According to the black box, a glitch appeared on the monitor screen at ■■■. They encountered an upsidedown metropolis in mid-air, while dense fog prevented the aircraft from pressing on. This was reported as a typical phenomenon of the Etheric Sea. The crew made difficult adjustments, to no avail. Out of control, the captain was hit on the head compelled by the abnormal gravity. The co-pilot applied unsuccessful emergency breaks, after which the aircraft went straight to ■■■.
...
To conclude, it's accepted by all that the detrimental effects of the Lament are defying our technology, as no scientific grounds can be used to explain such accidents. In recent reports, the Etheric Sea is spreading with troubling Retroact Rain that affects residents. To survive these disasters, we need to take measures to unravel the underlying truth of our world.
new_translation_vi: Một máy bay vận tải quân sự cỡ nhỏ đã gặp nạn trong hành trình bay tới ■■■. Nguyên nhân vụ tai nạn đang được điều tra. Ở độ cao khoảng 8.000 feet, chuyến bay bắt đầu hạ độ cao về phía ■■■. Chiếc máy bay vỡ tan khi va chạm với mặt đất. Toàn bộ phi hành đoàn đều thiệt mạng trong vụ tai nạn này.

source_en:
As the Express through the Rain I
The door swings open with a creaking. I turn around, portraying the raindrops with my eyes. Shall they end up in the sea upon the skies? I don't know, nor the destination of this express. Now and then I remember the past, when you and me crouch in one silhouette on those rainy nights. Will we return, back to days of blooming petals and neon lights?

As the Express through the Rain II
I remember, I do. Wet neon, frantic traffic, they all dance like Tetras. We don't care about umbrellas. As we shuffle through shallow depressions on the ground, our swirling skirts willingly embrace the splash. We dance to the tune of rain, dreaming without concerning the days. I wish I could dance with you till we catch the sun; I wish the rain never ends; I wish we never part ways.
That's when we see the flashing light. Bathing in those glowing drops, we chuckle out in the pouring rain. As the car chimes hard, I hear your voice: Can we continue the dance, continue without a finale? I say yes, no finale. We'll stop for no one.
Unsullied by doubt, you nod. In your full skirt, the rain is returning to the skies.
The express, descending from the air, carries you away with strong whistles.
Then, silent neon lights are smashed to the ground and feed me the splashes.
Then, the rain is gently consumed by the flames.
Then, I get swallowed by that rainy night.

As the Express through the Rain III
All our dreams disappear in the heavy rain, as they evaporate in the aching land.
The spreading fire burns every vein and valve, so as the rain drops about to meet the ground.
I see crawling petals come out of the soil, tearing down the foundation with their bodies. I can only escape, stumbling through the night and howling rains as I cling to the past shadow of you.
The scorching land permits the failure of our dreams. I lose you.
But the rain revisits here, along with the same old train.
In playbacks I see the express, welcoming me with open doors. Everything is still the same.
So I take a step forward. The door closes with a simultaneous broadcast. Am I seeing phantoms, mimicry of dizzy passengers in every cabin?
But that doesn't matter. As I find you, I ask you for permission to sit by your side. Same as you inviting me over a never-ending dance.
The answer is yes. Nothing will stop the express, not the rain nor the broken rails, until it greets the next desperate passenger.
new_translation_vi: Như chuyến tàu tốc hành xuyên qua cơn mưa I

source_en:
Jinzhou Folklore Journal I
Jinzhou is the newest city of Huanglong. It rests on the frontier where perilous monsters lurk. Devoting all its strength, Jinzhou thrives against continuous threats and moves steadfastly on a buoyant path.
Adjacent to other cities, the Gorges of Spirits marks the throat and the inevitable gate on every route. Through Jinzhou, visitors can find their way to the entire Huanglong. Embracing such geographical pre-eminence, Jinzhou continues to enlighten poets and merchants, bringing forth inspiration and fortune.
The culture and spirit of Jinzhou all included in this book, begins with the battle in the Gorges of Spirits.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal II
In the distant past, Gorges of Spirits was known as the crawling nest of Tacet Discords. In dying will, soldiers of Huanglong safeguarded their homeland against the approaching storm of destruction. Shed blood converged into a solid dome that intercepted their enemies before they cast the final dice.
Suddenly, a long cry came from under the Gorges, shaking the ground with Loong's mighty existence. Cutting a chasm in the sky, this creature set the stage amidst an overwhelming light. As the bell clanged, a fighter with golden eyes descended, piercing a sharp blade through the Crownless. Like blares of horns support arrived from all sides, filling the battlefield with cheers and fighting wills.
After this battle, the Gorges of Spirits was appointed as the defending border, protecting Jinzhou and the people of Huanglong.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal III
The statue of Sentinel is located at the exit of the Gorges, a dominant figure and a permitted talisman standing between all chaos. The Sentinel of Jinzhou "Jué" represents one star of Qingloong, carrying a message to cleanse evil and bathe Jinzhou in its pure blessings.
Whenever a Magistrate is chosen, or every decision is about to be made, Jué will be present as a guiding hand.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal IV
The common rendezvous for the festivities of Jinzhou starts from Knell Square to the Statue of Sentinel. People pray for blessings in front of the silent statue, no matter if it's for yield or peace.
During the Spring Loong Festival, the streets of Jinzhou will be bustling with activity, filled with bouquets and drums of Liondance. Normally, people welcome it with cleaning while merchants release new products to celebrate the arrival of a brand new year.
The Midnight Rangers too follow these etiquettes. As they stand tirelessly to ward off Tacet Discords in those prevailing nights, citizens of Jinzhou could gather in joyous reunion.

source_en:
"Here comes a beast, akin to a lion. It exudes might and intellect, embraces a human's act..."
Long ago, a recluse beast "Suan'ni" inhabited the distant jungle of Huanglong.
Legend had it these great fighters abhorred evils as deadly foes, endowing humans with generous courage. Its figure frequently led the fight troops, overwhelming enemies with great strength. One against a hundred, it disrupted the offensive Tacet Discords, hence honored as an auspicious beast and a loyal friend by its human companions.
To commemorate such success and pass down its blessings, human created the Liondance that adopted their moves into dancing footwork. To this day, the Liondance still embraces many successors among Huanglong.
This precious friendship lasted for hundreds of years hereafter.
Unfortunately, the Waveworn Phenomenon began to flourish, devouring living beings and the vibrant jungles where the connection between humans and Suan'ni moored.
Later on, rumors ruled upon the civil tongues that Suan'ni had adopted a vicious nature.
It was said that they encroached upon human territories and repelled all living creatures within their reach... And they were the harbinger of Tacet Field.
Some objected, saying Suan'ni was an early warning that protected humans from the approaching Tacet Field danger.
Difficult to tell their nature, people raised a big question mark on the existence of Suan'ni... In mere speculations, I tend to mark those evil ones as a narrow slice of Suan'ni.
As for the reason... perhaps it has possible connections to the loss of territories, struggles of power induced by depleted resources... Or the Waveworn Phenomenon should have contributed largely to their raging mutation.
As researchers achieved further discovery, it's acknowledged by most that Resonance Ability can be an acquired strength that stems exactly from one's heart. Without proper treatment, it begets destruction. In later research, it was confirmed that Suan'ni possesses a special power similar to the Resonance Ability. Even a powerful Suan'ni can "Overclock" like Resonators.
Many scientists believe Suan'ni accepted eventual extinction as they failed in the war against inner brutality.
However, I believe the survivors of Suan'ni will recall the past friendship with the human race.
Out of a natural curiosity toward legends of beasts, I decided to venture into the realm once Suan'ni resided. If anyone finds this interesting through my article, my efforts will not yield fruitless.
Next stop, the Violet Banyan.

source_en:
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part One
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Being a courier, the most comforting sound is the early whistle of vessels arriving at the port. Every day, Port Gunchao witnesses the busiest waterways in Huanglong, transporting both cargo and stories from afar—I know all of these from Miss Lumi!
According to Miss Lumi, Port Gunchao constitutes the largest freight transportation port in Huanglong! Every cargo to Jinzhou must travel through this port! As ships rest upon the morning bank, a long whistle utters in the air, announcing the arrival of new freight and the start of a busy day.
Couriers like me must fulfill every order without mistakes as they bear anticipation from every inch of SOL3 through mountains and seas. Recently, frequent delivery requests from Tiger's Maw Mine appeared on my list. The thought excites me that I could help to convey these precious vehicles of love and voice to Shuzhou, Shaozhou, and places on the distant corners of Huanglong. 
And senior couriers in my branch told me about a fabled island located in the most faraway place on the planet. Only the brightest ones could access the mystic portal to it! If my mail could finally reach its shores, perhaps I'd earn myself the title of a valuable courier! I'm sure that I'll find the chance! Hehe!
Because our topic here is: Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today! Hmm, I nearly forgot... Address... What's the address for our next order...

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Two
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Now that I've mentioned sounds, maybe the friction when the breeze gently laps on our uniform deserves to be on the list! I could hear the roaring gales as I ride the express car to deliver my orders. It serves as a reminder during my journey, urging me to hurry my pace with louder chants.
But please note that safety is the first on the road! Because you may bump into dangerous Tacet Discords that look pretty alike to traffic lights. Just follow the rules: red for stop and green for go, keep this in mind every time! Or you'll catch the attention of vicious monsters! No one can predict the situation around the port, since Tacet Discords are haunting us with their looming existence... It even gets worse when we have to commute between here and the obsolete port... 
Oh, that used to be a place of glamour like Port Gunchao, according to Miss Lumi. But the transportation was ruined by the sudden appearance of the fault zone. To make things worse, Tacet Discords started to pop up from nowhere... Later, the port could only bid farewell to its busy days and sink into dust. Such a waste. I think many packages are held up in the port to this day... Well, that's not what you expect of an express. I wonder if these packages could finally meet the right ends...
Maybe our new supply station will do the trick? Okay, my next workplace is settled then! Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Three
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Continuing our topic on the sound... I don't think I can skip the strange murmurs from Whining Aix's Mire. No, those are totally INSANE!
Let me explain in detail: I've made a transfer request to the new supply station. But some Exiles lurking in the neighbors just raided our camp and robbed us blind. I can't believe this... I know these aren't just common packages, they're potent representations of feelings. Miss Lumi agrees with me. On our first encounter, I already knew her as an impressive navigator. Though young, she deals with every order with delicacy, and that allows her to locate the fastest route despite all the obstacles and rubble along the way. When she delivers a package, intact as it is, to her customers, she ends her service with a radiant smile. How sweet...
By the way, Exiles are just one subtle part of our difficulties. Take the dense fog in Whining Aix's Mire for example. It usually signifies an accompanying thunderstorm and shrill screams that bring up a ripple of sadness and... a sense of longing. That's where the navigation tends to fail as the fog gradually consumes you.
Devastating events. I can't quite picture myself overwhelmed by such dense fog and Siren sounds... Eek! I can't dwell on this. Time to get back to work and be a proud courier today!
new_translation_vi: Lo, Lo, Hậu cần Lollo! Phần một

source_en:
Untitled Family Letters I
Dear Daddy, Mommy asked me to write a letter to you, but I don't know what to write because you aren't going home for a long, long time! A few days ago, Ms. Yuyi asked us to write about our own dads, but I can't pick a topic. Normal dads would take their kids out to play, treat them to lots of snacks, and tell them lots of stories, while I can't write anything because I'm forgetting your face... I can only write in my essay that my dad follows General Jiyan to fight monsters in Desorock Highland! Those monsters must be taller than the Balloon Monsters in Fiamma! But my dad can knock them out in just one blow because he is a big hero! But my classmates said I was bragging because the Balloon Monsters in Fiamma are so powerful that even Fiamma could have a hard time! But I don't know, I've never seen it... When are you coming back, Daddy? Can you take me to see the Hero Play when you're back? Just let me tag along! Mommy says I am a great helper now! I made scrambled egg rice the other day, and Mommy said she loved the taste! Come back and you can try it out! Oh and Verina gave a flower to me. She said it would last a long time. I attached it to this letter so you can see! Mommy said it's very pretty and you should take a look!

Untitled Family Letters II
I found this letter after Xiaobao went to bed.
Don't worry... Everything is fine now. Xiaobao helped me a lot. Though strange things happened under the mine, that's no sweat at all to my job. We take care of ourselves, and you should too.
You reminded me of my father, a soldier who seldom came home. I missed him so much and kept asking my mother the same question: When would he come back? But the war was escalating and those Tacet Discords were approaching our doorsteps. I remember a courier delivered a mail on a rainy day. I could tell right away that it was from my father. I came out of my room with a happy smile, when the courier paused for a conversation with my mother. Turning around, she cried over my shoulder, shedding tears upon that letter I dared not to read it myself.
I know they sacrifice a lot to drive those Tacet Discords out of Desorock Highland... and you're now suffering in bitterness at the front line. That gentle knock on the gate still chants a scary echo for me to linger upon the slightest thought that you would die like my father. So I told the couriers to leave those letters on my doorstep.
Enough of the past. Are you doing fine on the front line? Don't worry about us, you just need to do your job. We love you, as always.

Untitled Family Letters III
Worry not, dear. I'm doing fine these days. We managed to defeat a small group of Tacet Discords, while the Ministry of Development is working on some large-scale defense projects. They really know how to use their wit. We will triumph in this battle, believe me. And I miss you too, with all my body and soul.

Untitled Family Letters IV
...I don't know how to start this letter. General Jiyan, I want to say thank you. Thanks to you, his message finally reached us like this.
I recall days with him from time to time. He said someone should be the protector, even if this means sacrifices. In those distant portrayals of the battlefield, you stood unwaveringly against the enemies, supporting him and other soldiers with your might. He said you saved his life countless times. You are his icon, the best soldier who possesses a fighter's heart and a giver's will. He wants to be the same. Although he'd sacrificed his life to cover his teammates, I don't think he'd ever regretted it.
That's what you told me, that he always protects other soldiers even when facing the greatest threats, that he deserves to be a hero.
That night, I met him in a heart-breaking rainy dream that ominously resembled the day when the death of my father arrived. He opened the door, greeting me with his comeback. The early reunion obliged me to ask him: Why did you come back? I thought the war was still raging.
He replied: I just want to check if you're safe. Xiaobao is asleep, right? I'll be leaving now if everything is okay.
And then he added: Everyone on the battlefield just can't mellow out one bit when the war is drawing to an end. They're prepared to go for the killing blow.
I nodded: Just do your job and don't worry about us. Be a fearless fighter and beat those monsters. His steps paused upon a hesitant yes. I urged him to go back, and in anxiety, I met his open arms. He asked me: What if I die in the battle? What about you and Lil. Bao?
Questioned by such a dilemma, I asked in return: Do you ever regret joining the army?
He said no, not if he can protect our homeland.
"So am I." I said.
When I woke from that dream, I was visited by a sudden idea to see the Hero Play with Xiaobao. In the Theater, the heroine in Fiamma wielded a sword bravely against the Fluffernox while the stage bathed in flames. Attacked by the monster, she fell to the ground again and again. As she gathered herself from continued sufferings, tears coursed through my face. I told Lil. Bao that his father is a hero who can rival the Fiamma.
Xiaobao answered this in excitement: I want to be a hero just like him!
I promised to share all these stories with him and all living souls.
General, I would remember this till the end of life, and carve those names upon an eternal stone.
new_translation_vi: Những lá thư gia đình chưa tiêu đề I

source_en:
I received a message the other day.
Nothing special, just a message from the train station to the delayed passengers. It reads: "The Future Express apologizes to you with utmost sincerity. We'll keep our service full and complete until you reach the destination." I finished reading and deleted it, thinking "This must be a mistake by the station. I haven't traveled by train for a long time."
But this was just the beginning. I kept receiving strange messages about this Future Express now and then. I transferred them to the spam at first. I live in the moment. Those sorts of long travel and future seem out of my realm. I'm busy running errands around the mine, listening to frequent complaints from those researchers. Even a small miner like me gets a little bit nervous as the year draws to its close.
But these constant messages are killing me. Once I snatched a moment from my job to check them up and one particular piece had captured my attention (probably from a kid): "Daddy. The steward tells me to sit tight because the train is about to leave. We'll be in the future in no time! She would cast a spell that keeps us safe until the train arrives at the future. But I don't know about the future..." These words reminded me of my daughter, the same ever-curiosity when she was young. I haven't seen her in a while, though. I didn't want to disappoint this young sender with all the delay and wait. So I replied: I know the future. Future is where you get to eat Star Flakes and realize all of your dreams.
Several days later, this message thing struck my terminal again with a delay notice: "We're sincerely sorry for the delay. The Future Express will seek for soon departure while ensuring you a safe and happy journey with our best." It even ends with something like "The Future Express will meet you in the future." Another text comes right in: "When do we get to leave? Lil. You keeps asking me about this. I can only respond with empty promises, telling her that 'Soon we will be leaving for the future.' The lobby is full of anxious passengers, each clutching to an urgent desire to leave. And myself included. I received some food from a good Samaritan and that relaxed my nerves a bit. *sigh* When do we get to leave..." This looks like a message for the train station to me but somehow it reached my terminal. Glad that I had a soft time those days. Urged by a passing thought to cheer the sender, I replied: The train will leave soon. Be patient.
It never really cuts off the messages. I still receive them now and then. During a meal with my colleagues, I brought up the topic and all those intricate and haywire messages in my terminal. I sometimes felt compelled to comfort those frustrated passengers.
They said in utter doubt, that there was no such thing as the Future Express.
So I showed those messages to them and met their confused stares. The elder one of my colleagues chimed in, recalling some sort of rail station around the place in the past. It was used as an escape route during a horrible disaster. People named this train "The Future Express", carrying a message that you could ride with it until the bitter end and arrive at the future. Ages had veiled the rest of the story when they only came along the tongues of the past generations. Even he didn't know what happened later. I can't help but think, if the Future Express truly belongs to a forgotten past, then why would I receive these messages...
new_translation_vi: Tôi nhận được một tin nhắn vào ngày nọ.

source_en:
Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: I
We conducted a comprehensive survey and inspection of the Dim Forest and have come to the decision to revive the old research site of the Forest Nature Reserve. A rearrangement and categorization of the legacy data stored inside was conducted. During this process, we even discovered seeds and specimens of some plant species that have long since been deemed extinct. These precious seeds and specimens can help us gain a better understanding of the ecological changes the Dim Forest has experienced and the impact the Lament has placed on this area. 
Next, we will perform a comprehensive survey of various resources of the Forest, such as soil, water, etc., and focus on studying the local TD population of Hoochiefs. Based on previous reports, there have been several assault cases involving these Hoochiefs. Explorers who have encountered these TDs claimed that they frequently appear in groups. With this information in mind, we require all investigators entering the Dark Forest to travel in teams and take precautionary measures when necessary. 
(Cangmin: This is information regarding the establishment of the Dim Forest’s Department of Ecology. Long after the ending of the Lament, the situation in the Forest gradually stabilized, inviting researchers to conduct studies.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: II
10:00 A.M.
Several Hoochiefs were found near the research institute. Through observation, it was found that these Hoochiefs possess group consciousness to a certain degree and perform physical gestures to communicate with each other. All personnel in the institute have been notified to maintain a safe distance with the Hoochiefs.
1:00 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief.
2:45 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief group. A small-scale conflict occurred between the two groups. One of the groups seemed to be covered in some kind of spores. The Hoochiefs without spores were defeated and fled the scene.
6:00 P.M.
The Hoochiefs attacked the research institute and one was captured. The institute will shelter the Hoochief.
The behavioral characteristics of these Hoochiefs will be recorded and the engineering team are requested to install bionic cameras for our research. In the mean time, the Waveband of the Hoochief will be thoroughly analyzed.
(Cangmin: Study currently at preliminary stage)
(Qiaomu: The spores were later confirmed to be poisonous.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: III
We deployed several bionic cameras to observe the Hoochief groups. The following cameras were deployed. Three in the form of bushes, two in boulders, and one in Hoochief form. The Hoochief camera was able to imitate their movements to a certain extent, but were relatively robotic and failed to perform complex actions. In this round of filming, two bush cameras were destroyed, with the boulder cameras being used by the Hoochiefs as throwing weapons, resulting in critical damage to their lenses.
The Hoochief camera continued to follow the Hoochiefs and filmed their leader. The Hoochiefs did not show any aggression towards it, but the camera was immobilized due to a malfunction in its motion systems. The Hoochiefs later performed a "burial" for it around the banyan tree.
We will sweep the area around the banyan tree and recover the cameras.
(Qiaomu: The bionic cameras really came in clutch. Real MVPs!)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: IV
The sheltered Hoochief is covered in spores emitting a red glow. Researchers who came into close contact with the Hoochief for an extended period of time exhibited signs of coughing and difficulty breathing. As a result, researchers have been restricted from making close contact. 
Days later, the Hoochief began to show signs of crazed tendencies. It continues to devastate its surroundings while scratching its own body and coughing constantly. 
Further observation of the Hoochief is required. 
Additionally, we have observed an increase in the appearances of Hoochiefs near the research institute, likely influenced by the sheltered Hoochief's frequency. This requires special attention. 
An investigation into the Hoochief leader is to be carried out as soon as possible.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: V
Feilian Beringal, Howler, Overlord Class Tacet Discord. 
Based on our studies, the Feilian Beringal resides around the Giant Banyan and is the leader of the Hoochief group. The creature maintains highly aggressive territorial behavior and will show strong hostility towards intruders. Several of our survey teams received major setbacks during their investigation of the Beringal.
The Feilian Beringal, along with the Hoochiefs under its command, are mimetic creatures capable of imitating the behavior of the apes that once existed in the Dim Forest, bearing a certain level of intelligence. they copy humans to wield simplistic tools and weapons, and will also comfort and protect their companions.
In the meantime, further spread of spore infection was observed. Hoochiefs covered in spores tend to be more aggressive. Caution is advised.
Research studies of this phenomenon are currently underway.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VI
With the assistance of the Midnight Rangers, we carried out a special operation on the Feilian Beringal. Through great efforts, we managed to put a tracking bracelet on the Beringal, which will help us monitor its movements in the forest and avoid any direct confrontations.
During this operation, we discovered that the number of Hoochiefs infected with the spores was much higher than we had initially estimated, and the rate of the spore's spread was faster than the prediction models had shown. The spores can significantly affect the qualities of surrounding soil, water resources, and other environmental substances, and cause near-irreversible damage to the human body. Given that the Hoochiefs are the source of transmission of the spores, their expulsion from the area will be put in place. However, some researchers believe that the Hoochiefs are not the source of the infection itself, and have submitted a secondary proposal to begin research on spore antibodies.
(Senming: My mentor was the one who initiated the antibody research. She placed hopes to resolve the Forest's complications through this way.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VII
Progress on the research of antibodies has been considerable. We believe a result is soon within reach.
Haste expulsion of the Hoochiefs failed to yield meaningful effects, and in turn, triggered more frequent Hoochief attacks. To minimize and avoid escalation of this situation, we've changed our approach and instead focused on sheltering the apes by helping to remove the spores from their bodies and alleviate their emotions.
We hope that this will help us to better carry out our work.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VIII
A series of complications, in forms such as Hoochief disturbances, led to the loss of the majority of our research data.
However, while scavenging for data, we were still able to witness the valiant efforts made by our predecessors on the Dim Forest.
<ano=Ecoacoustics>Ecological</ano> research is a complicated study. Topics such as finding critical entry points and how to begin our research are all topics we need to be mindful of.
Fortunately, we now have more time to ponder.

Date: AL159
Confidentiality: level S
Case Chronology:
In AL159, former Mornguard head Syuwan was assassinated on the outskirts of the Resonance Nexus Command Hall and died after resuscitation.
Upon investigation, there were obvious signs of a fight at the scene, and multiple people saw fire that night accompanied by the sound of an explosion, and based on the analysis of the residual data, the suspect was a Resonator with the Forte Force.
Mornguard patrol team arrived, the suspect has disappeared, blockade of the entrance to the city did not find any suspicious people, the suspect is presumed to have an unusual means of movement.
A red fragment was left in the hand of the head of the Seokan, which is suspected to be a clue, but due to the small size of the fragment, it is impossible to pinpoint the target for the time being.
As this is a serious matter, it is recommended that the details of the case be kept quiet for the time being, and that the investigation be conducted in secret.

Jinhsi's endorsement:
Agreed. Chief Syoguan is highly trusted, and this matter may shake people's hearts and cause panic, so it is important to do a good job of calming them down.

I will keep jotting things. It keeps my brain running. Until I figure this out.

source_en:
Tan: Are you really working the night shift at the mine?
Jing: I decided to find myself a means of livelihood before the water and food run out at home. Saves me from starving myself.
Jing: It wasn't as terrible as I had imagined, though. I kept staring at the "grand elevator" on that side, trying to kill time. It must have gone up and down at least fifty times this evening.
Tan: Isn’t it too frequent?
Tan: Moreover, I heard that the mine has recently reduced the night shifts. So why is there still so much activity?
Jing: I don’t know either. Let me check with my night-security-adapted Forte.
Jing: Something’s definitely wrong...
Tan: What is it?
Jing: Nobody’s in the elevator. I checked the platforms across the levels. No one’s waiting... I have to go and check for myself.
Tan: Hey hey hey. Don’t get ahead of yourself yet. If this was a movie, the thing waiting for you out there definitely would not be what you expected.
Jing: That’s not true. I have to take care of more than my own safety, now that I’m in this job. Besides, you should start to be rational. Didn’t you brag about being the new generation of Jinzhou? Why do you believe in this kind of thing more than those squares?
Jing: Maybe it’s just mechanical malfunctioning, or my co-workers being naughty? The work here is so dull. Maybe they decided to “surprise” me a little?
Tan: Sentinel bless you. Good luck, then.

Who said music must be played by instrument?

source_en: The room was filled with clocks. I listened to the hands slowly ticking in the darkness. I opened my eyes, but there was nothing here, only the primitive darkness. I quickly got up and picked up a pen to record everything, the dream, yes, it was a dream. This time, I finally caught it and recorded it clearly. I do not possess the talent of a bard, nor do I have the fascinating legends of a traveler. I am simply an ordinary storyteller, combining the dream that troubles me with words. It all begins with the long winter season. The old captain at the harbor always had the same opening lines before setting sail, as a way to welcome the newly recruited young sailors. “The ocean is always unknown to humanity. Although humans have grasped the helm of progress time and time again with wisdom and bravery, the ocean will never bow down to humanity... Countless disasters have befallen those ambitious individuals who venture into the ocean, and this tragedy continues to unfold.” The old captain uttered each word with a dull tone, but it didn't matter. The sailors, excited for the upcoming voyage, simply applauded and cheered, without paying much attention to the words. The ship slowly left the shore, and the young sailors felt nauseous from the rough voyage, with constant vomiting slowly draining their enthusiasm. A huge creature leaped out of the ocean, causing the young sailors to hide in the cabin, while the captain and the old sailors stood calmly on the deck. "I will forgive your timidity this time, as it is your first encounter with it. Please remember its appearance. We call it the ancient whale. It is the disaster caused by the ocean, mysterious and immensely powerful. It is the embodiment of the demons of nature. Of course, when dealing with such unknown creatures, humans will not succumb. This is the first lesson of your voyage..." Intermittent gunfire broke out on the sea surface, and more and more sailors joined the one-sided attack. Continuously pulling the trigger made them gradually forget their fear and also the reason why they were attacking the giant creature in front of them, which had not harmed them. Under the smoke, the ship slowly moved forward along the blood-red trail...

It is the disaster caused by the ocean, mysterious and immensely powerful. It is the embodiment of the demons of nature. Of course, when dealing with such unknown creatures, humans will not succumb. This is the first lesson of your voyage..." Intermittent gunfire broke out on the sea surface, and more and more sailors joined the one-sided attack. Continuously pulling the trigger made them gradually forget their fear and also the reason why they were attacking the giant creature in front of them, which had not harmed them. Under the smoke, the ship slowly moved forward along the blood-red trail...

source_en:
I. Objectives
1. Assess the feasibility of spore essence extraction.
2. Investigate the diverse effects of spores at different concentrations.
II. Materials
Hoochiefs, with one uncontaminated and one contaminated specimen per group; 1ml syringe, saline solution.
III. Procedure
1. Group two Hoochiefs with similar body weights, weigh them, and assign unique identifiers.
2. Extract spore essence from contaminated individuals, blend it with saline solution, and establish concentrations of 0.2%, 0.4%, and 0.8%, categorized by groups.
3. Administer various concentrations of the spore extracts to uncontaminated individuals, observe their activity, and record findings.
4. After completing the experiment, conduct statistical analysis on the results and formulate conclusions.
IV. Conclusions
1. The spore essence extraction process results in approximately 58% loss, but extraction remains viable.
2. The 0.4% concentration of the extract exhibits the optimal effect, although outcomes may differ based on subjects and necessitate further validation.

Note: Achieved interim success. Transitioning the experimental subjects to humans is authorized.

Shixia just got accepted into the top school in Jinzhou, and she's set her sights on working at the Ministry of Development. I couldn't be happier for her, but also a bit envious of her drive and success. Meanwhile, I still have no idea what I want to do with my life. Shixia keeps bragging about how she'll pass the exam with flying colors, but let's be real, she studies all day and night while I'm out having fun on vacation. She's like a mountain climber, reaching new heights with every achievement. Good for her!

Despite Shixia's initial hesitation, she ended up crawling up the steep terrain alongside me. And after reaching such great heights together, it was clear she wouldn't back down easily. Thankfully, she got into Leyi Academy, otherwise her legs would have been permanently stuck in her bedroom from all the studying. I've never seen someone with so many textbooks and a consistently lit bedroom for a whole year... the school bully must be terrifying! But Shixia seems to be enjoying herself. 

I just don't understand why she's suddenly in a bad mood after acing the exam... I should take the chance to ask her, since she’s busy enjoying the scenery right now.

source_en:
Hello to the later of Haymarket, where I was once the city's mayor.
By the time you read this letter, Sea City and I will be about gone. Allow me, in this letter, to tell you of its last glory.
It was a perfect day for stargazing, and on that day we opened the roof of the municipal building especially to view the sea of stars with the citizens of Haiku City who had won the lottery.
Near the appointed time, far more people than expected came up. It wasn't due to stargazing, but because floods and torrential rains had quietly arrived and were attacking Sea City in a big way.
There were strangers who saw each other as enemies, and even former friends and family who had turned against each other in order to grab supplies and to seize the high ground.
I had thought that Sea City was a body of steel, but I didn't realize that she was so fragile in the face of disaster.
So I announced the opening of the passage for all citizens to ascend. Of course, saving everyone is unrealistic. To save one is one, and to last a moment is a moment is the only thought I have left.
This is the municipal building of Haymarket, and in critical moments it should serve the people who co-created it.
Survivors gather here, and what started out as a day of stargazing turns into a day of downright escapism. With dim waves of clouds above our heads and endless floodwaters beneath our feet, we wait for our fate on an isolated island. The sun and moon were gone, and the signal was broken. In the end, I had to make different star maps of the night view of Sea City's neighborhoods and show them to you in a projection.
That was a new promotional video for Hai City just released a while ago, a very beautiful night scene, shot at an altitude of thousands of meters.
In the face of disaster, human beings have lost the right to look up at the stars. But I hope that we can still view our own starry sky and keep that view as a common memory.

source_en:
Reported by Goose Book
Since the beginning of TD Outbreak (130-155 years), there has been a dramatic increase in the mist in the deep pit located at the bottom of Tiger's Maw, and the Institute has detected a large number of active Wuthering Waves sub-signals at this location, and has dispatched an exploration team to the pit to investigate on a number of occasions, however, personnel have been severely compromised, and the data has been lost, and it has not been possible to actually advance the progress of the investigations.
The purpose of this exploration is to continue the investigation of the mists and to rescue the trapped personnel. The personnel involved were:
Midnight Rangers Pioneer Brigade Specialized Team (111162)
Institute Address Exploration Team
......
Analysis of survey results regarding the Unknown Mists:
This exploration collected samples of the Mist in the tunnel connecting Tiger's Maw Mine and the Misty Deep Pit, and analyzed them in a field test using the [Simple Spectrometer] carried by the team. Based on the results of this test, we hypothesized that the Mist appears to be a biological component with a composition similar to the scale powder on the wings of Lepidoptera insects, exhibiting non-toxic, low-temperature properties.
We judge that the danger of the mists comes mainly from its low-temperature characteristics:
① The condensation of water vapor caused by low temperature will greatly obstruct the field of vision, causing investigators to lose their judgment of direction in the misty area.
② Low temperature will directly affect the health of the investigators, long-term low temperature leads to reduced physical vitality, unable to respond to the danger in time.
However, this investigation has not yet identified the positive body of the unusual sound coming from within the misty area. Considering that the unknown sound may cause panic among the people in the vicinity and affect the operation of the mine, it is recommended that the information be blocked.


The following is a list of recently missing persons:
Chamon
Bracegirdle
Leyun
Chonin
..................
(Relatives of the above individuals appear to have been experiencing varying degrees of hallucinations recently. They are calling for them to enter the deep pit of mist at the bottom of the mine, which is suspected to be related to the mutation of the mist. As the Misty Pit is sealed off and cannot be investigated further, it is recommended that all operators be informed to avoid the mist and temporarily stop mining in the area around the Misty Pit.)

The ancient tree "Loong's Gaze", is located in the northern parts of Loong's Gaze Outskirts, Central Plains. Based on records found inside "Plants of Jinzhou", the Loong's Gaze is estimated to be between 1400 and 1500 years old, having withstood the test of the Lament and continues to stand tall. Its twisting roots are like a python wrapped around a loong banner, its branches as though piercing claws, both showing the tree's unrestrained nature.
This unshakable ancient tree has long since become an icon of the land, as people seek to it as a beacon of hope. As long as the Loong's Gaze stands, the day of the Central Plains' rebirth will sure to come.

Keeping track of time is essential. We'll have to go out someday.

source_en:
Day 109.
There were two loud sounds today, I couldn't hear what it was, and there was a pause in the middle for about two... three minutes? When the first sound was heard, the new bed that had just been built on Xiao Gui's side was shaken to the point that it all fell apart, and the sand and dust fell from the cracks in the stone above his head, and he was immediately dumbfounded, and he didn't move. Until the second sound, he howled violently again.
Sansui told him to shut up, but he still howled, so Sansui gave him a slap on the face and told him not to affect everyone.
It didn't matter to me. By the time the first sound came, I was already thinking about my next life. In my next life I want to be a Gulpuff, zapping whoever gets me, not hiding in this dank cave.

Day 110.
Sansui says Threnodian can stomp hundreds of Gulpuffs with one foot, I say it doesn't matter, Gulpuff will zap his foot.
Not much rattling today.
new_translation_vi: Ngày 109.

source_en:
Xiao Gui's baby was born, at night. The moonlight shone in through the big hole that had been blown up, and it was quite bright. We all chatted about naming the baby, and finally chose "Changming". The child cried at the sound of the name, and then Xiao Gui followed suit, and so did everyone else, even Sanshui, who wiped his eyes.
Before the roof of the cave was blown open, there was no light from the sky. Listening to the cannon fire outside, in addition to fear, there is also a bit of unspeakable ...... ease. Now it was better to always know when it was light and dark and when it was raining. Everyone has decided to live here, Threnodian how it will be in the end, I do not intend to think about it, here is quite good.

Maybe, in the future, someone will come here to investigate and find "cavemen" or something. I'm just writing this down in the hope that the explorer doesn't embarrass us by treating us like ancient apes, with all the research and studies.
We are just villagers who came here for refuge, nothing special, no need to remember us.
new_translation_vi: Con của Xiao Gui đã chào đời, vào ban đêm. Ánh trăng chiếu qua cái lỗ lớn đã bị thổi bay, và nó khá sáng. Tất cả chúng tôi đều trò chuyện về việc đặt tên cho đứa bé, và cuối cùng chọn "Changming". Đứa trẻ khóc khi nghe thấy cái tên, và sau đó Xiao Gui cũng làm theo, và mọi người khác cũng vậy, ngay cả Sanshui, người đã lau mắt.

Weekly Readings 100th Special Extra Edition

*Weekly Fresh* Bounds of Gathering
Qichi Village's first Flower Tossing Festival came to a successful conclusion. Unlike previous years, to commemorate the completion of the village to the north, Qichi Village invited a number of nearby villagers to participate as a way of thanking everyone for their support.
Flower Tossing is a custom of the villagers of Qichi Village in the past. In March, freshly folded flower branches and petals are thrown into the Yuhua Lake pool to let the water feel the vitality of the early spring, and to pray that the joy of the new life will be transmitted to the hearts of the people and that they will not be trapped by the destruction of the Lament.
There is also a small pond near our inn, so if you are interested, you can throw a handful of flower petals into it when you take a walk after dinner. Although it is not as large as the Yuhua Lake in Qichi Village, the prayers and joys are certainly shared.

source_en:
Chapter 13: The Contract of Doom

The Magistrate's menacing gaze pierced through the trembling woman like a hot knife through butter. "Sign this here contract and you'll belong to me, my dear. And as long as you don't break any of the rules for the next three years, I'll make your ex-husband beg for mercy and pray for a swift death."

The woman crumbled to the ground in tears, her once glamorous face now stained with mascara. She clutched onto the papers like they were her last chance at redemption. In an ironic twist of fate, her former nemesis had become her savior. Her hair was no longer the envy of onlookers, but rather hung lifelessly around her face like a wilted flower. "Fine," she choked out, "but I have one condition."

The Magistrate leaned back with a smug smirk on his face. "Go on," he purred.

"That woman? She needs to disappear from this world," the woman demanded, a glint of revenge flashing in her eyes.

The Magistrate's brow furrowed in confusion as he watched her tears. "Sure, " he said quickly, lifting her up with one hand and causing her to stumble into his arms. As she struggled against him, the Magistrate's expression softened and a hint of amusement danced in his eyes.

"Don't touch me!"

"Ha! Don't flatter yourself, sweetie," the Magistrate chuckled. "I wouldn't touch you with a ten-foot pole."

source_en: Jinzhou is a fortress city on the southeastern border of Huanglong. It is the first land-based port for all foreign ships entering the nation. Foreign personnel and goods must be inspected and offloaded at Port Gunchao. Port Gunchao features a well-established container management system, along with large-scale berthing facilities. It is a comprehensive main hub port and container trunk port with the highest throughput out of any port in Huanglong. Currently, Port Gunchao has reached long-term strategic partnerships with Lollo Logistics and the Pioneer Association. We welcome business cooperation of any form.    Office of Commerce, Port Gunchao

Today, the captain had another discussion with me. He hoped that, as a technical backbone, I could provide a decisive opinion on whether the exploration work could still be completed as scheduled. Both he and I, and even everyone else, understand the importance of excavating the second long-distance transportation route. This route, starting from Jinzhou, passes through the Gorges of Spirits to connect the remaining areas in Huanglong. It is important for Jinzhou to have closer and more convenient interactions with other territories in Huanglong. To put it bluntly, in case there are issues with one transportation route in the future, we can still rely on the other, avoiding falling into a desperate situation.

Recent monitoring indicates the potential emergence of Tacet Fields around the Gorges of Spirits at any time, but we can't stop now as we have already come this far. If we stop now, all our hard-earned achievements will be in vain. However, if we don't stop, we may risk the lives of our team members.

source_en:
Position:
[Express Delivery Courier]

Requirements:
Age: No restrictions; candidates of all age groups are encouraged to apply.
Driving License: Must possess a valid driving license from any country.
Responsibilities: The ideal candidate will adhere to company standards, ensuring the safe, efficient, and accurate completion of daily collection and delivery tasks.

Work Location:
Candidates will be assigned to a nearby distribution point based on their preferences and the current availability at each distribution point.

Work Hours:
Duration: 9 hours per day, 5 days a week. Starting around 7 AM and concluding around 7PM, with approximately a 3-hour break at noon. 
Overtime: Any work beyond these specified hours will be considered overtime and compensated at double the standard rate.

Salary and Benefits:
1. Earn per package with unlimited potential earnings.
2. The company provides personal safety insurance, transportation vehicles, accommodation, and specialized collection and delivery skills training (including but not limited to hazardous material identification, harmless treatment of pollutants, first aid, etc.). The company issues corresponding professional qualification certificates upon completion;
3. Triple salary on holidays;
4. Free supply of work unifroms throughout the year;
5. Personal safety protection will be provided for collection and delivery in dangerous zones (including but not limited to material support, armed support, dedicated escorts, etc.), with all expenses covered by the company.

source_en:
The Dim Forest is unquestionably the most significant treasure trove in the entire Huanglong region, boasting unparalleled species richness in the world.
Upon setting foot at the entrance of this gate, I could distinctly hear the plants whispering and their summons.
It is said that deep within the forest, the former site of the Department of Ecoacoustics holds image records of numerous plants, including a delectable species known as Ivory Banana, originating from the Dim Forest. Ivory Bananas were once a primary food source for Hoochiefs, and, in return, Hoochiefs exploring the forest in search of Ivory Bananas became excellent pollinators.
Since the spread of the toxic spore mist, wild Ivory Bananas have disappeared from the Dim Forest, and information about this species can now only be found in historical records.
The Lament might be an inevitable process of natural selection.

source_en:
Guided by the fluorescent plants, I discovered a large purple tree.
Considering its characteristic of resembling an entire forest on its own, I speculated that this tree is likely a sub-species of the Ficus genus. The mysterious purple color on its leaves remains unexplained and requires further research and verification.
Due to the season, I failed to collect samples of the flowers and fruits of this tree, and there were no traces of pollinating insects in the vicinity. Surprisingly, the Violuna Banyan hasn't been contaminated by the toxic spores. Many mysteries still surround it, waiting to be unveiled.
I am certain that this is the first time this tree species has been discovered, and I have temporarily named it the Violuna Banyan.

source_en:
After bidding farewell to the Violuna Banyan, I proceeded towards the most important target—the Central Banyan.
It's a tree towering into the sky, with a large spore cloud perched at the top, spreading toxic spores with the wind.
Any creature approaching this tree exhibited obvious anxiety and fear—the white toxic spores floated around the Central Banyan, almost blocking out my sight. I could even hear faint coughing from the forest. I needed to take every step with extreme caution from now on.
The closer I got to the Central Banyan, the more uneasy I felt—there was a heavy snorting coming from its hollow, and the vibrations caused by breathing shook off the spores accumulated on the branches. As more and more spores fell down, I tightened my filter.
These creations of the Waveworn Phenomenon are infiltrating our world, making everything dangerous and unfamiliar.

source_en:
It's been a while since I had such an intense workout.

The contaminated Hoochief exhibited an astonishing lack of fatigue in their relentless pursuit of its prey—unfortunately, that prey was me. However, when escaping, I didn't feel panic and my brain started racing. I was well aware that the toxic spores are a direct consequence of the Waveworm Phenomenon. Based on the Ecoacoustics standards, how should we classify those contaminated Hoochiefs? Furthermore, how do those toxic spores contaminate Tacet Discords and is meditation a viable solution for Tacet Discords contamination?

Utilizing the Grapple function, I skillfully swung onto a hidden branch. The contaminated Hoochief lost track of its target and scanned around in confusion. It looked like a lost kid, whimpering and coughing, and it seemed to lose spatial perception. Each intense cough released a burst of toxic spores into the air. The spores, driven by their innate instinct to propagate, further pushed the already weakend body of the Hoochief to its utmost limit.

I started wondering: is it a form of co-evolution, or does it represent a parasitic relationship?

source_en:
The social behavior of Hoochiefs is even more astonishing than imagined, establishing them as the dominant species in the Dim Forest.

According to my survey, the toxic spore mist constantly spreads outward from the Central Banyan. To avoid the invasion of those spores, Hoochiefs disperse into different groups, seeking refuge in various safe zones, gradually forming communities characterized by "paternalism". The intelligence displayed by those Hoochiefs seem to be unique among Tacet Discords. Besides, near the Hoochief communities, sightings of activities from other Tacet Discords are notably scarce, which I attribute to a possible manifestation of "territorial consciousness". This consciousness prompts Hoochiefs to take different jobs and collaborate in repelling intruders from their territories.

What makes me even more curious is the response of a community if a Hoochief becomes contaminated. I am left wondering about the decisions such communities would make in such a scenario. Along the frequented path of the Feilian Beringal, I caught a glimpse of some grave-like mounds. Unfortunately, I didn't have the time to examine them carefully.

How long have we been sunken into the haze? A few seconds, or perhaps a few minutes? I have yet to recover from the ordeal; the hypothermia is still causing my entire body to tremble. I feel as if I have just been pulled out of a freezer, stiff and curled up. My ability to think has almost come to a standstill.
What was it? What did we go through? Where are we?
The miners taken away by the haze, where are they?
...
I will keep jotting things. It keeps my brain running. Until I figure this out.
