Tan: Are you really working the night shift at the mine?
Jing: I decided to find myself a means of livelihood before the water and food run out at home. Saves me from starving myself.
Jing: It wasn't as terrible as I had imagined, though. I kept staring at the "grand elevator" on that side, trying to kill time. It must have gone up and down at least fifty times this evening.
Tan: Isn't it too frequent?
Tan: Moreover, I heard that the mine has recently reduced the night shifts. So why is there still so much activity?
Jing: I don't know either. Let me check with my night-security-adapted Forte.
Jing: Something's definitely wrong...
Tan: What is it?
Jing: Nobody's in the elevator. I checked the platforms across the levels. No one's waiting... I have to go and check for myself.
Tan: Hey hey hey. Don't get ahead of yourself yet. If this was a movie, the thing waiting for you out there definitely would not be what you expected.
Jing: That's not true. I have to take care of more than my own safety, now that I'm in this job. Besides, you should start to be rational. Didn't you brag about being the new generation of Jinzhou? Why do you believe in this kind of thing more than those squares?
Jing: Maybe it's just mechanical malfunctioning, or my co-workers being naughty? The work here is so dull. Maybe they decided to "surprise" me a little?
Tan: Sentinel bless you. Good luck, then.

source_en:
Who said music must be played by instrument?
During my time working in the mine, I kept hearing strange sounds. At first, I thought it was the rumored "sound" everyone talked about... But later on, I discovered that these strange sounds actually came from the minerals themselves, and even more astonishingly, they formed a unique tune!
The shape the Tacetite is cut into and the quality of the Tacetite both dictates how this tune goes.
I sorted through the recordings across the years and arranged them into a song, which is now known as "Tune of Rocks".
I don't feel quite vigorous lately... But fortunately the Pioneer Association Radio has received the mastertape of "Tune of Rocks". My wish has been fulfilled!

source_en:
The ancient tree "Loong's Gaze", is located in the northern parts of Loong's Gaze Outskirts, Central Plains. Based on records found inside "Plants of Jinzhou", the Loong's Gaze is estimated to be between 1400 and 1500 years old, having withstood the test of the Lament and continues to stand tall. Its twisting roots are like a python wrapped around a loong banner, its branches as though piercing claws, both showing the tree's unrestrained nature. This unshakable ancient tree has long since become an icon of the land, as people seek to it as a beacon of hope. As long as the Loong's Gaze stands, the day of the Central Plains' rebirth will sure to come.

*Reminder: Please do not carve on the bark or branches of the tree. We all share an equal responsibility to safe keep the ancient tree's well-being.

source_en:
~ Qingyan Courier Station ~
Station Monthly Read, Issue No.80, Standard Edition

*Event Guide* Bounds of Gathering
The very first Flower Tossing Festival in Xiehua Village ended in a success. Unlike previous years, we invited many of our friends from the army to participate and celebrate the victories of their battles on the front lines, as a way of saying thanks for their hard work.
Flower Tossing is a local custom of the residents of the Central Plains. In March, residents throw freshly-picked flowering branches or petals into running water, as a way of embracing the vitality of early spring within the pools of water. They pray that the joys of new life can flow into people's hearts, no longer confined by sorrows left by the destruction of the Lament.
In addition, there is a small pond near our station. All visiting guests who are interested can feel free to throw a handful of petals into the pond during a stroll after dinner time. It may not be as big as the Yuhua Lake of Qiqi Village in the past, but the hopes and joys are the same.


~ Qingyan Courier Station ~
Station Monthly Read, Issue No.100, Special Commemorative Edition

*Special Postscript* Final Farewell
Who would have thought, the Qingyan Courier Station has accompanied travelers of all walks for another two years, and our monthly read has now reached its 100th issue. At the end of this commemorative issue, we would like to bid farewell to each and all of you.
The Lament has completely changed the Central Plains. Frequent outbreaks of disasters have made management of the station more and more difficult. Under these circumstances, I regret to say that the Qingyan Courier Station can no longer live up to its name and provide guests with a truly safe and comfortable living experience.
However, Qingyan's farewell will not be as unexpected as the appearance of a Tacet Field! We will soon be holding a charity sale of all the items inside the station. The proceeds from the sale will be used to help everyone rebuild their homes.

I hope you'll all look forward to it.  I hope that we can meet again in Jinzhou in the not-so-distant future.
new_translation_vi: ~ Trạm Chuyển Phát Qingyan ~

source_en:
It was the fifth day into the field and I finally had time to write something down.
I was assigned to be the platoon clerk, a platoon of 30 men. I had to write down what I ate, drank and slept, what I took and what I did. Geiger counters were going off every day, and shells flew by from time to time in the near distance.
I don't know if I was lucky or not, but an enemy bomb hit the bunker I had dug. It burned my Backpack to a pile of ashes. Fortunately, I was passing orders and dodged a bullet. But in the late fall, without a sleeping bag and a change of clothes, and not knowing how to survive the coming winter.
The platoon sergeant in charge of logistics, a warm-hearted man, let me have his brand new sleeping bag and clothes, and went to use the already moldy spares himself. I only took the sleeping bag, promising to return it to him when the rations were issued. He didn't answer or take back his clothes, just smiled and left. The night was too cold and I didn't want to go after him. Might as well wait until tomorrow to give it back to him.
new_translation_vi: Đã là ngày thứ năm tại thực địa và cuối cùng tôi cũng có thời gian để viết lại điều gì đó.

source_en:
The battle for 91.7 Heights lasted 11 days and nights, and our platoon, including the platoon leader and platoon deputy, lost 16 men, 7 were seriously wounded, and 8 were lightly wounded. The battle was as follows:
In late October, the enemy attacked my 91.7 unnamed heights, after several days and nights of repeated struggle, the enemy has encroached on most of the surface positions. 27 October, my department was ordered to put into battle to support friendly neighboring forces.
Under cover of fire, our unit launched six attacks on the enemy within eight hours, all of which failed to accomplish the task of expelling the enemy from the heights completely.
At dawn on the 28th, the enemy unsuccessfully launched a counter-attack with fire support.
From October 28 to November 6, control of the surface position changed hands several times, and neither side made a breakthrough.
On the night of the 6th, our department was replaced by friendly neighboring forces and withdrawn from the battlefield for repairs due to large losses and more than 70% casualties.
Lesson Learned:
The casualties of our section came mainly from kills by enemy close-range direct fire. This came to prove that the defensive experience promoted in the Army concerning indirect fire was effective; on the other hand, it proved that we were ill-prepared for close-range fighting, a detailed summary of the lessons learned is attached.
new_translation_vi: Trận chiến tại Cao điểm 91.7 kéo dài 11 ngày đêm, và trung đội của chúng tôi, bao gồm cả trung đội trưởng và phó trung đội trưởng, đã mất 16 người, 7 người bị thương nặng và 8 người bị thương nhẹ. Trận chiến diễn ra như sau:

source_en:
Today is November 8, and we have been ordered back to the rear to reorganize. The rumbling of artillery at 91.7 is constantly heard, and there is no doubt that height will be the key to the whole battlefield. Whoever mastered it there gained the initiative.
Flesh and blood became the strongest line of defense on that high ground, which was not many square feet, and before which all steel had to bend the knee.
I was glad I didn't borrow the platoon sergeant's new clothes, at least we could bring him home with dignity.
He told me a legend that his grandfather told him. It is said that when a man leaves, in the dead of night his returning spirit will be carried back by the breeze to find his own home. Now that it's late at night, I wonder if everyone has already set off on their way home?
new_translation_vi: Hôm nay là ngày 8 tháng 11, và chúng tôi đã được lệnh quay trở lại hậu phương để tổ chức lại. Tiếng ầm ầm của pháo binh tại 91.7 liên tục được nghe thấy, và không nghi ngờ gì nữa, cao điểm đó sẽ là chìa khóa cho toàn bộ chiến trường. Ai làm chủ được nó ở đó sẽ giành được thế chủ động.

source_en:
On November 15, we waited to provide support, two recruits in all. Counting the 12 men left over from before, we formed a squad. Since we were still a platoon, I was the acting squad lieutenant, nominally an acting platoon lieutenant.
The battle of 91.7 had depleted the reserves, and it was time for us to return to the battlefield with the remnants of our incomplete formation. Our troops are penetrating to the enemy's rear, just waiting to complete the encirclement so we can completely annihilate the enemy.
The enemy has also realized this and intends to make a desperate attempt to break through our defenses and counter-encircle our two flanks. The fate of this battle will soon be decided.
new_translation_vi: Vào ngày 15 tháng 11, chúng tôi chờ đợi để cung cấp hỗ trợ, tổng cộng có hai tân binh. Tính cả 12 người còn lại từ trước, chúng tôi thành lập một tiểu đội. Vì chúng tôi vẫn là một trung đội, tôi là trung úy tiểu đội quyền, trên danh nghĩa là trung úy trung đội quyền.

WOMAN VOICE: "Forty-seven days and I've gone from being a big-headed soldier to acting platoon leader."
Female voice: "The enemy kept coming up like cockroaches."
FEMALE VOICE: "And we will not hesitate to stomp on them, as always."
[pauses and takes a deep breath
Female voice: "Mom, I'll be back. They'll bring me back, and remember to leave the windows unlocked."

source_en:
1. The Sea of Flames is strictly off-limits to unauthorized personnel. Any unauthorized individuals who attempt to enter will face consequences for their actions. Those with authorization must adhere to the operation regulations.
2. Before entering the Sea of Flames, proper authorization and qualification certificates are required.
3. Protective gear must be worn before entering the Sea of Flames. Resonators must wear heat insulators and suction wires, while non-resonators should only enter if necessary and with additional protective clothing in special circumstances.
4. It is prohibited to work in the Sea of Flames for more than 3 hours at a time. If any physical or mental discomfort arises during operation, leave immediately and seek medical attention.
5. Regular psychiatric assessments are mandatory for personnel working in the Sea of Flames for an extended period of time to prevent potential risk of psychosis.
new_translation_vi: 1. Sea of Flames nghiêm cấm nhân sự không có thẩm quyền. Bất kỳ cá nhân không có thẩm quyền nào cố gắng xâm nhập sẽ phải đối mặt với hậu quả cho hành động của mình. Những người có thẩm quyền phải tuân thủ các quy định vận hành.

source_en:
That little girl Annalika said that there might be a "Pocket Piano" here, and according to the coordinates she gave, this should be the area.
However, after rummaging around for half a day, I couldn't even see the shadow of the piano, except for some blown-up dolls and toy cars that couldn't run.
This kid can always find something strange and weird from piles of ancient books, but does something like a "pocket piano" really exist?
new_translation_vi: Cô bé Annalika đó nói rằng có thể có một chiếc "Pocket Piano" ở đây, và theo tọa độ cô bé đưa, đây hẳn là khu vực đó.

source_en:
It's been so humid lately that I'm afraid it's going to be Retroact Rain again, so I found a weapon wreck to get out of the rain.
I came across a pair of siblings who were also stopping here, they were small and a bit wary of strangers, they looked like runaway kids.
I was going to call Mornguard from the camp over there to come over and take the people back, but the two surprised me by pouncing on me and almost bumping into the brim of my hat.
"Uncle, please, don't take us back. My sister and I just want to visit the sea of flowers over there." The larger boy looked at me sincerely, but I was momentarily stumped.
It's just that, who doesn't have a bit of curiosity when they're young. Anyway, I haven't gotten much lately, so why don't I just accompany them to take a look, just as a chance to go to Sea of Flames.
new_translation_vi: Dạo này ẩm ướt quá, tôi sợ lại là Retroact Rain, nên tôi tìm thấy một xác vũ khí để tránh mưa.

source_en:
We stopped at the edge of Sea of Flames and the two siblings nodded to each other as if confirming something. Then the boy pulled a small, delicate box out of his Backpack, and after only a moment's hesitation cast its contents into Sea of Flames.
Soon the long utensil melted away in the searing heat, and by the time I turned my head, the two siblings were crying little tears.
I've traveled all over the world and I'm not afraid of anything, but I'm most afraid of little kids crying, so it was good to see that I had put the blown up doll in the treasure chest before, and after I took it out and coaxed it, the little kid stopped crying.
Although this old thing did not get into the tower, it is also considered to make the best use of it, there is a value.
new_translation_vi: Chúng tôi dừng lại ở rìa Sea of Flames và hai anh em gật đầu với nhau như thể xác nhận điều gì đó. Sau đó, cậu bé lấy ra một chiếc hộp nhỏ, tinh xảo từ ba lô của mình, và sau một thoáng do dự, đã ném nội dung bên trong vào Sea of Flames.

source_en: Today was a bittersweet day. I dropped off the kids and received a blurry picture from Annalika, showing a "pocket piano" she found, just like the one I discarded years ago. It turns out that the pocket piano in the Sea of Flames was actually a precious memento of my grandparents' love. They were separated during a battle and made a promise to meet at the sea of flowers, where they would leave the pocket piano as a token of their love. My brother has plans to sell it for SHC, but how can something so priceless be measured in gold? It's moments like these that remind me of how powerful and fleeting life can be. Thank you, two little ones, for showing me the true value of antiques in this modern era.
new_translation_vi: Hôm nay là một ngày buồn vui lẫn lộn. Tôi đã đưa bọn trẻ đi và nhận được một bức ảnh mờ từ Annalika, cho thấy một chiếc "pocket piano" mà cô bé tìm thấy, giống hệt chiếc mà tôi đã vứt bỏ nhiều năm trước. Hóa ra chiếc pocket piano trong Sea of Flames thực sự là một kỷ vật quý giá về tình yêu của ông bà tôi. Họ đã bị chia cắt trong một trận chiến và hứa sẽ gặp nhau tại biển hoa, nơi họ sẽ leave chiếc pocket piano như một minh chứng cho tình yêu của họ. Anh trai tôi có kế hoạch bán nó lấy SHC, nhưng làm sao một thứ vô giá như vậy có thể đo bằng vàng? Những khoảnh khắc như thế này nhắc nhở tôi về việc cuộc sống có thể mạnh mẽ và phù du như thế nào. Cảm ơn hai bạn nhỏ, vì đã cho tôi thấy giá trị thực sự của đồ cổ trong thời đại hiện đại này.

source_en:
Annalika called out the waste after looking at my metric record.
Perhaps in her opinion, the only way to realize the true value of ancient objects is to incorporate them into the Condensed Abyss Tower.
If possible, I really hope that this little girl can step out of the Condensed Abyss Tower and experience the real world, and become part of the footnotes of history along with all the metrics.
new_translation_vi: Annalika đã gọi đó là rác sau khi nhìn vào hồ sơ số liệu của tôi.

source_en: I just can't stand the dirty looks of the Security Administrator anymore. Gotta remember the combination this time. Now it's only the safest to get it written down! Associations, associations... what should I associate it with? The number of the light strips? That should associate immediately! But that's only one digit, what about the other three? Ah, I should just write it down. Then where should I keep this note? I'll just take a glance when I forget. Where is the safest place to keep it?
new_translation_vi: Tôi không thể chịu đựng được những cái nhìn bẩn thỉu của Quản trị viên An ninh nữa. Lần này phải nhớ mật mã. Bây giờ chỉ có cách viết nó ra là an toàn nhất! Liên tưởng, liên tưởng... mình nên liên tưởng nó với cái gì? Số lượng dải đèn? Cái đó nên liên tưởng ngay lập tức! Nhưng đó chỉ là một chữ số, còn ba chữ số kia thì sao? À, mình nên viết nó ra. Vậy mình nên giữ tờ giấy này ở đâu? Mình sẽ chỉ liếc nhìn khi quên. Đâu là nơi an toàn nhất để giữ nó?

source_en: Haha, I bet no one would have known that I keep the combination here. Now the first two digits derive from my birthday: 2 and 4. The third digit is the number of light strips, and the fourth is the number of steps before the Gate! Haha, from now on it takes only one glance if I forget the combination. I will never “forget” anymore. And no dirty looks from the Security Administrator anymore!
new_translation_vi: Haha, tôi cá là không ai biết tôi giữ mật mã ở đây. Bây giờ hai chữ số đầu tiên bắt nguồn từ ngày sinh của tôi: 2 và 4. Chữ số thứ ba là số lượng dải đèn, và thứ tư là số bước trước Cổng! Haha, từ nay về sau chỉ cần liếc một cái nếu tôi quên mật mã. Tôi sẽ không bao giờ "quên" nữa. Và không còn những cái nhìn bẩn thỉu từ Quản trị viên An ninh nữa!

source_en:
Jinzhou is a fortress city on the southeastern border of Huanglong. It is the first land-based port for all foreign ships entering the nation. Foreign personnel and goods must be inspected and offloaded at Port Gunchao. Port Gunchao features a well-established container management system, along with large-scale berthing facilities. It is a comprehensive main hub port and container trunk port with the highest throughput out of any port in Huanglong. Currently, Port Gunchao has reached long-term strategic partnerships with Lollo Logistics and the Pioneer Association. We welcome business cooperation of any form.
Office of Commerce, Port Gunchao
new_translation_vi: Jinzhou là một thành phố pháo đài trên biên giới phía đông nam của Huanglong. Đây là cảng đường bộ đầu tiên cho tất cả các tàu nước ngoài vào quốc gia. Nhân sự và hàng hóa nước ngoài phải được kiểm tra và dỡ hàng tại Cảng Gunchao. Cảng Gunchao có hệ thống quản lý container được thiết lập tốt, cùng với các cơ sở cập bến quy mô lớn. Đây là cảng trung tâm chính toàn diện và cảng trục container với lưu lượng lớn nhất trong bất kỳ cảng nào ở Huanglong. Hiện tại, Cảng Gunchao đã đạt được quan hệ đối tác chiến lược lâu dài với Lollo Logistics và Hiệp Hội Tiên Phong. Chúng tôi hoan nghênh hợp tác kinh doanh dưới mọi hình thức.

source_en: Last month, while taking inventory in the yard, I spotted a spider web. Normally, I would have cleared it but this one was different. Its intricate design drew me in, with expanding polygons that seemed to follow a calculated pattern. It reminded me of a legendary tale - that TDs are attracted to similar frequencies. In that moment, I felt a connection to the spider and its creation. I couldn't bring myself to destroy it, hoping no one else would disturb its beauty. I wonder if the spider and I share a similar frequency?
new_translation_vi: Tháng trước, trong khi kiểm kê trong sân, tôi phát hiện một mạng nhện. Thông thường, tôi sẽ dọn sạch nó nhưng cái này thì khác. Thiết kế phức tạp của nó đã thu hút tôi, với các đa giác mở rộng dường như tuân theo một mô hình được tính toán. Nó nhắc tôi nhớ đến một câu chuyện huyền thoại - rằng các TD bị thu hút bởi các tần số tương tự. Trong khoảnh khắc đó, tôi cảm thấy một sự kết nối với con nhện và sự sáng tạo của nó. Tôi không thể mang mình đi phá hủy nó, hy vọng không ai khác sẽ làm phiền vẻ đẹp của nó. Tôi tự hỏi liệu con nhện và tôi có chia sẻ một tần số tương tự không?

source_en:
Thank you for choosing the expressway. This highway is a direct connection between Port Gunchao, Tiger's Maw Mine, and Jinzhou City. Please confirm your destination. Exiles and Tacet Discords may appear around this section of the expressway. Please be vigilant and drive safely during the transportation of goods.  (Update: Those who intentionally vandalize or damage expressway facilities will be subjected to prosecution!)
Routine Maintenance: Team Seven, Ministry of Development
new_translation_vi: Cảm ơn bạn đã chọn đường cao tốc. Tuyến đường này là kết nối trực tiếp giữa Cảng Gunchao, Mỏ Tiger's Maw và Thành phố Jinzhou. Vui lòng xác nhận điểm đến của bạn. Exiles và Tacet Discords có thể xuất hiện xung quanh đoạn đường cao tốc này. Vui lòng cảnh giác và lái xe an toàn trong quá trình vận chuyển hàng hóa. (Cập nhật: Những người cố tình phá hoại hoặc làm hư hỏng các cơ sở đường cao tốc sẽ bị truy tố!)

source_en:
Field Notes on the Overthrow of the CSC at the AL104 Catastrophe - XIII
Revisiting the field to examine the mystery of the CSC's demise has added no useful information.
There are still very few records of the site remains, Wuthering Waves sub-traces, and survivors' oral accounts ...... put together.
Regardless of the reasoning behind it, the results alone: what happened to mankind's most advanced research facility, I shudder to think of it happening again.
My intuition warns me that this was not a purely natural disaster.
new_translation_vi: Ghi chú thực địa về sự sụp đổ của CSC tại Thảm họa AL104 - XIII

source_en:
Handbook of CSC's Field Trip to AL104 - XVIII
Facility: Monitoring Station
Purpose: Collect and predict Wuthering Waves fluctuations around the first study area.

The CSC machine, which persisted until the last moment, still played a part in the aftermath of the disaster - guiding the residents of Huanglong to safely migrate to the mountains to fulfill its final mission. As a man-made object, it was almost perfect.
new_translation_vi: Sổ tay Chuyến đi thực địa của CSC đến AL104 - XVIII

source_en:
CSC Field Notes on the Overthrow of the AL104 Catastrophe-VII
The simple settlements that were once constructed with military installations were completely depopulated at the time of the Catastrophe.
Today, the environment is still harsh, with frequent fog and some anomalies in the Wuthering Waves subindex.
It seems to be frequently raided by Exiles operating in the vicinity, leaving little in this area.
new_translation_vi: Ghi chú thực địa của CSC về sự sụp đổ của Thảm họa AL104-VII

source_en:
In AL157, the largest TDTD Outbreak in Huanglong's history, the "Giant Wave TD Outbreak", appeared and pushed into Jinzhou's hinterland.
In order to save the homeland on which mankind relies on for survival, all Huanglong troops stood by and defended the last line of defense.
Among them, the Midnight Rangers' vanguard brigade went deep into the core area of the field to carry out a campaign to eliminate the enemy. They sacrificed their lives for The Price to Pay, successfully reversing the passive defense situation on the battlefield and laying the cornerstone for Huanglong's final victory.
This cemetery is dedicated to the memory of the 306 soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the battle of Huanglong TD Outbreak.
                                                                                                                        --From all the people of Huanglong.

Supplementary Announcement: In AL159, after the completion of the cemetery, there were many mourners, and the sound of mourning condensed, causing the surrounding Wuthering Waves to be disorganized, triggering a small Tacet Field Outbreak, and damaging various parts of the Memorial Cemetery to varying degrees. Plans were made to refurbish the site, but the public wanted to keep the remnants in place in order to serve as a wake-up call that the crisis was not to be forgotten.
new_translation_vi: Vào năm AL157, TD Outbreak lớn nhất trong lịch sử của Huanglong, "Giant Wave TD Outbreak", đã xuất hiện và đẩy vào vùng nội địa của Jinzhou.

source_en:
The Dim Forest is unquestionably the most significant treasure trove in the entire Huanglong region, boasting unparalleled species richness in the world.
Upon setting foot at the entrance of this gate, I could distinctly hear the plants whispering and their summons.
It is said that deep within the forest, the former site of the Department of Ecoacoustics holds image records of numerous plants, including a delectable species known as Ivory Banana, originating from the Dim Forest. Ivory Bananas were once a primary food source for Hoochiefs, and, in return, Hoochiefs exploring the forest in search of Ivory Bananas became excellent pollinators.
Since the spread of the toxic spore mist, wild Ivory Bananas have disappeared from the Dim Forest, and information about this species can now only be found in historical records.
The Lament might be an inevitable process of natural selection.
new_translation_vi: Dim Forest chắc chắn là kho tàng vĩ đại nhất trong toàn bộ khu vực Huanglong, sở hữu sự phong phú về loài không nơi nào sánh bằng trên thế giới.

source_en:
Guided by Starflower and the whispering plants, I stumbled upon a magnificent purple-branched arborvitae. The shape of its leaves resembled that of the Ficus genus, but the source of its striking color remains a mystery.
As I approached the tree, a group of fiercely protective female orangutans coiled beneath it, their eyes gleaming with ferocity. To avoid a confrontation, I spent several days collecting their shed hair and fashioned it into a makeshift tunic. With this disguise, I was able to get close enough to collect samples of the leaves.
Unfortunately, due to the season, I was unable to obtain samples of the flowers or fruits, and there were no pollinating insects in sight. This species still holds many secrets waiting to be unveiled.
I've tentatively named it Ficus purpurea and promised to return when the time is right. Farewell for now, my dear Ficus purpurea. Until we meet again and uncover your century-old tale.
new_translation_vi: Được dẫn dắt bởi Starflower và những loài cây thì thầm, tôi tình cờ gặp một cây arborvitae cành tím tráng lệ. Hình dạng lá của nó giống với chi Ficus, nhưng nguồn gốc của màu sắc nổi bật của nó vẫn là một bí ẩn.

source_en:
After bidding farewell to the Violuna Banyan, I proceeded towards the most important target—the Central Banyan.
It's a tree towering into the sky, with a large spore cloud perched at the top, spreading toxic spores with the wind.
Any creature approaching this tree exhibited obvious anxiety and fear—the white toxic spores floated around the Central Banyan, almost blocking out my sight. I could even hear faint coughing from the forest. I needed to take every step with extreme caution from now on.
The closer I got to the Central Banyan, the more uneasy I felt—there was a heavy snorting coming from its hollow, and the vibrations caused by breathing shook off the spores accumulated on the branches. As more and more spores fell down, I tightened my filter.
These creations of the Waveworn Phenomenon are infiltrating our world, making everything dangerous and unfamiliar.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi tạm biệt Violuna Banyan, tôi tiến về phía mục tiêu quan trọng nhất—Central Banyan.

source_en:
It's been a while since I had such an intense workout.

The contaminated Hoochief exhibited an astonishing lack of fatigue in their relentless pursuit of its prey—unfortunately, that prey was me. However, when escaping, I didn't feel panic and my brain started racing. I was well aware that the toxic spores are a direct consequence of the Waveworm Phenomenon. Based on the Ecoacoustics standards, how should we classify those contaminated Hoochiefs? Furthermore, how do those toxic spores contaminate Tacet Discords and is meditation a viable solution for Tacet Discords contamination?

Utilizing the Grapple function, I skillfully swung onto a hidden branch. The contaminated Hoochief lost track of its target and scanned around in confusion. It looked like a lost kid, whimpering and coughing, and it seemed to lose spatial perception. Each intense cough released a burst of toxic spores into the air. The spores, driven by their innate instinct to propagate, further pushed the already weakend body of the Hoochief to its utmost limit.

I started wondering: is it a form of co-evolution, or does it represent a parasitic relationship?
new_translation_vi: Đã lâu rồi tôi mới có một buổi tập luyện cường độ cao như vậy.

source_en:
The environment of the Secluded Forbidden Forest was even more magical than imagined. A unique canopy ecosystem has formed around the branches of this giant tree.
 According to my research, the tree's branches contain an abundance of Resonance Energy, which is pooled from all around the Dim Forest area and travels from the top of the tree to the entire trunk. This energy catalyzes the formation of this massive tree. And it is through this energy that a whole different ecosystem thrives in the tree. Possibly because of the ferocious roars that come from within the tree from time to time, the tree shows no signs of large Mutant Organism with TD activity. This gives the plants a better chance to thrive and allows the Reverberation creature Mutterfly to exist.
 The Resonator who made this giant tree is very similar to my Forte force. I'm sure he's a nature lover too. Otherwise it would be unlikely to create such a large and complex giant tree even with the added assistance of the Sound Emulator at the top of the tree.
 In order to facilitate future expeditions, I made a small fluorescent decoration on the branches of the Claustrophobic Forbidden Forest as a signpost. This will make future scientific expeditions more efficient. Then it was time to set off and explore the depths of the Claustrophobic Forbidden Forest!
new_translation_vi: Môi trường của Secluded Forbidden Forest thậm chí còn kỳ diệu hơn tưởng tượng. Một hệ sinh thái tán cây độc đáo đã hình thành xung quanh các cành của cái cây khổng lồ này.

source_en:
Verina: However, the majority of species in the area are at risk, including Ficus purpurea in the Conservation Area which is nearly extinct and requires urgent conservation measures to be preserved in captivity.
Verina: Also... 
[Hoochief's squeak—] 
Verina: Bad Hoochief! Bad! That's not your food!
[Hoochief's squeak—] 
Verina: Stop right there—
new_translation_vi: Verina: Tuy nhiên, phần lớn các loài trong khu vực đang gặp rủi ro, bao gồm Ficus purpurea trong Khu Bảo tồn gần như tuyệt chủng và đòi hỏi các biện pháp bảo tồn khẩn cấp để được bảo tồn trong điều kiện nuôi nhốt.

source_en:
Welcome to the Wetland Nature Park, a scenic spot built around a wetland, which is an important stopover and habitat for migratory birds, with tens of thousands of migratory birds overwintering here every year, and where the best bird-watching season is from October of the current year to March of the following year.
Two special birds are the local star species, also known collectively as feathered herons. They are large wading birds with a docile character, not only amicable and helpful among family members, but also willing to get close to humans, always maintaining a precious sense of trust in them.
Therefore, the scenic spot implores all tourists, please do not feed the feathered heron, if you want to contribute to the protection of the population of feathered heron, welcome to contact the rescue station.

source_en: A painting about a family playing together looks very cozy. Written on the back of the painting is the phrase, "I hid the treasure, in the painting!" The brushstrokes are crooked and childish, but sincere enough.

source_en:
To whoever reads this,
I hope someone still remembers me and has the painting I'm looking for. My son drew it years ago, and it captured the beauty of our once peaceful home. Back then, we used to come here often to admire the bridge and the garden full of colorful flowers. My son loved playing among them, watching the riders pass by with their heroic determination to deliver supplies while dodging the burning flowers that grew too fast.
But now, the bridge is broken, and our side is no longer safe. I had to send my wife and son away to find shelter while I stay behind as a rider, risking my life to prevent the fire from spreading further. I may not be much of a man, but I want to be a hero in my son's eyes.
I've also enclosed some dried flowers that I planted myself. They won't catch on fire like the others, and if I survive, I hope to see this place restored to its former beauty without fear of fire. But if something happens to me, please know that I am proud of what I have done and wish for you all to live in peace and see these mountains flourish with safe and beautiful flowers again.
Thank you for taking the time to read this letter. My thoughts will be with you and this place until we meet again.

source_en:
This is the location where the last trace of the research team was left at the time. We conducted a large-scale Sensor in the neighborhood and found some stray Acoustic Print.
Preliminary analysis of the Acoustic Print composition. It was found that part of it had been left for a long time and was already blurred, while the other part was very new. Could someone else have been here recently? We'll have to wait for further analysis before we can draw any conclusions.
......
According to the results of the detailed analysis of Acoustic Print, the composition of the old Acoustic Print was very mixed, with not only those researchers at that time, but also a large number of traces of TD's activities. With the number and average strength of the research team against a TD of this scale, they were afraid that not all of them had disappeared, but had been martyred in the line of duty.
Although the new Acoustic Print is much clearer, there is unknown interference that prevents it from being accurately recognized, but judging from the comparison results, they should all come from the same person, and the time span is quite large, and it seems that this person came here many times after the accident. A similar frequency was also found in the old Acoustic Print, and it is speculated that he may be the only survivor in the research team. Not only did the survivor not report the accident, but he also came back here repeatedly, so what exactly was the purpose?
......
Tacet Field has been unusually active lately, always feeling unsettled, as if something is about to happen ......

source_en:
March 23rd.
I still can't accept ...... them, so many people, all because of me ......
I heard that the former couple had a daughter and that child is now an orphan. A whole family ...... It's all ruined because of me!
No ...... this won't work ...... I should go find that girl, or at least not let her grow up alone. I can't let myself carry more sins.
......
May 12
A lot has happened lately. I was worried that an official investigation would come after me, but then suddenly TD Outbreak broke out and the investigation was closed. Hurray!
Kyauk is a smart girl, the only thing she's not smart about is that she trusts me too much. When I said I was her distant uncle, she believed me and was very close to me.
I thought taking care of Kyaw Kyaw could alleviate my guilt, but I didn't realize that the more she trusted me, the more guilty I felt. After paying so much The Price to Pay, not only did I fail to get the secret treasure, but I was also immersed in guilt the whole day, Yu Kuo Xing ah Yu Kuo Xing, what kind of thing have you lived into?
......
(The date data further back seems to be corrupted, only some intermittent statements.)
......
I went back to the research camp to look at it, but because of the TD Outbreak rampage, the terrain in that neighborhood has shifted a bit and it's hard to find the entrance from back then. It's been so long in the past that I can't recall the exact location.
......
I'm getting more and more unable to face Kyaw Kyaw, she can already take care of herself, or just let her think I'm missing.
......
I paid so much The Price to Pay, how can I get nothing? I am not willing, not willing ah!

source_en:
Date: [--02]
The C.V. laboratory is located in an abandoned site within Whining Aix's Mire. The main structure was built using a special material developed by C.V., which prevented severe weathering and corrosion. As a result, the building remained relatively intact. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the base level of the site for an artificial Tacet Field.
A few mechanical instrument abandoned by C.V. are left at the experiment environment. Outside the environment, a low-frequency lighting system was installed at a regulated distance and angle, ensuring permanent illumination of the experiment area.
The experimental environment center is composed of multiple bundled cables that secure a spherical metal device. The cables transmit the input and output data from within the metal device. Surrounding the spherical device are frequency detection instruments of the same specifications. These instruments are typically controlled by dials. When the dial is rotated clockwise, the electrical energy will drive the composite metal frame to rotate in a high angular speed clockwise around the central device for synchronizd frequency detection.

source_en:
Experimental Environment:
Experiment Number A038 is assigned a 6m x 6m x 6m artificial controllable Tacet Field. Environmental checks for the artificial Tacet Field are required every 6 hours.
To avoid impacting the subject, experiment personnel entering the designated area are prohibited from bringing in devices and tools incompatible with the standard specifications.

Detailed Record:
Initial observations confirm that A038 Tacet Discord, born in the artificial Tacet Field, can survive stably.
Subject has yet to exhibit specific physical features or simulate vocal behaviors. It lacks a physical form and can only be observed through specialized means.
Currently, A038 shows no clear behavioral objectives: mostly in a stationary state with low aggression and activity.
Due to significant deviations from expectations, further research is necessary.
Note: High sensitivity to frequency observed. Strict control of the standard frequency specifications in the experimental area is required.

Due to the unique nature of A038, we need more time to re-establish corresponding parameters and data language to gain deeper insight of its information. Considering our current technology and correlated data, this process will take a considerable amount of time.

Warning: Leakage of experimental information through any means is strictly prohibited.
Taking photos or recordings of subject without Professor Heisen's permission is strictly forbidden.

That concludes the records of initial observations.
To obtain more information on subject, future experiments and analyses are necessary.

source_en:
Date: [--25]
We have succeeded. The TD numbered A038 has survived the artificial Tacet Field. Though the outcome may be somewhat underwhelming, now is not the time for nitpicking.
The days on duty are so unbearable. I have to stare at this dark mass all night long. It neither moves nor makes a sound, making the nights even more tedious than my stern supervisor. To maintain stability in the Tacet Field, Professor Heisen had removed all the clocks. Sigh, every minute and second feels like eternity. The usually amiable Professor Heisen is unexpectedly strict this time. Since the experiment began, I had hardly seen him smile. By the way, a researcher had accidentally brought a tool with a frequency exceeding the standard into the experiment environment last time, causing a huge commotion. The entire research site sounded the alarm. Fortunately, the Tacet Field and A038 seemed unaffected. However, the size of that mass seemed to have increased slightly. I don't think it made any difference. However, it was the first time I saw Professor Heisen angry.
Alright, I should stop here for today. There are still many issues to resolve. All the parameters and data language established lately have to be typed out manually, and everyone is working around the clock, though none complains. After all, without overwork, where else can we geniuses and maniacs go?

source_en:
Date: [--08]
The experiment has reached its final stage, but it seems that everyone has become lazy. More and more colleagues suddenly disappear without a trace. Professor Heisen said some of them took leave to spend time with their families, while others decided to take a long vacation before returning. This is completely unlike their usual way. Previously, everyone was so engrossed in the research that they didn't even have time to sleep. Sigh, forget it. It's rare to have such tranquility. In these long nights, only this dark mass accompanies me. I don't know when you grew so big and started moving around. So many mechanical parts and metal chunks have appeared on you. Is that a diesel engine? I feel like I've seen it somewhere before...
Hm? I don’t quite feel like myself today. The body feels so faint it seems a bag of water, not mine.
You seem extraordinarily lively today, don't you? I never expected to see this side of you. It's not something I've seen in our previous encounters. This must be a new discovery. Let me jot it down in my personal memo.
The black spherical object split open, revealing a hidden assortment of items within. Steel plates, gears, clocks, giant drill bits, detectors, spotlights, blue liquid, surgical forceps, thick books, white lab coats, melted candies, adorable cats, electronic displays, and even substances resembling human bodies.
All things from the experiment site. I get it now, that diesel engine is something from the site, too.
Are you giggling? I haven’t heard you making sounds before, but it feels kind of familiar, like one of my colleagues.
My body and my mind feel just...

source_en:
Ma Cui: Mr. Painter, can you tell me about this painting?
Painter: It is a farewell gift for you, Mr. Ma, for when you pass away.
Ma Cui: Ha ha ha! You always have such unique ideas.
Painter: I thought it might make you angry.
Ma Cui: My temper has improved since my daughter came into my life.
Painter: She seems quite gentle and kind.
Ma Cui: That's not true. She's always been courageous.
Painter: She doesn't like her given name, Ma Xiaofang.
Ma Cui: And what does that mean to you?
Painter: That she may struggle with facing herself.
Ma Cui: It's not easy to confront our own weaknesses. But I know my child. She will become the bravest of heroes.
Painter: What if she had the chance to save you but failed because of her fears?
Ma Cui: ...
Ma Cui: Mr. Painter, are you being serious?
Painter: Absolutely.
Ma Cui: In that case, I would be honored to witness your exceptional fortune telling skills. But I believe you are mistaken about my daughter.
Painter: About her fate?
Ma Cui: No, about her character.
Ma Cui: If such a moment were to arise, then my passing will mark the beginning of her heroic journey.
Painter: Why do you say that?
Ma Cui: Because I know my child, and one day she will prove to be the bravest of heroes.
Painter: Mr. Ma, you are certainly an interesting man... Let us wait and see what unfolds.

source_en:
May 10th - This was our first mission with the advance squad, and I naively thought the Wuthering Waves weather was just normal. But it was far worse than I could have imagined.

May 11th - We were sent to Norfall Barrens to investigate Threnodian Crownless energy, but the Wuthering Waves only made things more difficult. The constant rain blurred our vision and we could barely see where we were going. General Jiyan gave us a potion to block out the strange whispers we heard in the weather.

May 13th - Our team was starting to feel overwhelmed as members fell one by one. For the first time, the idea of retreating crossed my mind. Thankfully General Jiyan recognized our distress and allowed us to rest in some ruins for the night. We found a book of jokes that helped ease our tensions, but General Jiyan still seemed worried.

May 20th - Wuthering Waves concentrations were no longer important because all data was meaningless. We were suffocating in this environment, and in our latest battle, everyone died except for me and General Jiyan. He sacrificed himself to save me from the TD army. I couldn't do anything but watch as he fought alone, his star mark flickering from overuse of his Resonator powers. I begged for help while hiding behind him, not wanting to die. In the end, General Jiyan half-knelt in the ruins while his lance stood tall, saving my life.

source_en:
Operation number: D12547
Action Team: "Gray Eagle"
Time of Operation: □□□□□□□□
Target: Feilian Beringal

The following is my action diary:

Just after arriving at the large east-facing Gate in Dim Forest at midday, the entire party was ambushed. We were attacked by deranged Hoochiefs that squealed and bit into our compatriots, and I heard screams from all sides. Fearing that bullets might accidentally injure our companions, we all resisted with only daggers and other weapons.
The regimental commander ordered the troops to split into three groups for temporary shelter, and I was placed in the group the commander was in. It was late at night when we arrived at the originally intended battle point, and we were all exhausted, yet no one was able to sleep. Soon we heard the cries of the Hoochief again from outside, these guys were endless and the soldiers had run out of ammunition. Having lost the means of resistance, the chief ordered the cave to be closed off using bombs, however the Hoochiefs still rushed in before the bombs exploded, and when the chief died with the last Hoochief, the bombs also got detonated and the cave was sealed off completely.
The signal with Huanglong was cut off and we couldn't contact the rest of the team. Trapped in the cave, we were gradually weakening, when I found a hidden hard disk in a collapsed hole next to us. Upon parsing it, I realized that it was actually information left over from the wartime institute's research, which recorded information about a laboratory hidden in Huanglong. I would also like to request that whoever finds this diary go there to prevent something like today from happening again.

&&&& (12587, 46899)

source_en:
[Entry]  
Tacet Discord  

[Known Types]  
Whisperin, Howler, Tranquilite, Clamorling, Staticoid
 
[Overview] 
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords. 
These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy. Despite extensive study, our understanding remains incomplete due to a lack of information on their composition. 
As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords. To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

[Appendix: Echoes] 
Upon its demise, the frequencies of a Tacet Discord will not immediately vanish. Instead, they will slowly decay over time, allowing for their capture and utilization. 
Once enough frequencies have been stored, they can be harnessed to replicate the abilities of the original Tacet Discord. 
This remaining energy, capable of emulating the defeated entity's power, is known as an Echo — a valuable asset that must be carefully collected and preserved in our laboratory archives.

[Introduction]  

Huaxu Academy, a renowned scientific research center in Jinzhou, boasts a rich academic heritage and cutting-edge technology. 
As a branch of Huanglong Huaxu Academy, it has produced numerous groundbreaking research results due to its focus on advancing science and technology in the face of the ongoing war against Tacet Discord. 
The academy maintains a high level of independence in its research pursuits, while also actively engaging in academic exchanges with other institutions within Huanglong and beyond. In fact, it was once a key collaborator of the Court of Savantae. Comprised of four primary departments, each with its own specialized functions, Huaxu Academy conducts parallel and cooperative research initiatives. 
Ad hoc project teams are also formed to tackle major challenges as they arise. While the president oversees administrative affairs, the Principal Investigator serves as the academic leader of the academy.


[Departments]  

Department of Anomaly Studies:  
The Department of Anomaly Studies researches and analyzes abnormal occurrences, constructs theories based on these events, and devises preventative measures. This includes the Resonance Beacon network model and Wutherological Climate studies in Jinzhou.
Main Disciplines: Wutherology, Remnant Ecoacoustics.  

Department of Laboratory Evaluation: 
The Department of Laboratory Evaluation analyzes and simulates anomalies using different theories to find optimal solutions. They also design the internal structure of Resonance Beacon and Terminal for effective use.
Main Disciplines: -

Department of Safety: 
The Department of Safety researches and supports the elimination of Tacet Discord. They design models of the Tacetite Weapon for the Resonator and create countermeasure equipment for civilians.
Main Disciplines: TD Ecoacoustics, Resonology.  

Department of Resources:  
The Department of Resources primarily studies Waveworn substances, processes field materials for research samples, and contributes to the Department of Laboratory Evaluation and Safety.
Main Disciplines: Wuthermaterials, TD Ecoacoustics, Plant Ecoacoustics.

In the lower left corner, among numerous stone tablets, stands one that remains remarkably intact despite the passage of time and elements. It recounts the founding history of Jinzhou.
"The armies are poised for destruction as the black moon eclipses the sun…" 
"…In the midst of battle, a golden-eyed visitor appears in the hazy sky. Our troops raise their blades in anticipation, while the jade dragon soars overhead…" 
"…But even as they long for home, these conscripts do not falter in defending their land. And thus, in this world of strategic passes, Jinzhou was built and this monument erected to forever remember this momentous event…"

source_en:
Jun 19
Today, a strange man came to our village. He said to call him brother, if I didn't mind. He was really friendly, but for some reason, he seemed different from the people in my village. He seemed to know a lot about me, even telling me that we were "of the same kind." 
He told me a really strange fairy tale. The ending of the fairy tale was kind of scary... but reality was even scarier, he said. He then asked: "What would you do if you were the little black lamb?" 
Before I could think of a reply, he had already left with a cryptic "See you next time." 
I told father about it, but he said no one like that had ever visited our village... 
Who could he be?
...
Jul 20
Sorry... I'm so sorry... (smudged water stains) 
If only I weren't so weak, I could've driven away those Tacet Discords... If Sissi didn't have to protect me...
There must be a way. Father said I can manipulate the frequencies of Tacet Discords... and humans.
Sissi, I'm so sorry you look like this now... It is only temporary. I'll do everything I can to return you to what you were before. I know you can still hear me.
Father promised me. He'll surely find a way to help.
...
Dec 17
It's been three months since that incident. Father doesn't seem to remember I'm still keeping a diary... He gave the notebook to me, but if he found out I'd been writing about everything, he'd be so mad.
He orders me to do what he says and use my powers to recombine frequencies of Tacet Discords.
But if anyone finds out about the truth — that Sissi, who went missing, actually died trying to protect me, and then I turned her into a horrifying Tacet Discord...
They will see me as a monster. I will be banished, and no one will ever understand or accept me with what I can do... No one... except Him.
But will the dead really come back through frequency manipulation? And if so, what would happen to their shattered souls, trapped inside their new bodies?
I really don't know...
...
Feb 8
Every day, I feel more and more uneasy. The people in the village are disappearing, and those Tacet Discords father has brought back...
I can't shake the feeling that something is very wrong. But I am trapped, like a moth to a flame, unable to escape this dark path.
I don't know what my father did... It must have been something terrible for the tension and unease here. I am not allowed outside anymore, and when I ask why, he just brushes it off.
If the price for my wish to come true is more bloodshed... I...
...
(No date)
The villagers have surrounded our house. They must have learned about it all.
The murderer... is that what they call me now? Or perhaps my father, too? At this point, what difference does it make?
After all that has happened... Can someone come and save me?
If I must pay the price for Qichi Village...
If there is a god... I hope they can...
Save my village...

(At the end of the last diary entry, you see a message in another handwriting.)
"It seems you are the luckier one."

Abstract: 

NovaFei is an acute infectious disease with no effective treatment, primarily affecting children under six years old. It is highly contagious with severe symptoms including fever, limb pain, and muscle atrophy. To combat this disease, a live attenuated vaccine has been developed and successfully passed phase III clinical trials on <color=#ffd12f>June 16 at 3:00 p.m. </color>. The Medical Section established a specialized team for this vaccine's development. This review aims to analyze the progress of the vaccine research and provide valuable insights for further studies. Results have shown promising immunization outcomes, making this vaccine a potential solution for preventing NovaFei infection.

1. Preliminary application of a neutralizing antibody detection method for NovaFei pseudovirus
2. Efficacy of live attenuated vaccine against NovaFei pseudovirus via injection
3. Clinical trial report of oral administration of "Sugar Pearl" live attenuated vaccine against NovaFei pseudovirus

... 

Appendix 1: Clinical Trial Participant Registration Records (i) 

Registration No.: CTR302001 

Name: Xiangli Yan
Gender: Female 
Age: 29 
Condition: Healthy, no hereditary diseases. 
Trial Stage: Phase I Clinical Trial 

Registry number: CTR302002 

Name: Xiangli Yao 
Gender: male 
Age: 7 months 
Condition: Healthy, no hereditary diseases.
Trial Stage: Phase I Clinical Trial 

... 

Message from Section Member: Mrs. Xiangli... Is it really okay? 
Response: Someone has to test it. I'm willing to test it on myself... and my son.

Related Report Entries: 
<color=#ffd12f>NovaFei Fever Cases Surpass 2,000 with Death Toll Rising in April; 
Huaxu Academy Forms Vaccine Research Group Under P.I. Xiangli's Leadership; 
Jinzhou TD Outbreak Paralyzes Transportation and Medical Supply Distribution</color>

Title: Oral NovaFei Fever Vaccine, Live Attenuated Mass Production Quality Standards and Transportation Overview of "Sugar Pearl" 
Reporting Officer: Medical Officer III, Huaxu Academy 
Report No.: MD-E0510 

Abstract:

This report details the importance of delivering Huanglong's medical supplies to Jinzhou, which served as the front line of defense against TD Outbreak. The Midnight Rangers valiantly defended the city from the fierce outbreak, but due to transportation line blockages, the second-generation Sugar Pearl vaccine - known for its stability and suitability for children - faced challenges in reaching the city. This report outlines the quality standards for mass production and transportation of the vaccine and other medical supplies during the war, with a focus on ensuring their efficacy and safety. The innovative use of the more stable second-generation vaccine played a crucial role in protecting the citizens of Jinzhou from TD Outbreak, making it a valuable contribution to the battle against this deadly disease.

1. Quality Standards for Mass Production of Vaccines
2. Management Guidelines for Storage and Transportation of Vaccines
3. Assessment of Current Vaccine Transportation Methods

The transportation of the second-generation Sugar Pearl vaccine is a critical step in combating the TD Outbreak. In response to the challenges posed by interrupted main transportation routes and the treacherous terrain, a thorough plan was implemented. Refrigerated trucks equipped with temperature-monitoring equipment were used, accompanied by professional technicians to ensure proper storage and transport conditions. Additionally, due to the severity of the epidemic and the time sensitivity of vaccine delivery, medical supplies were divided into seven teams for transportation. Welcome to the digital documentation of SR-461's classified manual. Only members of our top-secret organization have access to this interface, so if you're not one of us, scram before we track you down.

Now, for my fellow members, let's get down to business. As outlined in Article 1, it is crucial to differentiate between Suppressor 1 and Suppressor 2. Mixing them up could lead to disastrous consequences. We don't want that, do we?

Moving on to Article 2 - surprise, there are three suppressors in total! And they all need monthly check-ups and maintenance. Don't forget to download your keys from the main console before you head over to inspect and update their logs.

But hold your horses, folks. Before you start celebrating with sugary carbonated beverages, know that these activities will be recorded and could disqualify you from the end-of-the-month raffle event. Yes, even the daily intake of smelly rice noodles in the conference room is a no-go. No amount of aromatic reagents can cover up that stench.

And speaking of stench, let's talk about puns and dad jokes. We all love them (or pretend not to), but too much can be a nuisance for everyone else. That's why anyone caught making puns or cracking corny jokes will have to suffer through a week's worth as punishment. Just try not to repeat them — that's just unforgivable.

Lastly, remember that this manual can only be adjusted three times per quarter. Any additional changes will have to wait until the next quarter.

So there you have it, folks. The 21 articles carefully crafted by the brilliant minds of SR-461. Let's all abide by them and avoid any unpleasant consequences.

Archive: Resonance Evaluation Report on “the First Resonator”
Time of Evaluation: <color=#ffd12f>Year of Wei, AL ████</color>
Resonator Name: REDACTED
[Resonance Assessment RA1001-G] 

[Resonance Evaluation Report] 
Resonator ████ reports amnesia regarding their resonance ability, with no clear time of awakening. A Tacet Mark is present on their right hand. No visible Post-Awakening physical alterations. Their Tacet Mark and pupils display a golden halo when they exert their Forte. Resonance Spectrum tests show strong Syntony with multiple patterns, but the cause of Resonator ████'s Awakening remains inconclusive. Further examination is needed to determine the origin of their resonance abilities.
Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a noticeable periodic waveform, which classifies ████ as a Congenital Resonator.

[Overclock Diagnostic Report] 
Resonator ████'s waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable with no abnormal waveforms. Examination results are determined to be within normal parameters, and ████ bears no risk of Overclocking.
During the Battle of Gorges of Spirits, a Resonator engaged in combat with an unidentified Tacet Discord ("the Crownless"), resulting in a high-risk victory and resolution of the crisis. The morale of the army was boosted and they achieved invincibility. Three days later, the battle concluded in triumph, with soldiers reporting seeing the Resonator standing next to "Jué". This event marked the founding of Jinzhou in that same year.

Attachment: Jinzhou Foundation Ceremony (REDACTED)

Data loss must be addressed before next database maintenance to prevent further issues.

Entry No. 14
1. Status of suppression device: Reactivated. Functions, normal. Rate of fog suppression continues to decline.
2. Data analysis and additional notes: Recent suppression results, unsatisfactory. Assuming the effectiveness of the suppression device remains constant, I can only infer that the increase of energy intensity within the fog's source is present.
Test results have revealed that the fog carries energy of similar frequency, as detected in the mud-like substance found within the marsh. I can confirm with high confidence that these phenomena are derived from a unique and unified source in this area.
In addition, it has been observed that <color=Highlight>the Mourning Aix performed repeated entries into the fog carrying reactants of high energy intensity</color>. Followed by <color=Highlight>a plummet in the efficiency of the suppression device</color> after its departure. I believe that Mourning Aix correlates with the source.
However, I am puzzled to find that <color=Highlight>the Mourning Aix's vital signs</color> weakened each time it departed from the fog. Lacking data... Further observations needed.
Recorder: Shi'er, SR-461

source_en:
Entry No. 18
1. Status of suppression device: Reactivated. Functions, overloading. Rate of fog suppression only at 34.265%.

2. Data analysis and additional notes: Recent suppression results, unsatisfactory. Suppression rate continues to decrease. If the power of the suppression device is not further amplified, it is only a matter of time before we lose suppression effectiveness and experience a further spread of the fog.

However, considering that the effectiveness of the suppression device has already received two increased adjustments, as well as the changing of the fog's intensity from weak to strong, further increase would only result... It feels as if the fog's source has engaged in a match of tug of war with us. 

No, this isn't possible. Judging from the frequency band drawn, there are no large life forms within the fog area, but... Is it really possible? Must a life form be identified by humans? We have been unsuccessful in making actual contact with the source of the fog up till this day, thus we cannot completely rule out the existence of human intelligence.

In addition, I have read Shi'er's log (not that I wanted to. It was only because he came looking for me), and I believe that additional manpower and equipment should be allocated to further survey the movements of the Mourning Aix.

I have not witnessed the creature's behaviors inside the fog area like Shi'er did, yet I have seen it perform frequent circles and landings within proximity of the deceased avian Tacet Discord. It still possesses longings for the avian Tacet Discord and has lost its sanity because of it.

Similarly, I still hold the speculation that avian Tacet Discord bears human emotions and human intelligence.

Normally, we would be led to believe that the harmony between the two Tacet Discord is nothing more than a simulation of some form of biological behavior. Yet I have witnessed... During the Tacet Discord Outbreak, one of the creatures dragged its dying partner to safety as it let out a mournful cry toward humans.

It gave a shrilling cry as it kneeled down seeking the humans for help. At that moment, I seemed to have seen its "soul", one that is no different from a human (I am aware that this is an emotional expression inappropriate to this recording, but I insisted on its inclusion.).

Recorder: Qiqi, SR-461

source_en:
When we speak about the concept of "love", we often analyze it from a psychological perspective and conclude it is an emotional motivation. When analyzed from a biological perspective, it is due to the secretion of hormones. However, all are conducted from the perspective of human beings themselves, without any exception. The love between animals or other creatures, on the other hand, seems to be less complex and sophisticated, and more inclined to biological instinct, reproduction, companionship, and courtship, as they do not possess any form of human intelligence.
Now, what of those two Tacet Discords? As entities that carry information and embody energy, are they forbidden to garner the instinct to "love"? Do they sing and cry as the information they carry is love mimicked from humans? Or is it due to the self-consciousness that prompts such actions on their own from a certain cause?
We have no way of knowing for certain. But as you have found out yourself, the question returns to its roots: What is the true meaning of "love"?
From a researcher's point of view, I would perhaps say that "love" itself is merely unique information in the form of energy. An afterglow of the Big Bang. And we are all just carriers who are fortunate enough to carry it. It is just that different carriers produce varying interpretations, and the difference between us and the creatures in love lies precisely in ourselves.
Thus I will not be left in sorrow due to farewell, as I was able to convey this information owing to our meeting.
You have materialized the love inside my body, transforming me into a much-perfected individual.

July 4
The citywide alarm blared incessantly throughout the day, sounding three to four times. Yōu was so frightened that she clung to me tightly, refusing to let go. I felt powerless in comforting her, so I held her even tighter.
We're leaving tomorrow, and I hope everything can go smoothly, allowing Yōu to get a restful night's sleep.

source_en:
July 5
The platform was swarming with people. All in chaos. I was overcome with fear of being separated from Yōu, so I abandoned one of our bags and hold onto Yōu's hand tightly. Thankfully, we successfully boarded the train.
There was a foul smell inside the carriage, as if something was rotting. The lights flickered on and off and the door was broken as well, almost trapping a young man's arm. I wondered if a broken train like this could truly lead us to safety.

July 9
Today marked the fifth day since the collapse. I feared it might be my last, but then a young man discovered an unburied cave. It offered us air and protection from the falling rocks and bitter cold. We took turns searching for food and water in the carriages. Perhaps we can make it through...

source_en:
Dates don't mean anything to me anymore. Only I and a young man survive. Why am I keeping this diary? I don't know. Maybe someone will discover my diary someday? But what good will it do?
The young man mentioned that the rock wall here seems thinner, suggesting that if we tried to dig together, we might find a way out. However, he's currently leaning against the rock wall, his eyes tightly shut, and he hasn't moved for hours.
I lack the courage to check his breathing. I feel terrible. My body is burning up, and my head is aching as if it's about to explode. I keep hearing Yōu's voice. Perhaps she's here to relieve me from all this pain.

source_en:
Dated: [--25]
The rain in the lab lasts much longer than outside... Falling for a good four years, eleven months, and two days since.
The impact of witnessing the "Suspension" for the first time is gradually overshadowed by overwhelming despair. Disappointment and frustration spread in the lab like moss, resilient and unavoidable. Working in this damp environment is a kind of torture both physically and mentally.

Research on the Retroact Rain has entered its second phase, yet contrary to expectations, there's been no progress whatsoever. Perhaps everyone, including Professor Heisen, has questioned if we're doing it wrong. But all evidence points to the fact that "it" has indeed visited the Whining Aix's Mire. That's one of the reasons we moved here.

What we pursue is merely to use the Retroact Rain to relive the "miracle" and seek enlightment. Despite exhaustion, doubts, and countless arguments, we must continue the research. However, time is not on our side. Eventually, we decided to transition to the "Plan B".

Is it a worthwhile choice? Hard to say. Professor Heisen said the risks are high, but success could bring us closer to the answers. Yet, we've failed 37 times. 37 lives lost in the process. Finally, the subject named A038 survives. It's a huge breakthrough, but not many were excited, because we all knew it was a replica... nothing more than an absurd imitation of "God".

Night shifts are tough. Due to understaffing, I'm the sole one on duty. All night, observing this invisible stuff who is unable to speak or move. It's more boring than staring at my tutor's face. And to maintain the stability of the Tacet Field, all clocks were removed. Every minute feels unbelievably long...

Professor Heisen, once kind, has become particularly strict this time. Since the experiment started, he hasn't smiled at all. Speaking of which, a researcher once brought above-standard tools into the experimental area, triggering alarms throughout the lab. Fortunately, neither the Tacet Field nor A038 seemed affected, but for some reason, A038 feels a bit larger. By the way, that was the first time I'd ever seen Professor Heisen lose his temper.

Let's call it a day. There are still some issues, and I need to manually input the reconfirmed parameters and data. We were all insanely busy. Despite the workload, no one complained. After all, we have nowhere else to go but here. 
It's time to feed frequency again? And seriously, I think we've been feeding it too many things. Anyway, it's Professor Heisen's order, so maybe it's best to just follow it...
