And to maintain the stability of the Tacet Field, all clocks were removed. Every minute feels unbelievably long...

Professor Heisen, once kind, has become particularly strict this time. Since the experiment started, he hasn't smiled at all. Speaking of which, a researcher once brought above-standard tools into the experimental area, triggering alarms throughout the lab. Fortunately, neither the Tacet Field nor A038 seemed affected, but for some reason, A038 feels a bit larger. By the way, that was the first time I'd ever seen Professor Heisen lose his temper.

Let's call it a day. There are still some issues, and I need to manually input the reconfirmed parameters and data. We were all insanely busy. Despite the workload, no one complained. After all, we have nowhere else to go but here. 
It's time to feed frequency again? And seriously, I think we've been feeding it too many things. Anyway, it's Professor Heisen's order, so maybe it's best to just follow it...

source_en:
Solitary visitor in Jinzhou,
Feeling weighed down by the burdens of the past that you cannot share? Is there someone beloved you wish to see again?
We, the Séance Society, understand your pain, as we all carry regrets of lost loved ones. Join us. We offer a solution. 
(Coordinates shared)
new_translation_vi:
Vị khách đơn độc tại Jinzhou,
Bạn đang cảm thấy nặng nề vì những gánh nặng của quá khứ mà chẳng thể sẻ chia cùng ai? Có người thân yêu nào mà bạn hằng mong được gặp lại không?
Chúng tôi, Hội Séance, thấu hiểu nỗi đau của bạn, bởi tất cả chúng tôi đều mang trong mình sự hối tiếc về những người thân đã mất. Hãy tham gia cùng chúng tôi. Chúng tôi có giải pháp cho bạn.
(Tọa độ đã được chia sẻ)

source_en: As I grow old and reflect on my life, I am haunted by the regret of not fulfilling a legend someone once told me. They said that if the most important person in your life is willing to fulfill this legend, your relationship will be blessed by the heavens until death do you part. I missed my chance and have always felt like we were just passing through each other's lives. But now, as I face my impending death with only regrets, I feel compelled to find the place where we promised to meet and fulfill the legend. Even though it may be too late for me, I hope this notice can reach young people who still have a chance to hold onto their loved ones. So please, kind lady at the Pioneer Association, share this unknown legend and perhaps someone can finally solve its mystery. Under the crescent moon, we roam On a screen court, stars dance and moan Timeless, by this heart-shaped lake Together, hand in hand we take Starry-eyed, our love shall never break.
new_translation_vi: Khi đã già và nhìn lại cuộc đời mình, tôi luôn bị ám ảnh bởi sự hối tiếc vì đã không hoàn thành một truyền thuyết mà ai đó từng kể. Họ nói rằng, nếu người quan trọng nhất trong đời bạn sẵn lòng cùng thực hiện truyền thuyết này, mối quan hệ của hai người sẽ được thiên đường ban phước cho đến tận lúc lìa xa. Tôi đã bỏ lỡ cơ hội đó và luôn cảm thấy chúng tôi chỉ là những người khách qua đường trong cuộc đời nhau. Nhưng giờ đây, khi đối mặt với cái chết cận kề cùng bao nỗi niềm, tôi cảm thấy thôi thúc phải tìm đến nơi chúng tôi từng hứa hẹn gặp nhau để hoàn thành truyền thuyết ấy. Dẫu có lẽ đã quá muộn với tôi, tôi hy vọng thông báo này có thể đến được với những người trẻ vẫn còn cơ hội nắm giữ lấy người mình yêu thương. Vì vậy, xin hãy giúp tôi, cô gái tốt bụng tại Hiệp Hội Tiên Phong, hãy chia sẻ truyền thuyết chưa được biết đến này, biết đâu đó sẽ có người cuối cùng giải mã được bí ẩn của nó. Dưới ánh trăng khuyết, ta dạo bước Trên sân khấu, sao nhảy múa thở than Bên hồ hình trái tim, thời gian ngừng trôi Tay trong tay, ta cùng chung lối Ánh mắt rạng ngời, tình ta mãi chẳng phai.

source_en:
I recently received an invitation from the Pioneer Association to explore the culinary delights of Jinzhou. Eager to embark on this food journey, I wandered through the city's streets, savoring every dish the city has to offer. My journey led me to uncover delightful surprises that have now come together to form this unique booklet—a comprehensive food map of Jinzhou. I hope that as you read these pages, you will feel inspired to embark on your own food exploration—then my hard work is worth it. For it is in the moment when flavors dance upon your taste buds, igniting a symphony of sensations that resonate deep within, that the true essence of these delicacies lies.
<color=Highlight>Panhua's Restaurant</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆☆
While writing this booklet, I found myself seated at a small table at Panhua's Restaurant, enveloped by the vibrant buzz of lively conversations. It was here that I witnessed a heartwarming gathering involving a Patroller who had just completed her duty, her friend wearing a blue beret, and another friend in an icy demeanor. Before the Patroller could sit down, she swiftly placed an order for Poached Chicken, Perilla Salad, and Maocai before being joined by her friends. They shared anecdotes with each other, and the vivid expressions and gestures of that Patroller made the atmosphere even more lively. This experience makes me confident that Panhua's Restaurant has the ability to provide a relaxing and spirited dining environment, making it a standout choice for any culinary enthusiast.

As I penned these words, the Poached Chicken arrived at my table. While the chicken itself appeared flat, when immersed in the restaurant's specially crafted sauce, it provides an unforgettable flavor. As I savored each bite, the meat juices burst forth, accompanied by a fresh aroma that lingered in the mouth. The accompanying vegetables, stir-fried to perfection, boasted a vibrant green, complemented by sizzling oil droplets. Paired with tender and fluffy rice, the dish left me with only one word in my mind—"delicious". 

So I couldn't resist having another serving:)
<color=Highlight>Jewel Boba</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆
I found myself longing for more as I savored the delightful Jewel Boba, each sip leaving me yearning for another taste. If I had a second stomach dedicated solely to desserts, there's no doubt it would be reserved for the delicious dessert soup offered here in Jinzhou.. And if I were to recommend just one, Jewel Boba would undoubtedly be my top choice. Boasting over thirty years of renowned excellence, this sweet treat remains as delicious and affordable as ever.
During my visit, I ordered the new buy-one-get-one-free dessert soup. The owner told me that its launch was inspired by a happy couple celebrating their anniversary at the shop—the owner, pleased with their happiness, presented them with a specially made drink. As the couple highly praised its taste, the owner decided to share its taste to more customers. After listening to this warm story, I, who was holding two cups alone, couldn't shake the bitterness of coming here alone. Luckily, the sweetness of the Jewel Boba somewhat lifted my spirits.
<color=Highlight>Liuxian Teahouse</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆
Liuxian Teahouse boasts its Bittberry Tea with distinctive bitterness, which forces you to question everything with a single sip. However, beneath the initial shock, a subtle sweetness emerges, with great persistence in the mouth. 
Unlike the bustling Panhua's Restaurant, Liuxian Teahouse provides a tranquil atmosphere where one can recline in a chair, fan in hand, and while away the hours immersed in the peaceful embrace of life unfolding around them.
<color=Highlight>Borderland Cuisine</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆☆
...
new_translation_vi:
Gần đây tôi nhận được lời mời từ Hiệp Hội Tiên Phong để khám phá những món ngon tại Jinzhou. Hào hứng bắt đầu hành trình ẩm thực này, tôi đã lang thang khắp các con phố, thưởng thức mọi món ăn mà thành phố mang lại. Chuyến đi đã dẫn tôi đến những bất ngờ thú vị, giờ đây được tổng hợp thành cuốn sổ tay độc đáo này—một bản đồ ẩm thực toàn diện của Jinzhou. Tôi hy vọng khi đọc những trang này, bạn sẽ cảm thấy được truyền cảm hứng để bắt đầu hành trình khám phá ẩm thực của riêng mình—khi đó, công sức của tôi mới thực sự xứng đáng. Bởi lẽ, chính trong khoảnh khắc hương vị nhảy múa trên đầu lưỡi, khơi dậy một bản giao hưởng cảm xúc vang vọng tận sâu bên trong, mới là bản chất thực sự của những món ngon này.
<color=Highlight>Nhà hàng của Panhua</color>, đánh giá: ☆☆☆☆☆
Trong lúc viết cuốn sổ tay này, tôi ngồi tại một chiếc bàn nhỏ ở nhà hàng của Panhua, bao quanh bởi tiếng ồn ào náo nhiệt của những cuộc trò chuyện. Chính tại đây, tôi đã chứng kiến một buổi tụ họp ấm lòng giữa một nữ Patroller vừa hoàn thành nhiệm vụ, một người bạn đội mũ nồi xanh và một người bạn khác với vẻ ngoài lạnh lùng. Trước khi kịp ngồi xuống, nữ Patroller đã nhanh chóng gọi món Gà Luộc, Salad Tía Tô và Maocai trước khi những người bạn của cô ấy đến. Họ chia sẻ những câu chuyện với nhau, và biểu cảm cùng cử chỉ sống động của nữ Patroller đó càng làm không khí thêm phần náo nhiệt. Trải nghiệm này khiến tôi tin rằng nhà hàng của Panhua có khả năng mang đến một môi trường ăn uống thư giãn và đầy sức sống, trở thành lựa chọn nổi bật cho bất kỳ tín đồ ẩm thực nào.

Khi tôi viết những dòng này, món Gà Luộc đã được mang ra bàn. Dù bản thân miếng gà trông có vẻ bình thường, nhưng khi nhúng vào loại nước sốt đặc biệt của nhà hàng, nó mang lại một hương vị khó quên. Khi thưởng thức từng miếng, nước thịt bùng nổ, kèm theo hương thơm tươi mát đọng lại trong miệng. Các loại rau ăn kèm được xào hoàn hảo, giữ được màu xanh tươi tắn, điểm xuyết bởi những giọt dầu nóng hổi. Ăn cùng cơm trắng dẻo thơm, món ăn chỉ để lại trong tâm trí tôi một từ duy nhất—"ngon tuyệt".

Vì vậy, tôi không thể cưỡng lại việc gọi thêm một phần nữa :)
<color=Highlight>Jewel Boba</color>, đánh giá: ☆☆☆☆
Tôi thấy mình khao khát nhiều hơn khi thưởng thức món Jewel Boba đầy mê hoặc, mỗi ngụm đều khiến tôi mong muốn được nếm lại lần nữa. Nếu tôi có một chiếc dạ dày thứ hai chỉ dành riêng cho món tráng miệng, chắc chắn nó sẽ được dành cho món chè ngon tuyệt tại Jinzhou này. Và nếu phải giới thiệu chỉ một món, Jewel Boba chắc chắn sẽ là lựa chọn hàng đầu của tôi. Với hơn ba mươi năm danh tiếng, món ngọt này vẫn ngon và giá cả phải chăng như ngày nào.
Trong chuyến thăm, tôi đã gọi món chè mới mua một tặng một. Chủ quán kể rằng sự ra đời của nó được lấy cảm hứng từ một cặp đôi hạnh phúc đang kỷ niệm ngày cưới tại quán—chủ quán, vui mừng trước hạnh phúc của họ, đã tặng họ một món đồ uống được pha chế đặc biệt. Vì cặp đôi khen ngợi hương vị của nó hết lời, chủ quán quyết định chia sẻ hương vị đó đến nhiều khách hàng hơn. Sau khi nghe câu chuyện ấm áp này, tôi, người đang cầm hai cốc một mình, không thể xua tan nỗi đắng cay khi đến đây một mình. May mắn thay, vị ngọt của Jewel Boba phần nào làm tâm trạng tôi phấn chấn hơn.
<color=Highlight>Trà Quán Liuxian</color>, đánh giá: ☆☆☆☆
Trà Quán Liuxian tự hào với món Trà Bittberry có vị đắng đặc trưng, buộc bạn phải đặt câu hỏi về mọi thứ chỉ với một ngụm. Tuy nhiên, ẩn sau cú sốc ban đầu, một vị ngọt tinh tế dần xuất hiện, lưu lại rất lâu trong miệng.
Không giống như nhà hàng náo nhiệt của Panhua, Trà Quán Liuxian mang đến một bầu không khí yên tĩnh, nơi người ta có thể ngả lưng trên ghế, tay cầm quạt, và để thời gian trôi đi trong sự tĩnh lặng của cuộc sống xung quanh.
<color=Highlight>Ẩm Thực Biên Giới</color>, đánh giá: ☆☆☆☆☆
...

source_en:
Loong Buns, Jinzhou Stew, Star Flakes... Before delving into the numerous specialties of Jinzhou, let me introduce you to a time-honored dish—"Rising Loong".
<color=Highlight>Rising Loong</color>, rating: ☆☆☆☆☆
For anyone exploring Jinzhou, tasting Rising Loong is a must. The dish presents itself with a captivating golden crispiness, with its preparation involving intricate steps to reproduce the scene where a carp looks up to the sky, aspiring to become a dragon. This dish narrates the awakening of Jué. Back then, countless carps leaped from the water to pay homage to it. It is an event seem auspicious by Jinzhou people. Therefore, if you seek good fortune, don't miss the chance to savor Rising Loong!

<color=Highlight>Food Ration Bar</color>, rating: ☆☆☆
Although I've given it only three stars, the significance of Food Ration Bar goes beyond its taste. Its major characteristic lies in its convenience, accessibility, and ample nutritional value, making it available for every soldier who fights bravely and relentlessly on the frontlines.
More importantly, each Food Ration Bar comes with a note, expressing Jinzhou people's thoughts, wishes, and gratitude to the soldiers who safeguard the peace and prosperity of Jinzhou.
Even though countless challenges may lie ahead, Jinzhou and its people consistently stand in support of the soldiers. The soldiers courageously protect Jinzhou with their lives, and in return, Jinzhou becomes their steadfast shield.
new_translation_vi:
Bánh bao Loong, món hầm Jinzhou, Bánh Star Flakes... Trước khi đi sâu vào vô số đặc sản của Jinzhou, hãy để tôi giới thiệu với bạn một món ăn lâu đời—"Rising Loong".
<color=Highlight>Rising Loong</color>, đánh giá: ☆☆☆☆☆
Đối với bất kỳ ai đang khám phá Jinzhou, việc nếm thử món Rising Loong là điều bắt buộc. Món ăn hiện lên với vẻ giòn rụm vàng óng đầy quyến rũ, với quá trình chế biến bao gồm những bước phức tạp để tái hiện cảnh tượng cá chép vượt vũ môn, khao khát hóa rồng. Món ăn này kể lại sự thức tỉnh của Jué. Ngày đó, vô số cá chép đã nhảy lên khỏi mặt nước để bày tỏ lòng tôn kính. Đó là một sự kiện được người dân Jinzhou coi là điềm lành. Vì vậy, nếu bạn tìm kiếm vận may, đừng bỏ lỡ cơ hội thưởng thức món Rising Loong!

<color=Highlight>Khẩu Phần Ăn</color>, đánh giá: ☆☆☆
Mặc dù tôi chỉ cho nó ba sao, nhưng ý nghĩa của Khẩu Phần Ăn vượt xa hương vị của nó. Đặc điểm chính của nó nằm ở sự tiện lợi, dễ tiếp cận và giá trị dinh dưỡng dồi dào, giúp mọi người lính chiến đấu dũng cảm và không mệt mỏi nơi tiền tuyến đều có thể sử dụng.
Quan trọng hơn, mỗi Khẩu Phần Ăn đều đi kèm với một mảnh giấy, bày tỏ suy nghĩ, mong ước và lòng biết ơn của người dân Jinzhou đối với những người lính đang bảo vệ hòa bình và sự thịnh vượng của Jinzhou.
Dù vô vàn thử thách có thể đang chờ đợi phía trước, Jinzhou và người dân của nó luôn sát cánh ủng hộ những người lính. Những người lính dũng cảm bảo vệ Jinzhou bằng cả mạng sống của mình, và đổi lại, Jinzhou trở thành tấm khiên vững chắc của họ.

source_en:
We Promise, We Deliver—Lollo Logistics

Away from Jinzhou and yearning for its specialties? Look no further–Lollo Logistics has got you covered!
Staying in Jinzhou and craving specialties from the Six Countries? No problem–Lollo Logistics is here to help again!
Picture this: when you open those take-out boxes, hot steam rises, carrying the aroma that wafts into your nostrils, igniting your appetite for these delights.
For unrivaled quality and swift delivery, make the smart choice–choose Lollo Logistics!

BodyBuilder: Totally! Wasn't in Jinzhou before, but I was craving Panhua's Restaurant's Pulled Chicken so bad. Every sec, min, hour, couldn't stop thinking about it, lost sleep over it. Finally gave in, called Lollo Logistics, and ordered takeout. However, the delivery guy forgot pickup, but drove me to Jinzhou for that Pulled Chicken!
AM JUST A BRUSH: Hahaha! Bad News: Forgot to pick up the takeout; Good News: Ended up bringing the customer to the restaurant.
AAA Fresh Ingredients Wholesaler: Definitely fresh. Trustworthy!
Green Light Forever: Thanks, mate! You can count on us. We always keep our promises!
new_translation_vi:
Chúng Tôi Hứa, Chúng Tôi Giao—Hậu Cần Lollo

Xa cách Jinzhou và khao khát những đặc sản của nó? Không cần tìm đâu xa—Hậu Cần Lollo sẽ lo liệu cho bạn!
Đang ở Jinzhou và thèm đặc sản từ Lục Quốc? Không vấn đề gì—Hậu Cần Lollo lại ở đây để giúp đỡ!
Hãy tưởng tượng thế này: khi bạn mở những hộp đồ ăn mang đi đó, hơi nóng bốc lên, mang theo hương thơm xộc vào mũi, đánh thức sự thèm ăn của bạn đối với những món ngon này.
Để có chất lượng vượt trội và giao hàng nhanh chóng, hãy đưa ra lựa chọn thông minh—chọn Hậu Cần Lollo!

BodyBuilder: Chắc chắn rồi! Trước đây không ở Jinzhou, nhưng tôi thèm món Gà Xé của nhà hàng Panhua đến mức không chịu nổi. Từng giây, từng phút, từng giờ, không thể ngừng nghĩ về nó, mất ngủ vì nó. Cuối cùng tôi đã đầu hàng, gọi cho Hậu Cần Lollo và đặt đồ ăn mang đi. Tuy nhiên, anh chàng giao hàng quên lấy đồ, nhưng lại chở tôi đến Jinzhou để ăn món Gà Xé đó!
AM JUST A BRUSH: Hahaha! Tin xấu: Quên lấy đồ ăn mang đi; Tin tốt: Cuối cùng lại đưa khách hàng đến tận nhà hàng.
AAA Fresh Ingredients Wholesaler: Chắc chắn là tươi ngon. Đáng tin cậy!
Green Light Forever: Cảm ơn, bạn hiền! Bạn có thể tin tưởng chúng tôi. Chúng tôi luôn giữ lời hứa!

source_en: Every morning, well before the sun graces the sky, Mahe, the owner of Mahe's Grocery, has already begun his work. Over the next few hours, he carefully prepares the ingredients for today's sale. With changing seasons come distinct selections of vegetables and fruits. How does Mahe choose seasonal ingredients, and how does he ensure them reaches households far and wide? Join us today on "Meeting Jinzhou", as this episode takes you on a visit to Mahe's Grocery.
new_translation_vi: Mỗi buổi sáng, rất lâu trước khi mặt trời chiếu sáng bầu trời, Mahe, chủ cửa hàng tạp hóa Mahe, đã bắt đầu công việc của mình. Trong vài giờ tiếp theo, ông cẩn thận chuẩn bị các nguyên liệu cho việc bán hàng hôm nay. Theo mùa thay đổi, các loại rau củ quả cũng được lựa chọn khác nhau. Làm thế nào Mahe chọn nguyên liệu theo mùa, và làm thế nào ông đảm bảo chúng đến được với các hộ gia đình ở khắp mọi nơi? Hãy tham gia cùng chúng tôi hôm nay trong chương trình "Gặp gỡ Jinzhou", vì tập này sẽ đưa bạn đến thăm cửa hàng tạp hóa của Mahe.

source_en:
Title: Spectrum Anomaly Monitoring Report for Subject C-001

Entry: #H-C-6947

Abstract:

The data presented in this report were obtained from spectrum evaluations performed on Subject C-001, also known as "Jué," from June ████ to December ████.

During a preliminary experiment conducted on June 14th, ████ researchers observed a 15-second frequency loss in Subject C-001's spectrum. Five additional tests were later conducted through the following day, and all data obtained reflecting the frequency loss were highly consistent (Margin of error averaged below 0.02).

The recorded data of the Resonance Spectrum on the 3rd, 6th, 11th, 23rd, and 30th of the subsequent month indicated a gradual lengthening of Subject C-001's frequency loss. The data exhibited significant increases with varying patterns. It was postulated that this event occurred due to the presence of Subject C-002, also known as the "Mianloong Chamber." Subsequent thirty-two one-factor experiments confirmed a significant correlation between Subject C-002 and the duration of frequency loss in Subject C-001. Notably, Subject C-002 exhibited an inhibitory effect on the duration growth of Subject C-001.

Based on spectrum monitoring data of Subject C-001 from June ████ to December ████, the following preliminary conclusions can be drawn:

1. Subject C-001 bears defect/malfunction.
2. Subject C-002 can temporarily slow down the escalation of Subject C-001's defect, but cannot make up for Subject C-001's frequency loss.

Appendix-1 (Source: Research Memo #C349)

With the help of the "peculiar visitor", we were given the opportunity to converse with Subject C-001 directly. It was a meaningful and mutual conversation, though we didn't get as much information as I had hoped for.

But at the very least, the conversation proved one point: Our previous research was effective, and there was no defect in C-001. As per C-001's own declaration, "One of the Temporal Programs was lost," and during its prime, C-001 had the capability to manipulate time by decelerating or even halting it, rewinding it, and making corrections as needed. Nonetheless, the current condition of C-001 can be described as one of sickness, with irreversible disruptions to time rendering any attempts at correction or restoration ineffective. Consequently, Mt. Firmament has been transformed into an isolated entity amidst the vast oceans of time, despite the initial purpose being one of redemption.

Appendix-2 (Source: Research Memo #C382)

By running through time flow models, we came up with two hypotheses:

Hypothesis #1: C-001's "defect" is none congenital, and this "defect" may have taken place around the period of C-001's first arrival at Mt. Firmament (it has been confirmed that the "defect" cannot be reversed, see report #H-C-7426).

Hypothesis #2: The discrepancy in temporal progression between the interior and exterior of the "time bubble" has been progressively widening. Based on data comparisons, there exists a correlation between the deceleration rate of time flow in Mt. Firmament and the growth rate of the duration of C-001's frequency loss.

Expanding on the second hypothesis... If C-001 were to eventually cease to exist, the uncontrolled flow of time in Mt. Firmament would likely surpass its limitations and impact a broader range of regions… Such as, the entirety of Jinzhou.

…This might be why that "peculiar visitor" offered to work with us in the first place…

Appendix-3 (Source: Research Memo #C457)

Efforts are being made to advance the development of the artificial Resonance Object. Although we have not yet achieved success, we have decided to name it the "Chronosorter" in honor of our recent progress.

I know we have our "peculiar visitor" to thank for every progress we've made so far. If the "Chronosorter" project is successful, it's a win-win for everyone involved. As I had anticipated, they intend to restore and utilize C-001's complete power in order to rectify the temporal distortion, with the aid of a Resonance Object.

There is still a significant journey ahead of us. This is merely the starting point.
new_translation_vi:
Tiêu đề: Báo cáo Giám sát Bất thường Phổ cho Đối tượng C-001

Mục nhập: #H-C-6947

Tóm tắt:

Dữ liệu được trình bày trong báo cáo này thu được từ các đánh giá phổ được thực hiện trên Đối tượng C-001, còn được gọi là "Jué," từ tháng ████ đến tháng 12 ████.

Trong một thí nghiệm sơ bộ được thực hiện vào ngày 14 tháng 6, các nhà nghiên cứu ████ đã quan sát thấy sự mất tần số 15 giây trong phổ của Đối tượng C-001. Năm thử nghiệm bổ sung sau đó đã được thực hiện vào ngày hôm sau, và tất cả dữ liệu thu được phản ánh sự mất tần số đều rất nhất quán (Biên độ sai số trung bình dưới 0,02).

Dữ liệu ghi lại của Phổ Cộng hưởng vào ngày 3, 6, 11, 23 và 30 của tháng tiếp theo cho thấy sự kéo dài dần dần của sự mất tần số của Đối tượng C-001. Dữ liệu cho thấy sự gia tăng đáng kể với các mô hình khác nhau. Người ta giả định rằng sự kiện này xảy ra do sự hiện diện của Đối tượng C-002, còn được gọi là "Mianloong Chamber." Ba mươi hai thí nghiệm một yếu tố tiếp theo đã xác nhận mối tương quan đáng kể giữa Đối tượng C-002 và thời gian mất tần số ở Đối tượng C-001. Đáng chú ý, Đối tượng C-002 thể hiện tác dụng ức chế đối với sự gia tăng thời gian của Đối tượng C-001.

Dựa trên dữ liệu giám sát phổ của Đối tượng C-001 từ tháng ████ đến tháng 12 ████, các kết luận sơ bộ sau đây có thể được rút ra:

1. Đối tượng C-001 mang khiếm khuyết/trục trặc.
2. Đối tượng C-002 có thể tạm thời slow sự leo thang của khiếm khuyết của Đối tượng C-001, nhưng không thể bù đắp cho sự mất tần số của Đối tượng C-001.

Phụ lục-1 (Nguồn: Bản ghi nhớ nghiên cứu #C349)

Với sự giúp đỡ của "vị khách kỳ lạ", chúng tôi đã có cơ hội trò chuyện trực tiếp với Đối tượng C-001. Đó là một cuộc trò chuyện ý nghĩa và tương hỗ, mặc dù chúng tôi không nhận được nhiều thông tin như tôi đã hy vọng.

Nhưng ít nhất, cuộc trò chuyện đã chứng minh một điểm: Nghiên cứu trước đây của chúng tôi có hiệu quả, và không có khiếm khuyết nào ở C-001. Theo tuyên bố của chính C-001, "Một trong những Chương trình Thời gian đã bị mất," và trong thời kỳ đỉnh cao, C-001 có khả năng thao túng thời gian bằng cách làm chậm hoặc thậm chí dừng nó lại, tua ngược nó và thực hiện các hiệu chỉnh khi cần thiết. Tuy nhiên, tình trạng hiện tại của C-001 có thể được mô tả là một tình trạng bệnh tật, với những gián đoạn không thể đảo ngược đối với thời gian khiến mọi nỗ lực hiệu chỉnh hoặc khôi phục đều không hiệu quả. Do đó, Mt. Firmament đã bị biến thành một thực thể bị cô lập giữa đại dương thời gian rộng lớn, mặc dù mục đích ban đầu là sự cứu rỗi.

Phụ lục-2 (Nguồn: Bản ghi nhớ nghiên cứu #C382)

Bằng cách chạy qua các mô hình dòng thời gian, chúng tôi đã đưa ra hai giả thuyết:

Giả thuyết #1: "Khiếm khuyết" của C-001 không phải là bẩm sinh, và "khiếm khuyết" này có thể đã xảy ra vào khoảng thời gian C-001 đến Mt. Firmament lần đầu tiên (đã xác nhận rằng "khiếm khuyết" không thể đảo ngược, xem báo cáo #H-C-7426).

Giả thuyết #2: Sự khác biệt trong tiến trình thời gian giữa bên trong và bên ngoài "bong bóng thời gian" đã ngày càng mở rộng. Dựa trên so sánh dữ liệu, tồn tại mối tương quan giữa tốc độ giảm tốc của dòng thời gian ở Mt. Firmament và tốc độ tăng trưởng thời gian mất tần số của C-001.

Mở rộng giả thuyết thứ hai... Nếu C-001 cuối cùng ngừng tồn tại, dòng thời gian không kiểm soát được ở Mt. Firmament có khả năng vượt quá giới hạn của nó và ảnh hưởng đến phạm vi rộng hơn... Chẳng hạn như, toàn bộ Jinzhou.

…Đây có thể là lý do tại sao "vị khách kỳ lạ" đó đề nghị làm việc với chúng tôi ngay từ đầu…

Phụ lục-3 (Nguồn: Bản ghi nhớ nghiên cứu #C457)

Những nỗ lực đang được thực hiện để thúc đẩy sự phát triển của Đối tượng Cộng hưởng nhân tạo. Mặc dù chúng tôi chưa đạt được thành công, chúng tôi đã quyết định đặt tên nó là "Chronosorter" để vinh danh những tiến bộ gần đây của chúng tôi.

Tôi biết chúng tôi phải cảm ơn "vị khách kỳ lạ" của mình vì mọi tiến bộ mà chúng tôi đã đạt được cho đến nay. Nếu dự án "Chronosorter" thành công, đó là một chiến thắng cho tất cả những người tham gia. Như tôi đã dự đoán, họ dự định khôi phục và sử dụng toàn bộ sức mạnh của C-001 để khắc phục sự biến dạng thời gian, với sự hỗ trợ của một Đối tượng Cộng hưởng.

Vẫn còn một chặng đường dài phía trước. Đây chỉ là điểm khởi đầu.

source_en:
Research Memorandum — #C532
Date: [--05]
As our 903rd experiment ended in yet another failure, we couldn't help but reminisce about our initial excitement when we completed the first Chronosorter prototype. However, we were always aware that it was a crude replica of C-001's power. My calculations showed that the Chronosorters could only function within a specific distance and would become useless once removed from this region's time barrier (although they may still work at the Luminous Shore).

Despite this, I clung to hope. The concept of a "Secondary Resonance" was more than just a theory to me; it was my life's work. It was terrifying to think it could all be a mere fantasy.

Research Memorandum — #C545
Date: [--26]
The 931st Chronosorter, like its predecessors, was destroyed by intense resonance shock. But it successfully restored time for a brief 1.29 seconds, making it a valuable sacrifice.

I was right... My belief in the Secondary Resonance theory has been confirmed! When two entities resonate at high intensity, the weaker one can exert much greater Resonance power than its original capacity.

The only issue is how the Chronosorters we've been making are too fragile for this task. I need a more powerful Resonator, but the risk is too great. No one can withstand the resonance shock of C-001 without enduring catastrophic overclocking.

Note: I must speak to our visitor. I saw them telling C-001 something. I am convinced that there is a connection between what they did and the brief success of Chronosorter No. 931. Yes, I had seen it with my own eyes; C-001 must have transmitted some form of unknown energy to Chronosorter No. 931, just when I had deemed the experiment a failure...
new_translation_vi:
Bản ghi nhớ nghiên cứu — #C532
Ngày: [--05]
Khi thí nghiệm thứ 903 của chúng tôi kết thúc trong một thất bại khác, chúng tôi không thể không hồi tưởng về sự phấn khích ban đầu khi chúng tôi hoàn thành nguyên mẫu Chronosorter đầu tiên. Tuy nhiên, chúng tôi luôn biết rằng đó là một bản sao thô sơ của sức mạnh C-001. Các tính toán của tôi cho thấy các Chronosorter chỉ có thể hoạt động trong một khoảng cách cụ thể và sẽ trở nên vô dụng khi bị loại bỏ khỏi rào cản thời gian của khu vực này (mặc dù chúng vẫn có thể hoạt động tại Luminous Shore).

Mặc dù vậy, tôi vẫn bám lấy hy vọng. Khái niệm "Cộng hưởng Thứ cấp" không chỉ là một lý thuyết đối với tôi; đó là công việc cả đời của tôi. Thật đáng sợ khi nghĩ rằng tất cả có thể chỉ là một ảo tưởng.

Bản ghi nhớ nghiên cứu — #C545
Ngày: [--26]
Chronosorter thứ 931, giống như những người tiền nhiệm của nó, đã bị phá hủy bởi cú sốc cộng hưởng dữ dội. Nhưng nó đã khôi phục thời gian thành công trong 1,29 giây ngắn ngủi, khiến nó trở thành một sự hy sinh có giá trị.

Tôi đã đúng... Niềm tin của tôi vào lý thuyết Cộng hưởng Thứ cấp đã được xác nhận! Khi hai thực thể cộng hưởng ở cường độ cao, thực thể yếu hơn có thể tạo ra sức mạnh Cộng hưởng lớn hơn nhiều so với công suất ban đầu của nó.

Vấn đề duy nhất là làm thế nào các Chronosorter mà chúng tôi đang tạo ra quá mỏng manh cho nhiệm vụ này. Tôi cần một Resonator mạnh mẽ hơn, nhưng rủi ro là quá lớn. Không ai có thể chịu đựng được cú sốc cộng hưởng của C-001 mà không phải chịu đựng overclocking thảm khốc.

Lưu ý: Tôi phải nói chuyện với vị khách của chúng tôi. Tôi thấy họ nói với C-001 điều gì đó. Tôi tin rằng có mối liên hệ giữa những gì họ đã làm và sự thành công ngắn ngủi của Chronosorter số 931. Vâng, tôi đã tận mắt chứng kiến; C-001 hẳn đã truyền một dạng năng lượng không xác định nào đó cho Chronosorter số 931, ngay khi tôi cho rằng thí nghiệm là một thất bại...

source_en:
Reply: That Child
Unfortunately, C-001 did not respond to the matter concerning that child. However, the fact remains that the dead baby did come back to life. We do not need C-001 to confirm anything for us, or else the strange occurrences of that day would be meaningless. As for the child's identity, there can be no other answer besides ■■■.
As for how the dead baby was brought back to life, I suspect it has something to do with the turning back of time, but neither you, I, nor the people of Hongzhen are able to remember the events of that night in detail. If we rule out the possibility of a collective hallucination, this at least indicates that the phenomenon of turning back time on that day only affected individual entities and not all of Mt. Firmament...
A citizen of Hongzhen told me that a child is now being fostered in the town. Maybe we should go and take a look...
new_translation_vi:
Trả lời: Đứa trẻ đó
Thật không may, C-001 đã không phản hồi về vấn đề liên quan đến đứa trẻ đó. Tuy nhiên, thực tế vẫn là đứa bé đã chết đã sống lại. Chúng tôi không cần C-001 xác nhận bất cứ điều gì cho chúng tôi, nếu không những sự kiện kỳ lạ của ngày hôm đó sẽ trở nên vô nghĩa. Đối với danh tính của đứa trẻ, không thể có câu trả lời nào khác ngoài ■■■.
Đối với việc đứa bé đã chết được hồi sinh như thế nào, tôi nghi ngờ nó có liên quan đến việc quay ngược thời gian, nhưng cả bạn, tôi, hay người dân Hongzhen đều không thể nhớ chi tiết các sự kiện của đêm đó. Nếu chúng ta loại trừ khả năng ảo giác tập thể, điều này ít nhất cho thấy hiện tượng quay ngược thời gian vào ngày hôm đó chỉ ảnh hưởng đến các thực thể cá nhân chứ không phải tất cả Mt. Firmament...
Một công dân của Hongzhen nói với tôi rằng một đứa trẻ hiện đang được nuôi dưỡng trong thị trấn. Có lẽ chúng ta nên đi xem thử...

source_en:
Research Memo #C501
Date: [--19]
Our visitor shared intricate details about the outside world, describing a new civilization that rose from the ashes of the old. Their narrative held a serene tone, void of personal emotion, as if they were an impartial observer, rather than the one who saved said civilization in the first place.
It became clear to me that they were not like us - their humility and goodwill were meant to guide and integrate us onto a predetermined path.
Despite this, I was grateful for all the knowledge they shared with me. I yearned to see this new world for myself, realizing that I had been cooped up in Mt. Firmament for too long...
new_translation_vi:
Bản ghi nhớ nghiên cứu #C501
Ngày: [--19]
Vị khách của chúng tôi đã chia sẻ những chi tiết phức tạp về thế giới bên ngoài, mô tả một nền văn minh mới trỗi dậy từ đống tro tàn của nền văn minh cũ. Câu chuyện của họ mang một tông giọng thanh thản, không có cảm xúc cá nhân, như thể họ là một người quan sát khách quan, thay vì là người đã cứu nền văn minh đó ngay từ đầu.
Trở nên rõ ràng với tôi rằng họ không giống chúng ta - sự khiêm tốn và thiện chí của họ nhằm mục đích hướng dẫn và tích hợp chúng ta vào một con đường đã được xác định trước.
Mặc dù vậy, tôi rất biết ơn tất cả những kiến thức mà họ đã chia sẻ với tôi. Tôi khao khát được tận mắt nhìn thấy thế giới mới này, nhận ra rằng mình đã bị nhốt trong Mt. Firmament quá lâu...

source_en:
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>March. Various lands were ravaged by TD Outbreaks, and 31 victims climbed the mountain.
<alignleft/>April 9. A TD Outbreak approached Mt. Firmament. On the night of the same day, a stream of fire fell on Empyrean Cliff. (Note: Empyrean Cliff was later renamed as Loong's Crest)
<alignleft/>April 21. Two townspeople lured an outsider to the place where the stream of fire fell on Empyrean Cliff.
<alignleft/>April 22. A TD Outbreak invaded Hongzhen. The Sentinel called Jué emerged from Empyrean Cliff, slowing the flow of time with its Temporal Mandate to repel the TD Outbreak and forming Mt. Firmament.
<alignleft/>April 23. An outsider visited Hongzhen with the Sentinel Jué and left the mountain with 17 other townspeople later.
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>July 3. The outsider returned to Mt. Firmament, seemingly unaffected by the Temporal Disruptions. The locals have been referring to them as "that peculiar visitor" ever since."
new_translation_vi:
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>Tháng 3. Nhiều vùng đất bị tàn phá bởi các đợt bùng phát TD, và 31 nạn nhân đã leo lên núi.
<alignleft/>Ngày 9 tháng 4. Một đợt bùng phát TD tiếp cận Mt. Firmament. Vào đêm cùng ngày, một dòng lửa rơi xuống Empyrean Cliff. (Lưu ý: Empyrean Cliff sau đó được đổi tên thành Loong's Crest)
<alignleft/>Ngày 21 tháng 4. Hai người dân thị trấn dụ một người ngoài đến nơi dòng lửa rơi xuống Empyrean Cliff.
<alignleft/>Ngày 22 tháng 4. Một đợt bùng phát TD xâm chiếm Hongzhen. Sentinel được gọi là Jué xuất hiện từ Empyrean Cliff, làm chậm dòng thời gian với Lệnh Thời gian của nó để đẩy lùi đợt bùng phát TD và hình thành Mt. Firmament.
<alignleft/>Ngày 23 tháng 4. Một người ngoài đã đến thăm Hongzhen cùng với Sentinel Jué và rời khỏi ngọn núi cùng với 17 người dân thị trấn khác sau đó.
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>Ngày 3 tháng 7. Người ngoài đã trở lại Mt. Firmament, dường như không bị ảnh hưởng bởi các Gián đoạn Thời gian. Người dân địa phương đã gọi họ là "vị khách kỳ lạ đó" kể từ đó."

source_en:
<alignleft/>...
<alignleft/>March 5. Thunder started roaring at about 21:00–23:00, and the Sentinel Jué returned with a dead baby.
<alignleft/>March 6. The thunder stopped around 01:00–03:00. Something strange was happening in the sky, and the stars were moving in reverse.
<alignleft/>At 05:00–07:00 of the same day, the Sentinel Jué came to Hongzhen to entrust the baby to the townspeople. The baby looked completely normal with no signs of lifelessness.
<alignleft/>(Note: It should be impossible for a dead baby to be brought back to life. I would never believe this if this was not my personal experience.)
<alignleft/>...

<alignleft/>...

source_en:
Years ago, there were two close friends who lived on Mt. Firmament. One of them loved stories about the world and wanted to travel around the world, collecting stories while adventuring like the protagonists of stories. When the Sentinel was about to seal Mt. Firmament, this person left Mt. Firmament on horseback.
The other person loved the sounds of the mountain, such as the gurgling water and chirping birds. She hung windchimers everywhere in the mountains and played the guqin on the mountain every day because she wanted to hear the music of the mountains and valleys.
They made a promise to reunite here after a few decades. At their reunion, one would tell stories of the world, and the other would play the beautiful music of the mountains and forests.
However, time flowed differently on Mt. Firmament, and one day there was equivalent to a few decades outside. Time passed mercilessly. The one who left could no longer return home, and the one who stayed could only watch as her guqin decayed.
In this vast expanse, every goodbye could be a farewell for life.
Be well. Farewell.
new_translation_vi:
Nhiều năm trước, có hai người bạn thân sống trên Mt. Firmament. Một trong số họ yêu thích những câu chuyện về thế giới và muốn đi du lịch khắp thế giới, thu thập những câu chuyện trong khi phiêu lưu giống như các nhân vật chính trong truyện. Khi Sentinel chuẩn bị phong ấn Mt. Firmament, người này đã rời Mt. Firmament trên lưng ngựa.
Người kia yêu âm thanh của ngọn núi, chẳng hạn như tiếng nước chảy róc rách và tiếng chim hót. Cô treo chuông gió khắp nơi trên núi và chơi đàn guqin trên núi mỗi ngày vì cô muốn nghe nhạc của núi rừng.
Họ đã hứa sẽ đoàn tụ ở đây sau vài thập kỷ. Khi đoàn tụ, một người sẽ kể những câu chuyện về thế giới, và người kia sẽ chơi bản nhạc tuyệt đẹp của núi rừng.
Tuy nhiên, thời gian trôi khác nhau trên Mt. Firmament, và một ngày ở đó tương đương với vài thập kỷ bên ngoài. Thời gian trôi qua không thương tiếc. Người đã rời đi không thể trở về nhà, và người ở lại chỉ có thể nhìn cây đàn guqin của mình mục nát.
Trong không gian rộng lớn này, mỗi lời tạm biệt có thể là một lời chia tay vĩnh viễn.
Bảo trọng. Tạm biệt.

source_en:
Hello, stranger!
If you're reading this message, you must have been selected as the first audience member of our Chelonian Dance Troupe!
A long time ago, I stumbled upon an instrument that can work miracles—the melodious music it plays can make me, animals, and even Tacet Discords dance to its tune. Of all the dances, the dance of tortoises is the most moving.
Since I was a child, I've always dreamed of becoming a performer who sings and dances. Unfortunately, probably due to my lack of talent, I've never been able to sing and dance well despite how much time and effort I've devoted to my training.
However, the moment I saw the tortoises dance, I set a goal for myself—to found a dance troupe!
With my guidance, the Chelonian Dance Troupe has been established for some time now, and our members' rehearsal efforts are beginning to bear fruit.
Now, it's time to pick up the instrument and let the music play!
Let's get moving, Chelonian Dance Troupe! Show the audience a dance they will never forget!
—Founder of Chelonian Dance Troupe
new_translation_vi:
Xin chào, người lạ!
Nếu bạn đang đọc tin nhắn này, bạn hẳn đã được chọn làm khán giả đầu tiên của Đoàn múa Chelonian của chúng tôi!
Cách đây rất lâu, tôi tình cờ tìm thấy một nhạc cụ có thể tạo ra phép màu—âm nhạc du dương mà nó phát ra có thể khiến tôi, động vật và thậm chí cả Tacet Discord nhảy múa theo giai điệu của nó. Trong tất cả các điệu nhảy, điệu nhảy của loài rùa là cảm động nhất.
Từ khi còn nhỏ, tôi luôn mơ ước trở thành một nghệ sĩ biểu diễn biết hát và nhảy. Thật không may, có lẽ do thiếu tài năng, tôi chưa bao giờ có thể hát và nhảy tốt mặc dù đã dành bao nhiêu thời gian và công sức cho việc luyện tập.
Tuy nhiên, khoảnh khắc nhìn thấy những chú rùa nhảy múa, tôi đã đặt ra một mục tiêu cho mình—thành lập một đoàn múa!
Với sự hướng dẫn của tôi, Đoàn múa Chelonian đã được thành lập được một thời gian, và những nỗ lực tập luyện của các thành viên chúng tôi đang bắt đầu đơm hoa kết trái.
Bây giờ, đã đến lúc cầm nhạc cụ lên và để âm nhạc vang lên!
Hãy bắt đầu nào, Đoàn múa Chelonian! Hãy cho khán giả thấy một điệu nhảy mà họ sẽ không bao giờ quên!
—Người sáng lập Đoàn múa Chelonian

source_en:
To the Moontree Lodge,

I'm tired. I'm really tired.
The many failed experiments and our unachievable goal have filled me with despair.
I'm not the right person for the work of the academy, nor am I good at communicating with others. I don't even have what it takes to apologize after hurting the only person who would listen to me.
I'm rotten to the core and unworthy of pursuing the truth.
Even if I make a wish, I bet no one would want to make my wish come true.
But on the off chance... even if there's only a one in ten thousand chance that someone will see this...
Please make me disappear from this world. I hope that nobody will remember me and nobody will be sad because of my disappearance.

source_en:
When "the Genius" Meets "the Ordinary": An Exclusive Interview with the Mysterious Polymath

Q: This is your first time speaking to the public, right? Are you nervous? Everyone's been so curious about what the legendary "genius" is like.
A: Haha, actually, I've interacted with many of you on various topics without you even realizing it. Maybe you would recall discussing proton lifetime with someone named Cream Cat.

Q: That science writer Cream Cat? So it's also you! What a surprise! By the way, does this pseudonym have any special meaning?
A: It's from a little "aha" moment. Let me ask you this: ever accidentally dropped a cream cake? If you have, you've probably noticed the creamy side always hits the ground first, just like a cat always lands on its paws. Now, imagine this: stick the non-creamed side onto a cat's back, and voilà! You've got yourself a cream-cat perpetual motion machine, spinning 24/7—a true scientific marvel.

Q: It must take a whimsical and creative mind to come up with such an interesting idea. I wonder if your research on Automata Mechanics is just as imaginative.
A: To answer that, let's raise our heads and look at the starry sky through the window above. What do you see at first glance? And if you look further, what do you see next?

Q: First, the moon and stars. Beyond that, maybe planets crashing into each other or the starry sky mirroring the world we live in.
A: Now, are these just your imagination or scientific facts waiting to be confirmed? You can't find the answer if you don't imagine it first, right? It's the same with my research: imagination is part of scientification. Researchers today often focus too much on the utilitarian side of science, abandoning imagination to ensure their work contributes to mankind and the world as a whole, even if it goes against their intuition. Applied research is undoubtedly necessary for post-Lament reconstruction, but that's no reason to give up imagination, the breeding ground of science. So, my advice is... just think about how to make the science work. As for what it might yield, well... (smiles)

Q: How enlightening! Speaking of advice, do you have any for your gifted son, Xiangli Yao? As a genius yourself, you must have high expectations for him.

source_en:
Dad and Mom always take different paths when we go hiking. Dad likes heading up to the summit, and I enjoy climbing with him. After reaching the top, we sit under a big tree and count the stars in the night sky. Mom, on the other hand, always goes down the mountain. Today, I decided to go with Mom.
I didn't even know there was a village at the bottom of this remote mountain! Everyone there smiled and nodded at Mom like they knew her well. Does Mom come here for her job all the time?
The villagers gathered around and thanked Mom, expressing their praises, just like those mentioned in the newspapers. But I also heard them say something else.
"I wasn't sure if Dr. Xiangli Yan would really give us checkups for free every month, but she did it! And she still does, even after the big disaster..."
"She's so sincere and considerate. But don't you think it's a waste of talent for her to work in our village? I mean, someone of her expertise should be doing more important things!"
On the way home, I couldn't shake off what the villagers had said, even finding myself muttering those words. Mom noticed and took my hand, asking about counting stars with Dad. I told her I could recognize every star, even the faintest ones in the distance. Mom said even though she wasn't up on the mountain with us, she was still gazing at the stars. The difference was that she kept her feet firmly on the ground so she wouldn't fall while looking at the sky. As she spoke, a man came up to her asking for help, so I went home alone. But this time, the starry sky looked different from what Dad showed me back on the mountaintop.

"When people are hungry, they work to earn credits to buy food. But when my mind hungers for knowledge about this world, what can I offer to satisfy that craving?"
The words of that researcher have been echoing in my mind ever since then...
By observing the Tacet Fields, we will definitely be able to find the cause of this disaster and redefine the science of our times.

source_en:
More researchers have left... No one's going to continue the research on the Tacet Field.
It feels like everything we've been studying is akin to planting a seed in a Petri dish out in the Tacet Field. And guess what? That seed might germinate, dissolve into the culture solution, or even mutate into a monster and burst out.
Our research is just as chaotic. Experimental data that should remain constant at 3.74 can suddenly skyrocket to 7.65 the next moment. Is this the truth we've been pursuing? How bitterly ironic!
I would feel somewhat relieved if such an impossible error was due to my own incompetence. But if the Lament has already overturned the very order of this world, what's the point of scientific inquiry?

source_en:
I've always known that I'm useless... and beyond saving. When that monster rampaged through the camp, I was the first to run. Should I really be ashamed for doing that? I just did what anyone would do in that situation.
All overseers like to paint a pretty picture—things like human evolution or venturing into a new era. Maybe the other artificers believe them and think these ideals are worthy of all their sacrifices and efforts, but I'm not one of them... I'm a coward, not a warrior who is willing to immolate myself for an ideal that might never be realized. But... those overseers were right about one thing: the world is coming to an end, and only the strong can survive.
I've heard stories of TD Outbreaks wiping out entire tribes of exiles silently, as if they were dying flames in the ashes of a campfire. I've heard about the horrors that they witnessed in the Tacet Field, horrors far beyond my imagination, and I don't want to end up like them. I don't want to live like a rat hiding in the wilderness, surviving by eating scraps dug out of garbage, and at risk of being killed at any time.
There's also some good news though. The boss said the experiment was successful. If we can control that Tacet Discord, the overseers will start taking us seriously, and we might even be promoted. Maybe... we'll be able to settle down and won't need to live life on the edge anymore.
Stronger. I must become stronger. If I can use the power of a Tacet Discord, then I'll fuse myself with a Tacet Discord. If I can use the power of an Echo, then I'll get my hands on one at whatever the cost. If getting my hands dirty means that I can live for one more day or even one more hour, then I'll do anything without any hesitation.
—I won't let this world chew me up and spit me out until there's nothing left. I won't.

source_en:
April 8
The doctor recommended Fuling receive palliative care at home. Fuling smiled and explained that it wasn't about losing hope, but rather a chance to finally visit the magical destinations we've always talked about exploring together... I understand her illness is serious, but as long as it brings her happiness, I'll support her wholeheartedly. And me? Well, I'm not one to give up without a fight.

April 15
Fuling asked me to map out our journey, and she took on the task of delving into success stories of her illness, pinpointing potential treatment spots. A few of the locations she picked were incredibly isolated. I was worried she wouldn't make it to those places. However, she brushed off my concerns with a carefree assurance, claiming she was perfectly capable and full of vigor.
Not wanting to dampen her spirits, I agreed and promised to take good care of her.

May 1
The famous doctor we visited in Mingting said she couldn’t do anything about Fuling's rare symptoms.
It's okay; we have other options. There must be a way to cure her.

May 30
Despite everything we've tried, we haven't found a treatment that can fully cure Fuling. Her condition has worsened, and the illness has made it difficult for her to travel long distances. To cheer her up, I rented a hologram projector from the Pioneer Association for her. She enjoyed the projected scenery, but I couldn’t ignore the yearning and sorrow in her eyes. She concealed them well, but I sensed them, and it pained my heart.

June 13
Fuling, in her gentle way, had requested snapshots of the landscapes I stumbled upon during my travels. She believed that by seeing these images, she could somehow accompany me on my journey. Despite her well-meaning gesture to console me, her absence left a void that tainted even the most breathtaking views with melancholy.

June 15
Encountered a Tacet Field on my path today, diverting me onto a detour that led me to a hidden lake nestled deep within the forest. 
The sight before me was beyond words—the wind carried petals from the trees, creating a mesmerizing dance of colors in the sky. My camera failed to capture the fleeting magic of that moment. Enthralled by the enchanting view, I momentarily lost touch with reality. 
Yet, as quickly as joy enveloped me, sorrow and fear washed over, realizing that such beauty held no meaning without her presence beside me. 
It felt like fate as I journeyed in search of a cure for Fuling, passing through places we had once dreamt of exploring together. Some spots were meant to surprise her during our planned adventures. 
If only Fuling were here, her artistic touch would breathe life into these places once more; even the most desolate ruins would flourish under her paintbrush.
...If only she were here with me.

June 16
I encountered a strange man in red today. His pretentious attitude put me on edge. Despite my unease, he shared a weird story with me, almost as if it was intentional.
He knew I was seeking a cure for Fuling and claimed to have a way to save her. However, he only revealed half the truth and insisted on me doing him a favor before sharing more details. Honestly, I'm not sure if I should trust him.

June 17
My next destination is Jinzhou, the home of a painter Fuling admired. She is so excited about this. I haven't seen her like this in a long time.
I've discovered the true identity of that man in red. Apparently, he belongs to a dangerous organization that I shouldn't meddle with, but...

June 20
The information shared by that man and his organization was beyond anything I could have imagined. The truth behind that tale, the Sentinel's power to manipulate time, the secret realm in Mt. Firmament... if they are all real, then Fuling can be cured.
According to the deal I made with them, I need to use my identity as an adventurer to find a certain object hidden in the mountain, and this object, as they promised, is the key to saving Fuling's life. They seemed unusually obsessed with it, but their intentions were none of my concern. All I need to do is keep Fuling alive, and for that, I'll pay any price.
I must give it a try.

source_en:
My Dearest Wuli,

How are you? I wonder if you're still continuing our adventure as you read these words.

You've visited several places on our list of future adventures. I intentionally picked them under the guise of seeking treatment for my illness, as you may have noticed. I wish I could go with you, Wuli… I don't have many days left, but I trust you'll find and enjoy the wonders we once dreamed of sharing.

We've traveled through diverse lands, witnessing lives rebuilding from devastation, and immortalizing extraordinary moments for a wider audience to savor. In this world scarred by the Lament, beauty and hope persist, sprouting anew from the depths of despair. This is our quest, and I hope you will carry this essence with you as your journey unfolds.

Our adventures have always been shared with companions. We met, journeyed together for a time, and eventually diverged onto separate paths. Perhaps we will reunite on our next escapade, or perhaps destiny will guide us on divergent routes indefinitely. The bravery to explore and forge ahead will forever reside within us.

This truth holds for our past journey and for the ones ahead for you.

The day will inevitably come when we must bid each other farewell, just as it will when our paths cross once more. So, my love, please, continue your journey... and carry our joint aspirations into the future.

With all my love,
Fuling

My Dearest Wuli,

How are you? I wonder if you're still continuing our adventure as you read these words.

You've visited several places on our list of future adventures. I intentionally picked them under the guise of seeking treatment for my illness, as you may have noticed. I wish I could go with you, Wuli… I don't have many days left, but I trust you'll find and enjoy the wonders we once dreamed of sharing.

We've traveled through diverse lands, witnessing lives rebuilding from devastation, and immortalizing extraordinary moments for a wider audience to savor. In this world scarred by the Lament, beauty and hope persist, sprouting anew from the depths of despair. This is our quest, and I hope you will carry this essence with you as your journey unfolds.

Our adventures have always been shared with companions. We met, journeyed together for a time, and eventually diverged onto separate paths. Perhaps we will reunite on our next escapade, or perhaps destiny will guide us on divergent routes indefinitely. The bravery to explore and forge ahead will forever reside within us.

This truth holds for our past journey and for the ones ahead for you.

The day will inevitably come when we must bid each other farewell, just as it will when our paths cross once more. So, my love, please, continue your journey... and carry our joint aspirations into the future.

With all my love,
Fuling

source_en:
The Temporal Disruption and the Sonoro Sphere became intricately linked because of malfunctions in the Sentinel's Temporal Mandate, making them inseparable. To safeguard against any deviations, my old friend offered to encase the Sonoro Sphere within a specific medium, turning it into our fail-safe plan.

My new apprentice’s Forte of Flame Manipulation is crucial for destroying the Sonoro Sphere, a task that only she can accomplish. On the other hand, my old friend is the only one who can unlock said Sonoro Sphere. Both individuals are vital to the success of our goal. Yet, unleashing the full power of Flame Manipulation would exact a toll far too heavy for a mere child to endure.

It seems this game shall stay unfinished for many moons to come.

source_en:
It suddenly dawns on me that I've been copying her paintings for over a year now. I've employed the same rendering technique, the same wrinkle method, and the same composition. Yet, my paintings lack her vividness, their visions unsteady as well. My Forte mirrors hers closely, only that her work conjures more vibrant and stable visions. I could achieve the same. Once I manage to conjure visions with the same vividness, people will recognize me as the best painter!
...

Mr. Baici, a man who has collaborated with numerous renowned artists, came to visit me. He had heard that I, too, could create paintings that summon vivid illusions. He came to express his admiration and encouraged me to continue. At first, I thought someone had finally recognized my talent. But his true intention was to recruit me into his shady business, buying all Forte works for dubious purposes. I had heard of the Shanyun Art Exchange, but never imagined their dealings would be so unscrupulous. While I did copy those paintings for practice, the choice of what and how to paint was mine alone. These dealers think they can buy me—what a joke.
...

The Shanyun Art Exchange sent me an authentic painting so I could study the vision's frequency. They claim they have superior methods to help me achieve the desired effect if my own Forte fall short. My Forte is not inferior to hers. They simply haven’t seen its full potential. Yet, with the authentic work in hand, progress would indeed be swifter.
Their condition is that I collaborate with them and hand over all my copies. These paintings are mere stepping stones to my success, destined to be discarded. So, why not accept their terms? I don't care what they do with the paintings. They assure me they've been conducting such transactions for years without incident. With such a powerful patron, there should be no trouble.
I'll do anything to make it happen.
...

Having an authentic work in my hands makes all the difference. The frequency fluctuations of the painting have allowed me to glimpse her energy. I need to examine her original painting once more. A perfect replica is just the beginning. One day, I will be the only painter capable of bringing paintings to life, surpassing even her achievements.
...

Why do my paintings still fall short after all this time? They lack her artistic depth! Wait—I think I understand. If I use their method to alter the painting's frequency, I might be able to achieve it...
...

Mr. Baici is truly a connoisseur of art. He says my recent works are nearly indistinguishable from the original. Some have even exhibited power beyond the original piece. I knew it. The gap between us is merely a slight difference in ability. With their technical support, my Forte has easily reached the next level. Surpassing her should be simple, let alone mere replication.
...

No, something is wrong... Why do my paintings attract Tacet Discords? The visions are more unstable now. How is it that her painting has none of these problems? There's something amiss here. I... I just want to surpass her! I never meant to harm anyone! The Shanyun Art Exchange is still not giving me a clear answer... This was not our deal!
...

I'm tired, truly, deeply tired...
I won't create any more paintings that harm others.
This isn't what I wanted!
But they have evidence of what I've done and won't let me go...
What should I do? What should I do?
Can anyone help me... anybody...
I’m not afraid of being caught anymore... As long as I can get out of this...
Help me...

source_en:
//By Bram
I have seen my end. Before death arrives, I... must repent.
I am not a pure scholar.
I envy my colleagues... Victor, Alaia, Vasily, Chen Xuefeng... They all have ideals, and beliefs. They sincerely hope that their efforts will better humanity. They want to surmount the Lament and ward off crises.
I am different. I work for selfish reasons, masquerading my ambition as ideals like theirs. I joined the research on Retroact Rain in Whining Aix's Mire and then relocated to Mt. Firmament, all to prove that time is a river. We are merely carried along by it and someday we will also find a way to go against the current.
Like a drowning man, I grasped at any straw, seeking salvation where none exists... Isn't it ridiculous, Vivian?
I don't know why I have you in my mind at this moment... Or should I say... you never left. The miracles at Mt. Firmament once fueled my unrealistic fantasies. I sacrificed everything and exhausted all the knowledge I had acquired throughout my life, just to bring you back from the dark, hazy underworld, and hold you in my arms once again.
But I failed. My fingers started to tremble, my head grew dizzy, and I could no longer operate those delicate instruments. I see you now, standing by the river, separated from me only by a thin veil. I've been drifting down, and down, and down... But you, you stayed somewhere upstream, for eternity.
Fortunately, I won't have to worry about this much longer. I'm about to run aground, and I hope I have the chance to sail upstream and find you.

source_en:
Date: [––]
Testing, testing… Ah, great! So the recording function still works.
I, Victor Christopher, the last Research Director, am leading this experiment in my own name—no precedent, no animal tests, no ethical reviews. Honestly, making the decision was torture to me—my science ethics is wearing thin. But none of those were possible. I'm running out of time. It's just me and Caleb, that assistant AI, now.
Still, I'm recording what I'm about to do. I'm not recording in proper formatting, 'cause this is but a desperate act by an unresigned old man. I hope this won't bother anyone who should find this memo.
I've set up a few Chronopins—to prevent energy breakdown, I'll overload each of them—which should, theoretically, create a lasting, irreversible time bubble, trapping me inside like an insect in amber. I hesitate to call it immortality—it's more like sentencing myself to life. The only comfort is that my consciousness will be kept still too, so I'll stay sane during this long slumber.
The reason I'm doing this instead of welcoming death with calm is… I have to wait for that one's return.
That one once helped us develop the technology of [data corrupted], helped us reconstruct what was a tiny chip of the Sentinel's supreme power. They showed us a glimpse of a god's world, even if just for an instant. And I just… want to meet that one again, even though they might not give us the answers we long for.
By then, what will that one say to this foolish, dying old man? Will they call me a complete idiot? Will that one compare our research to child's play, with that scorn theirs? Or will they appreciate our work... before our tombs?
I don't know. It's been too long. My memory of that one has blurred. The only part about them that's left in mind is that they were so caring, and so indifferent, at once.
Okay, it's about time. Gotta get in my amber. I'll see you in a million years, my friends, or in a few seconds… They're the same to me.

source_en:
Date: [---].
I am Victor. This is a routine voice journal.
Today is another beautiful day. Most of the researchers have left. They will leave Mt. Firmament. Mr. Bram and I advised them to calm down and at least wait until we resolve the issue of shortened lifespan before making a decision. But they didn't listen.
I didn't leave. Research requires perseverance, which was the first lesson Mr. Bram taught me. He always leads by example. Ha, to him, I'll always be that immature young boy.
Date: [---].
I took some time to create something new: a simple AI. I named it Caleb after the iron-headed thing who traveled with a man and dog in an old movie I watched as a kid. Not many people are left here, so someone has to take care of the minor work. An AI is always useful.
I also created some interesting rock puzzles, powered by the many unoccupied Chronosorters in this place. It reminds me of playing with building blocks in my childhood. Those were the days. However, Mr. Bram doesn't seem very happy. Maybe his age prevents him from accepting too many new things...? Or perhaps his worsening leg condition makes these rock puzzles a hassle for him to navigate.
I don't mind. Life isn't just about work and research, right?
Date: [---].
It is quite enjoyable to educate an AI from scratch. It's like painting on a blank canvas—I need to stay focused to avoid turning a meticulous artwork into a careless scribble.
I answer any questions it raises and write new database entries for it every few days. I teach it everything I know about the world, using the methods Mr. Bram taught me. This feeling... is wonderful. Its camera reflects the world as I see it, and it thinks with my logic, allowing me to examine myself again through its actions.
Date: [---].
Caleb learns quite quickly. Initially, I only intended for it to help with cooking and tidying up the facility. I never expected its potential to far exceed our imagination. It seems that it is time to change its title from "Life Assistant" to "Research Assistant".
Mr. Bram has been ill for several days, bedridden, and unable to go anywhere. I miss the energetic man who used to scold us apprentices one by one. But now I have become a middle-aged man myself, too. It's been days since I last shaved, but it seems trivial now.
Date: [---].
Mr. Bram… didn't make it through that long winter.
Caleb and I buried him on a hill nearby without a tombstone. It wouldn't help anyway, as no one will know who we are or what our names are. People might just laugh about how a bunch of lunatics indulge themselves in illusions when they see our negligible legacy.
Caleb was with Mr. Bram until his very last moment. And Mr. Bram… taught it everything he knew. I understand why.
I once read a story about a man who was determined to level a mountain, despite everyone thinking he was out of his mind. But he made it, with the help of his sons, his grandsons, his great-grandsons, and so on.
I hope Caleb will shoulder this responsibility. I've told it about this. Human life is too short, but Caleb is immortal. It might accomplish what is impossible for us.
I will not live to see that day, but I will do everything I can while I'm alive to press forward. I promise, in the name of Bram, my mentor.

I answer any questions it raises and write new database entries for it every few days. I teach it everything I know about the world, using the methods Mr. Bram taught me. This feeling... is wonderful. Its camera reflects the world as I see it, and it thinks with my logic, allowing me to examine myself again through its actions.
Date: [---].
Caleb learns quite quickly. Initially, I only intended for it to help with cooking and tidying up the facility. I never expected its potential to far exceed our imagination. It seems that it is time to change its title from "Life Assistant" to "Research Assistant".
Mr. Bram has been ill for several days, bedridden, and unable to go anywhere. I miss the energetic man who used to scold us apprentices one by one. But now I have become a middle-aged man myself, too. It's been days since I last shaved, but it seems trivial now.
Date: [---].
Mr. Bram… didn't make it through that long winter.
Caleb and I buried him on a hill nearby without a tombstone. It wouldn't help anyway, as no one will know who we are or what our names are. People might just laugh about how a bunch of lunatics indulge themselves in illusions when they see our negligible legacy.
Caleb was with Mr. Bram until his very last moment. And Mr. Bram… taught it everything he knew. I understand why.
I once read a story about a man who was determined to level a mountain, despite everyone thinking he was out of his mind. But he made it, with the help of his sons, his grandsons, his great-grandsons, and so on.
I hope Caleb will shoulder this responsibility. I've told it about this. Human life is too short, but Caleb is immortal. It might accomplish what is impossible for us.
I will not live to see that day, but I will do everything I can while I'm alive to press forward. I promise, in the name of Bram, my mentor.

source_en:
Greetings, dear friends! It's your old friend Riddle Master D! Or you can just call me Mr. Riddle!
Since you've managed to make it this far, then it means that you're just one step away from my deepest secrets. "Oh, the horror! My deepest secrets! I must not let that happen!"
Gotcha didn't I? Well, quite the opposite! These challenges are placed here specifically designed for curious minds such as yourselves! Enjoy the thrill of these puzzles to the fullest and uncover the treasure I've hidden within!
Oh, goodness. I almost forgot to give you a bit of a hint. Don't want to have you test out each one individually. No, no, that won't do. Now, time for everyone's favorite, the hints:
The mechanisms are marked in four colors: red, green, blue, and yellow. They are numbered one to four based on the order in which they are supposed to be activated. Only one of the following hints is true, study them wisely:
(1) Mechanism No. 1 is red.
(2) Mechanism No. 2 is purple.
(3) Red and purple cannot be activated back to back.
(4) Mechanisms No. 1 & 4 are neither blue nor purple.
Rather simple, right? Better hop to it then! But do keep in mind, that you've only got five minutes to solve this puzzle! Muahahaha!

Greetings, dear friends! It's your old pal, Riddle Master D again! Or you can just call me Mr. Riddle. Whichever you prefer!
Oh, hold on, I've already mentioned that in the previous message. Anyway, there's always the possibility that someone might have missed the previous one and actually finished all 24 attempts before finally getting in. You'll never know!
Anyway. Sorry if you feel disappointed, but as you can see there's no treasure here. Not in the form of riches or anything like that at least. Instead, I have left you with something you may find even more delightful: "Riddle Master D's Latest Horror Riddles—Ultimate Collection"! This masterpiece is the culmination of my life's work, the one and only existing piece in this world! I’m sure this is exactly what you've been searching for!
Hmm? Not interested in books? Only treasures of glistening gold and silver have the power to spur that unyielding heart of yours, you say?
Ahem. Well, I figured as much... In that case, I believe this is a matter that calls for Riddle Master D’s credo: The true essence of a riddle lies not in the reward it conceives, but in the very process of resolve it entails! Did you not enjoy the thrill of the riddles? You would be lying to yourself if you said no. Then that's all that matters, is it not?
I hope you enjoyed yourselves. Until next time!

Hi Rover,

I'm not sure if this message will reach you, but I hope it does.

There's something I've been wanting to tell you, but I can't seem to find the right words in person... To be honest, I'm afraid you might reject what I'm about to ask.

I'd like to give you this scroll of painting. It's not just because you helped me with Mingyan's situation, but also because you freed me from a worry that's been haunting me for years. The Patrollers returned the "Serenity of Xiehua Village" that I drew during the hearing, but I want you to have it now. After all, it's the reason we met, a testament to our shared journey, and a symbol of the courage you instilled in me. In a way, we created this painting together.

My heart will always be connected to this piece, and I must admit, I have an ulterior motive... I want it to stay with you.

<alignright/>Zhezhi

Submitted by: ███████ 
BS 000/1/00094* 
Tethys ID: A-000 (Archived)

...Is the tape running already? Oh, excuse me...

...Target data has been imported into Tethys, and the Stellar Matrix in question is temporarily designated as No. 001. The Matrix's equatorial coordinates in the Tethys System range from 08h 07.5m to 09h 10.7m in right ascension, and from 15.12° to -0.08° in declination...

According to our observations, Stellar Matrix No. 001 contains at least two pseudo-stars with a Lament magnitude exceeding 2.0. This means the source of our target data was destroyed by at least two near-catastrophic events, consistent with our observations.

Detailed data on 001α and 001β will be available after the data source is processed by the Shorekeeper...

...

All our knowledge, whether past, present, or future, pales in comparison to what we cannot know.
Looking back at Solaris-3 from the starry sky beyond, it may look like a mere pale blue dot. 
But it is also... our star. Our home.
Please, what should I do...

Record No. 0595 (Internal) 
Submitted by: Hoda Theophilus Anna 
BS 037/1/99375* 
Tethys ID: K-125 (Decommissioned)
——TOP SECRET——

...Despite our best efforts, we may have failed in ensuring the safety of the city's remaining residents. Despite working with authorities and assisting with evacuation efforts, I can't shake this feeling of being too late.

...It's now 3 PM. We have reached the skyscrapers in the city center, with flames lighting up the northeastern sky. The bridge there seems to have collapsed as well.

We stumbled upon a specialized unit, led by the formidable "Ironclad" Brandon, making their way towards the heart of the Lament-infested zone. We must advance higher... Those dangerous red flowers emerging, they are pushing us towards the skyscrapers, but... the Lament's core is right above us. That... black hole.

This is a war of attrition... Many of those who found us were already beyond saving...

The time is... what, 6 PM? It should be 6 AM. The next surgery is about to start. We are currently gathered in a meeting room on the upper floors of the skyscraper. At this point, we can't afford to be too meticulous. We'll need at least three Peregrine-class gliders to evacuate everyone.

...Only thirteen atropine doses remain, and it's getting hotter here. We are struggling to maintain the patients' body temperatures.

Support! Aerial support! Headquarters! Requesting assistance! Coordinates have been sent to Tethys—support!

...At the very least... evacuating the women, children, and elderly...

It's getting hotter. Brandon and his team haven't returned... Requesting support...
...

I can't... give up hope...

Proposal Date: ████████
Resolution Date: ██████████
Resolution Outcome: Approved - Execution Authorized
Authorized Executor: ██████
————————————————————
In summary, our efforts have failed. Both the ████ system and this unit confirm this assessment.

Over the past ████ years, the disaster has destroyed over 80% of effective man-made structures and killed more than half of the global population. After all countermeasures proved ineffective, the ████ system and this unit began feasibility testing of Plan 3 based on the Tethys Institute's report.

Throughout these ████ years, we have successfully completed the observation, containment, and analysis phases, thus meeting the preliminary conditions required for Plan 3. However, recent data indicate that time ripples generated by the disaster are converging on our current spacetime, with the disturbance intensity increasing in direct proportion to temporal progression. Projections suggest that within ████ years, this disturbance will result in a 15-degree negative deviation from the baseline, likely surpassing it.

Under these circumstances, Plan 3 poses a significant risk: Event A within this spacetime could become an absolute outlier from Event O, severing the causal connection between the two. Such an outcome would be catastrophic, leading to the permanent disconnection of Event O from Event A.

████████████████ ████████████████ ████████ ██████████████████████ ……

Upon entering the execution phase, Instances One and Two will be activated to assist in controlling time and space, respectively. Instance Two, developed from our research on the Sonoro Theory, is particularly optimized for spatial control.

…No, emotions are unnecessary for her function. That is redundant for our purposes. As long as she endures, once we become an absolute outlier, all other concerns will be irrelevant…

As for Instance Two, the Tethys system will oversee her management. There is no need for further concern in that regard.

...
"We've been through so much to get here."
"But the past is just a small part of our story, and I have faith that our future holds even more promise."
That's what I was told.
...
"Do you ever feel homesick?"
Homesick? What is that?
"It's a special feeling, when memories of the past manifest in your mind. Or should I call it... a feeling of nostalgia?"
I can show you whatever you wish to see with a Sonoro Sphere.
"That's not quite what I meant..."
Is that a smile on your face, or... the so-called "bitterness"?
...
"Well... I built it from my memories. I believe it should work."
A piano? 
"It links the Tethys System with the stars, allowing you to control it through sound."
Control stars with sound? 
"Yes, why not give it a try?"
...
"...Many have perished." 
Sacrifice is inevitable when the Lament strikes. 
"What are we truly fighting for? The Lament never ends. What is the purpose..." 
You can rely on me and everyone here. 
You're not alone in this. 
When was the last time you took a break? You need to rest.
"I'm sorry... I can't show weakness in front of them..."
Put more trust in our companions. Their faith in our shared goal won't be shaken that easily.
"Thank you... I'm just thinking..."
"If everything is already predetermined, then when we want to change the course of history..." 
"There's only one way."

Entry No. ███████ (Internal)
███: ███████ 
BS ███████* 
Tethys ID: ███████

...
The kernel used by the Tethys System appears vastly different from our current terminal systems. The primary difference is that Tethys's hardware layer is completely invisible to us, and its software language seems to be from an era beyond our own...

The entire Tethys System's instruction set, source code, and language are highly restricted and not publicly available. We are unable to perform any code-level maintenance because it autonomously manages all tasks... It's as if it were a natural creation or... it is beyond our understanding.

...However, my observations have revealed a few intriguing details. While Tethys's code remains tightly guarded, I detect the presence of a stored-program logic architecture - a tried and true computer structure. This design relies on a central processor to access stored data and instructions and carry out computations...

In other words, the Lament data, which is visualized as stars in Tethys, must flow through a system capable of reading and processing it...

Similarly, Tethys shares the same bottleneck as traditional stored-program architectures: its efficiency is limited by the central processor's read/write speed. Just as insufficient fuel limits a spacecraft's performance...

However, it seems Tethys employs another logic structure that integrates the entire central processor physically, allowing it to handle all instructions and data simultaneously. This necessitates a processor of unimaginable power, one capable of managing the data throughput of something as massive as the Black Shores... Why would Tethys incorporate such a complex logic structure?

...There are too many mysteries and no answers. I can only document what I've discovered, but beyond that, I am powerless...
