source_en:
Applicant: Gardner, Monica
Application Type: Clearance Application
————————————————————————————————————————————
Body Text: 
A causality assessment of the collected data confirmed a normal distribution, with no significant anomalies detected. However, during real-time regional information monitoring, unnatural frequency fluctuations were observed, specifically associated with the access doors.

To verify these findings, a 48-hour real-time data investigation was conducted. Access to the Black Shores system database enabled the correction of anomalous entries and the isolation of a dataset exhibiting characteristics linked to the access doors. Hypotheses were subsequently formulated, followed by a regression analysis and re-simulated modeling based on historical data and relevant theories.

For comprehensive details, please refer to the appendix. Key conclusions from the data analysis include:
1. The intensity of abnormal frequency fluctuations of the access doors is strongly correlated with the sequence in which they are activated.
2. The peak frequency band of these fluctuations bears a high similarity to the high-frequency range of the overlapping section in the current Necrostar frequency history.
3. The transient model of these peak frequencies shows some resemblance to the transient model of an Overclocked Resonator connected to the Black Shores' Terminal.

Based on this, the report confirms that the rumors hold some validity. Among the filtered data, the highest correlation of abnormal frequencies is linked with the grouping of <color=Highlight>Lower Levels of the Hall of Foreign Affairs—Haven of Sprouts—Platform of the Hall of Foreign Affairs</color>.

While no field tests have been conducted yet, further study of the <color=Highlight>sequence and pattern of access door usage</color> may yield significant insights in the next phase.

Additionally, during the on-site investigation, I re-verified the relevant movement path, which was frequently used in past Black Shores debriefing processes. Given Conclusion 3, I suspect this event may be connected to certain historical incidents at the Black Shores.

...In light of these findings, I believe that any potential lead towards locating missing employees warrants serious consideration. Therefore, I formally request higher-level permissions to access historical data for further investigation.
————————————————————————————————————————————
Approval Status: Rejected
Approver: Tethys System
Approver's Comment: "The Necrostar presents a significant hazard. Investigating its associated frequencies could exacerbate these risks. Clearance is therefore denied."

source_en:
[00:01] (Knocking sound)
[00:04] Come in.
[00:09] Hello, I'm from the Engineering Department. Is this—Oh, Ms. Hoda! Ouch—
[00:19] (Sound of collision)
[00:20] Oh no, are you okay? Sorry, it's a bit of a mess in here.
[00:24] No worries, I'm fine. Just stubbed my toe.
[00:30] ...That sounds painful.
[00:32] Yeah, it's one of those pains that really hits you when it happens.
[00:34] Hahaha! You've got a good sense of humor, haven't you? Wait, what's that look?
[00:47] Oh, nothing. I'm just surprised. I didn't expect to see you smile like that.
[01:00] Do I come across as stiff to everyone?
[01:03] Well, not exactly... But you're always so focused at work, so... Oh, by the way, I heard you're managing this room now. This is the demolition approval form. Could you please sign here? The room's set to be demolished next month to make way for a new office area.
[01:36] (A brief silence)
[01:47] Ms. Hoda?
[01:50] I've signed it, but no one's really managing this room anymore, so you don't need to follow the formal process.
[01:58] Well, I heard some of our old employees like to nap here. Just wanted to double-check before construction begins. I didn't expect to find you here... You seem quite familiar with this place?
[02:16] Familiar? I don't know if that's the right word. How long have you been with the Black Shores?
[02:23] One year and three months.
[02:26] Really? Time flies... So, you must have met the Mentor by now?
[02:32] Your mentor? You mean the Modulator? Yes, but I've only seen them from a distance. I haven't really had a chance to talk. Big shots like the Modulator and the Shorekeeper are always busy. 
[02:44] Big shot? You mean my mentor? Ha, sometimes I wonder if things would've been easier for us if they were just a regular member... I actually first ran into them right here. You wanna know the first thing they said to me?
[03:01] Really? Umm, I have no idea... 
[03:06] They asked if I wanted some crispy squab for dinner. 
[03:11] What?
[03:14] Unbelievable, right? It was my first day on the job. Everyone was busy, and I was sitting here, staring at the employee handbook. Almost thought they were one of our cooks. 
[03:39] So, what happened after that?
[03:44] Then Lady Flora, you know, our Mentor's little tail, actually brought some crispy squab over for me. The three of us sat here, ate squab, drank soda, and played cards all night. By the time we said goodbye, I realized all my first-day nerves were gone.
[04:20] It wasn't until the next day, during my formal orientation, that I found out they were the Modulator everyone talked about. 
[04:29] Whoa... That's so cool... I wish it was me...
[04:34] I can still vividly picture Mentor with those paper slips stuck to their forehead—his punishment for losing our card game. I remember the vibrant colors of Lady Flora's flowers, the winning hand I had, and the smell of crispy squab. It all happened right here, in this very room.
[04:47] And it was just an ordinary day in the Black Shores's most ordinary room.
[04:53] ...So, erm, how was the squab?
[04:56] Not good. The cook forgot to add seasoning.
[05:00] (End of recording)

source_en:
I can't believe the simulated civilizations possess self-awareness and the ability to break through reality. 
But how could these simulated beings possibly comprehend their own existence within a simulation? 
Destroying the analysis room, frantically trying to avoid deletion, and breaching into reality—these actions seem like desperate last measures, crying out for help. 
<s>But behind their cries are thousands of virtual lives at stake! Erasing entire civilizations would be nothing short of a massacre!</s>
No! These simulations are merely programmed codes that imitate humans. 
I cannot be deceived by false data. We must quickly fix any errors before they affect the reality.
…

After so many attempts, I've finally managed to keep the core of the analysis system... But... this place is no longer usable... 
What if the erroneous data hasn't been completely deleted? What if it's hiding deeper within? What if the core still has undetected corruption? 
No, I... I can't trust those safety reports anymore... 
Such errors must not happen again. Constant monitoring is needed—at least once a day, no, five times a day... 
But I need time, a lot of time…
…

Greetings, visitor from the future. If you find yourself here, please help me perform one last check.

If there's any leftover erroneous data in the room, make sure to clean it up completely to eliminate potential risk.

Do NOT trust or respond to anything you see on the screen.

The backup analysis room is the anchor I left for you—The data there is absolutely correct.

If the analysis room shows anything different from the backup room, check all data immediately and restore the room to its original state.

Remember, <color=Highlight>recheck both analysis rooms and make sure they are the same</color>. Ensure all data is thoroughly deleted.

The transfer route will always be here.

source_en:
Tucked away in the tempestuous Stormy Sea lies an archipelago known for its lavish Tacetite deposits and as a refuge for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, the Black Shores has fostered strong partnerships with nations across Solaris-3.

The archipelago cannot be accessed from any known lands. Only those recognized by the Black Shores or who have received an invitation and guidance can navigate their way to this hidden place.

Members of the Black Shores who operate abroad, frequently traversing various lands, are known as "Consultants." Those stationed at the headquarters are referred to as "Bloom Bearers." Apart from these fundamental duties, the Black Shores also accommodates a plethora of other specialized roles.

Though the Black Shores openly shares its advanced technologies with its partners, even its own members remain unaware of the true origins of these innovations.

source_en:
Also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, the Tethys System is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. By inputting Lament frequency data—collected both manually and via beacon access—into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe.

The results generated by the Tethys System are projected as a starry sky within the underground of the Black Shores, made possible by multiple Anchors and underground Data Hubs. This has earned the underground region the title "City of Eternal Night".

The Tethys System has no discernible energy source, physical infrastructure, or processing core. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots. In essence, the Tethys System is almost akin to a natural phenomenon, with an origin that remains entirely mysterious.

source_en:
These unique robots, found throughout the Black Shores, serve as the physical terminals of the Tethys System. Their construction and performance capabilities remain largely unknown, yet they possess direct access to the system, second only to its administrator. Within the Black Shores, these robots function both as assistants and tools in the daily activities of its members.

Each terminal has a distinct personality, and the study of these robots has advanced the field of cognitive psychology.

source_en:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament. Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.

Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study and observe them. Malfunctioning matrices, however, are collected and isolated in designated areas to prevent data overflow.
The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.

source_en:
Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.

At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator".

source_en: A mysterious lifeform that rests beneath the Black Shores' subterranean galaxy. Her physical structure and age are shrouded in mystery. In the complicated coding language of the Tethys System, the name "Shorekeeper" also means "Guardian of Secrets". She chose to call herself "Shorekeeper" to symbolize her role in watching over those who venture away from the shores into faraway lands.

source_en:
These stabilizing devices are strategically positioned throughout the surface and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetites that make up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System's virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need to build a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores.

The Anchors are independently developed and designed by the Black Shores, drawing inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores' minimalist engineering design.

PS: Don't look at them, especially in the eyes.
The promised day is at hand. May the Divinity bless and protect the faithful and unleash havoc to the non-believers.

source_en: Bloom Bearer Field Report No. 10826 Authored by: Ariosto Attention Rinascita-based Bloom Bearers: Please follow the advice below in the interest of your safe being. Failure to do so may result in unpleasant repercussions. 1. Rinascita has no center of politics, instead a collection of city-states governs the region. The southern coastal city of Ragunna is the recommended port of entry for Black Shores Bloom Bearers. The "Stormy Sea" between Black Shores and Rinascita is treacherous, exercise extreme caution. Stay on the approved navigation route. If found to be deviating, correct course at once. 2. Strange aquatic TDs inhabit the Stormy Sea. Our current understanding of them is limited as they appear incapable of coherent thought. Do not interact, approach, or touch them. Take evasive action at once should one move towards your vessel. 3. Ragunna, a city-state by the sea, is the city with the strongest link to the Sentinel. This connection is maintained by the Order of the Deep, an organization claiming to act as the Sentinel's representative. The citizens of Ragunna equate Sentinel Imperator to "god," and have erected numerous statues in Their image. Bow and lower your gaze when in the presence of such statues. Do not stare at any one statue for over 30 seconds. 4. Ragunna has one cardinal rule regarding pizza: it does not, and will never, tolerate crownapple topping. Do NOT in any circumstance, add crownapple or gemberry to any pizza served at a Ragunnesi restaurant. This rule must—and I repeat—must be adhered to. Comments Comment 1: I knew sending you to investigate the Somnoire was a mistake! If I read another useless do's and don'ts listicle you'll be re-writing the whole thing. And say goodbye to your performance bonus! Posted by: Mistman Comment 2: Living by the sea… Do the Ragunnesi eat rice from a coral bowl? Posted by: SheepGoBaah Everything I've shared above is based on firsthand experience—gathered by shedding blood, sweat, and tears! In all seriousness. Other than its Common Echoes, the city of Ragunna is also renowned for its "faith" centered around the Sentinel, reinforced via mythologies created by The Order of the Deep to justify the post-lament state of affairs. Personally, I find their mythologies not entirely baseless, as the worldviews espoused are similar to that of the Tethys System. The first inhabitants of Rinascita were refugees displaced by the Lament and Waveworn disasters. Guided by the Sentinel to settle in Rinascita, these refugees were of vastly different backgrounds, cultures, and ideologies. Ragunna's religious and political systems were likely structured around a unifying mono-faith to increase civil cohesion. I encourage Bloom Bearers to approach Ragunna's many rituals and customs with a critical but open mind. I was born in Rinascita, but after years with the Black Shores, upon my return, the change was far greater than I had anticipated. Most notably, the Order now holds absolute authority in Ragunna. I advise all Bloom Bearers to maintain cordial relations with the Order, respect their rules, and avoid confrontation. Given the Order's current stance towards the Black Shores, Bloom Bearers must exercise utmost discretion while in Ragunna, To help Bloom Bearers earn the trust of Order members, I've compiled a few useful examples of how to phrase sentences so they resemble clauses from their Codex. Let me demonstrate: -Oh, mighty lord in black, the founder and ruler of the Black Shores! May I one day be worthy of your talents and devote myself fully to your service! -Greedy KU-Money, reflect upon the error of your ways before the lord's altar and seek redemption. -Praise to Shorekeeper, Guardian of the Black Shores! Your starlight scatters the darkness and banishes all evil. With your light to guide us, we are delivered to salvation! Comments Comment 1: Even if you said that, I do not accept a delay in the report. Posted by: Shorekeeper

source_en: Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition) Many non-initiates misunderstand the Order of Deep and feel overwhelmed by words in the Codex such as "grace," "salvation," "mercy," and "faith." Indeed, never has the Sentinel Imperator revealed Their true form. So why then, are we to believe in Their existence? The chronicles of Rinascita record numerous battles of the Sentinel against the Lament. The ruins and wonders across Rinascita bear witness to Imperator's divine authority. Their destined path created a better world for mankind, leaving us to shape a new future, while They, silently watch over us. We are grateful for Their blessings. We honor Their teachings. We follow in Their deeds by disseminating wisdom that guides all towards good—such is the mission of the Order of Deep. Under Cassilin the Knowledgeable, we have compiled this introduction to elucidate upon the meaning of the Sentinel and our Order. This we hope inspires followers on the path of virtue. We begin with some frequently asked questions: 1. Who is Sentinel Imperator? Sentinel Imperator embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. It is important to note that we acknowledge other divine beings, for They have spoken of Sentinels in distant lands, with powers that control day and night, the flow of time, or all knowledge and wisdom. Without exception, all Sentinels selflessly guide humanity and shepherd civilization. As such, all Sentinels are great divinities. However We believe Sentinel Imperator holds foremost power to "Split." That is, They split the ocean, granting humanity land on which to "breathe." By right of Their providence, Imperator is elevated among all Sentinels. 2. What is the Order's doctrine? This mortal world is a boundless sea in which every soul must swim up to the divine. Life flows in waves, and only by reaching the shore do we reach the dawn of civilization. Our Sentinel is salvation from the gales and tides, is the unity from which Rinascita was born, and is ascension for our souls. The Order's doctrines are thus: “Salvation," "Ascension," and "Unity." - Salvation: By the grace of the Sentinel, Their followers must deliver salvation to others. Nary are we blind to injustice or suffering. We labor to save others from sin. To the wicked, the Order provides salvation, and for the unrepentant, may we exact penitence. - Ascension: To find salvation is to seek ascension. Members of the Order will not indulge Their favor in idle pleasures or desires. All must elevate their spirit through self-discipline or risk sinking into the abyss. - Unity: After granting us Their representation on earth, Sentinel Imperator left Rinascita in our care. Members of the Order are "brothers and sisters," who unite people of faith, regardless of origin or background. Only as one can we fortify ourselves from the perils of the deep sea. The first Primus, Napoli the Second, received a prophecy from the Sentinel: in a distant future, a "Last Wave" shall engulf the earth. Those saved must "breathe," to "ascend" in "unity" on new land, just as we once answered the Sentinel's call and made landfall on Rinascita. 3. Is there evidence to support the doctrine of the Order? Theology is a science humanity has not yet fully understood in theory or practice. The Sentinel guides civilization, and we trust Their word. Throughout the generations, the Order has established the following philosophical precepts. Excerpts from The Philosophy of the Order: Sacred Knowledge (Volume 1: Water): On Origin: Genesis in "Water." In nature "Water" is infinite as it is universal. In the beginning, Sentinel Imperator "split" this world, once a formless ocean, into the realm of land and sea. On Motion: Movement through "Water." The motion of "Water" heats and cools, wets and dries the realm of land. From water, all life was created in the "First Wave" and will end in the "Last Wave." On Revelations: Refractions of "Water." Man's image reflected by "Water" is a strange reality unto himself. So too applies to all reality when water refracts the world unto the Sonoro Sphere. Through reforms by successive Primuses, we have come to emphasize the scientific and practical application of our philosophical understanding. Readers may visit Arito Well in the Square of Liberty to experience the mysteries of "water divination": toss a coin into the well, make a heartfelt wish, and answers you shall receive. We would be greatly honored if this Codex engenders interest in the Sentinel's teachings, and we welcome all to the Order's library, where supplementary literature is available to borrow. While words are a paltry means to express the Sentinel's grand purpose, we nonetheless hope to have adequately conveyed fractions of divine essence. Let miracles recorded in the Codex be "symbols" of infinite, communicable power. Through narratives of common understanding, we envision a world of unwavering faith. Even as the Lament threatens to return, we reaffirm our place and purpose. We pray that believers and non-believers alike will view the text herein as an invitation for communion and reflection. May these words offer insight to us adrift at sea. The paths are many, but with virtue in our hearts, we illuminate a way amidst the waves.

source_en:
Day 15.

Some have begun to question the worth of this endeavor, and the very honor we strive to uphold for Fisalia. Such whispers should have no place here.

We have crossed the ridges of Thessaleo Fells, weathered storms, and dared currents to reach this place, losing a ship on the way. Now, it's time to claim our rewards. The "relic" that has been kept from our family by the Order lies somewhere within these forsaken ruins, and treasures glimpsed only in dreams seem at last within our grasp.

Dario will stay behind. His legs were pierced by a TD and he can no longer walk. We've left him with enough provisions.

The rest of the knights will press on, toward the ruins in the <color=Highlight>southwest</color>.

May we walk ever upon the righteous path.
new_translation_vi: Ngày 15.

source_en:
Day 16.

The pilgrimage chapel is nothing but another empty shell. The knights smashed windows and overturned altars, but not one sign of the relic has been found.

Renzo seems to have lost his wits, staring at the torches and babbling—perhaps a result of the drowning earlier. We can't afford to wait for his recovery. Ennio wishes to keep him with us, but such sentiment would only slow us down.

Our cause allows no room for the weak. Now, a ruin lies to the <color=Highlight>west</color> of this island. That shall be our next destination.

May we walk ever upon the righteous path.
new_translation_vi: Ngày 16.

source_en:
Day 17.

We waded through marshland to reach this waterlogged ruin, only to find more disappointment. The knights are losing faith—some doubt we'll ever find this so-called relic. Ennio, who's as close as family to me, stood against my decision to move on. He accused me of straying from the righteous path.

There was no other way to settle it; we dueled, as the knight's creed demands. He cast the gauntlets over to me, his mentor. Our duel ended amidst a strange howl from afar. When he fell, a part of me fell with him.

Ennio... He was set on the ideals of knighthood but was blind to the cold reality facing our branch of the family. I can feel it now—fortune and glory lie to the <color=Highlight>north</color>. Porto-Veno Castle will have to honor our deeds.

At this point, there's no turning back.
new_translation_vi: Ngày 17.

source_en:
(The edges of the yellowed page are charred)

Day ██.

Our search stretched on and on, and all we found in the storeroom was a worn-out weapon schematic, probably left behind by the Order. Silently, we gathered anything of worth, not speaking a word about the relic. No one needed to—everyone knew. This quest has failed, and all our sacrifice has been in vain. But I don't accept it. The Order must have hidden something here on this island. Where is it?

(Rushed handwriting follows as if penned in great urgency)

Those damned TDs are coming for us. It's only a matter of time before they break through. But I've finally found it.

How absurd! The relic was always here, right before our eyes.

At the grand altar of ██, circled by towering Tacetites.

The howls are drawing closer. Forgive me.
new_translation_vi: (Các cạnh của trang giấy ố vàng đã bị cháy sém)

source_en:
The aromatic fat from the grilled fish glistens as it drips down, adding to the flames of the campfire below.

Mmm! The fat has infused the fish beautifully, and if you savor each bite, you can still taste the freshness of the fish itself. Delicious! A perk of being a fisherman, I'd say!

Nothing slips past you, does it, Joanna? A few days ago, I was actually thinking about quitting. It gets too lonely traveling alone. The Haven's scenery here is stunning, and I thought about building a hut here and waiting to die of old age. Last night, you found your way into my dreams...

Don't worry, I've nearly forgotten your face and your voice. What I haven't forgotten is the promise you made. The one about moving forward and seeing unseen views.

Besides fish, there are so many other delicacies I haven't had the chance to try yet, and places I want to visit. I can't just let it end like this. I'll set off at first light tomorrow.
new_translation_vi: Lớp mỡ thơm từ món cá nướng lấp lánh khi nhỏ giọt, làm tăng thêm ngọn lửa của đống lửa trại bên dưới.

source_en:
Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. Korlacchi. The holy name... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...
new_translation_vi: Mùa đông đã đến. Đã đến lúc nghỉ ngơi và tận dụng thời gian này để rèn luyện kỹ năng kiếm thuật của mình.

source_en: Tonight's banquet is a big deal. It's my first time handling something this important. The higher-ups even had me and Barolo set the password for the lighting controls. But how do I make sure everything goes according to plan? Aha, I've got it—keep the enemies close, just like with secrets. For the <color=yellow>first two digits</color>... I'll go with the <color=yellow>number of trees and chandeliers in the hall</color>. As for the last two digits, that's on Barolo. He took forever setting up the balloons in the hall yesterday. Maybe he was hiding the password in the <color=yellow>balloons</color>? Ugh... still feels a bit off. Better go check everything again.
new_translation_vi: Bữa tiệc tối nay là một sự kiện lớn. Đây là lần đầu tiên tôi xử lý một việc quan trọng như thế này. Cấp trên thậm chí còn bắt tôi và Barolo đặt mật khẩu cho hệ thống điều khiển ánh sáng. Nhưng làm thế nào để đảm bảo mọi thứ diễn ra đúng kế hoạch? Aha, tôi hiểu rồi—giữ kẻ thù ở gần, giống như với những bí mật. Đối với <color=yellow>hai chữ số đầu tiên</color>... tôi sẽ chọn <color=yellow>số lượng cây và đèn chùm trong sảnh</color>. Còn hai chữ số cuối, đó là việc của Barolo. Hôm qua anh ấy đã mất cả buổi để treo bóng bay trong sảnh. Có lẽ anh ấy đã giấu mật khẩu trong những quả <color=yellow>bóng bay</color>? Ugh... vẫn cảm thấy có chút gì đó không ổn. Tốt hơn là nên đi kiểm tra lại mọi thứ.

source_en: You know, as you get older, your memory starts to slip... But here's the good news—I'm only in charge of the last two digits for the light control password. Well, I'll just go with August 9th. It's an important day for me—it's my wedding anniversary with my dear Mathilde, and also the day Padrino baptized our Charlotte. <color=yellow>August 9th</color> it is, then. Perfect for the last digits of the password.
new_translation_vi: Bạn biết đấy, khi bạn già đi, trí nhớ bắt đầu giảm sút... Nhưng đây là tin tốt—tôi chỉ phụ trách hai chữ số cuối cho mật khẩu điều khiển ánh sáng. Chà, tôi sẽ chọn August ngày thứ 9. Đó là một ngày quan trọng đối với tôi—đó là ngày kỷ niệm ngày cưới của tôi với Mathilde thân yêu, và cũng là ngày Padrino rửa tội cho Charlotte của chúng tôi. Vậy thì <color=yellow>August ngày thứ 9</color> là được rồi. Hoàn hảo cho những chữ số cuối của mật khẩu.

source_en:
My dear boy,
 
Leaving you is the last thing I want, but these troubled times force my hand. All I can offer now are a few words on this torn paper.

Stand tall and live your life with pride. Your parents gave their lives for the dignity of art, and you carry the same blood in your veins.

I've sacrificed my freedom in pursuit of the endless mysteries these Echoes hold, but I believe in you—you have a strong heart. Hold on to hope and keep moving forward.

One day, the treasure we have valued deep within the Averardo Vault will bring forth new hope.

With Love,
Ash

source_en:
Subject: Welcome aboard the Echo Train of Averardo Vault!
 
To facilitate your business within the Averardo Vault, we are pleased to offer the Echo Train service. These unique Echoes will swiftly transport you to various areas within the Vault.
 
For your safety, please adhere to the following guidelines:
 
1. The Echo Train is gentle in nature, but please refrain from feeding or attacking it. Doing so may cause it to veer off course or even fall off the tracks if startled.
 
2. During the journey, you may enjoy the view through the train's window. Please do not extend any part of your body out the window. If you find that this rule has already been violated, promptly refer to Rule 6.
 
3. Averardo Vault only contains depositories, storage facilities, and small decorative sculptures. There are no statues or structures with a height of around ▇▇▇, resembling a ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇. If you encounter such a structure during your ride, remind yourself that it is merely an illusion caused by the Vault's enclosed environment and promptly avert your gaze. If you continue to perceive the structure, promptly refer to Rule 6.
 
4. You may call the Echo Train via your Terminal, and it will typically arrive within three minutes. If the train fails to arrive within this time frame, leave the station immediately and report the delay to the Vault staff at the front desk. Do not board any train arriving after the three-minute window.
 
5. The Echo Train within the vault is designed to resemble a fish. It has no limbs, legs, or tentacles. If you notice that the train's appearance deviates from this, do not board it. Instead, call for another Echo Train and wait until the abnormal train has left the platform.
 
6. If you violate any of the above rules, promptly leave the platform and inform the nearest Vault staff. If you have already boarded the train, immediately throw this flyer out the window. The train will proceed to the nearest station, where Vault staff will be waiting to escort you out. Please refrain from engaging in conversation or making eye contact with the staff.
new_translation_vi: Chủ đề: Chào mừng lên tàu Echo của Hầm Averardo!

source_en:
Subject: Averardo Vault Tour Guide (Underground Depository Zone)
 
Welcome to Averardo Vault! We hope you have a wonderful and unforgettable time here.
 
The main areas of the Underground Depository are as follows:
 
1. Precious Metals and Artworks Depository
This section primarily stores valuable metals and rare artworks. Some of the items are displayed to the public on a rotating basis. Below is a partial list of recommended exhibits for this month:

Stern's Ceramic Jar
The beloved ceramic jar of the famous comedian Arthur Stern! After receiving the Laurel, he retired from the stage to focus on the art of pottery. This jar is one of twelve masterpieces he personally painted.
Recommendation Rating: Five Stars!

"Deepening Stars"
The painting of an anonymous artist, depicting the starlight reflected from beneath the abyss. Critics have debated the theme of this piece for years, making it a highly controversial and discussed piece.
Recommendation Rating: Three Stars!
 
2. Echo Depository (Currently Closed)
This section primarily houses Echoes.
Important: The Echo Depository is no longer open to visitors.
 
3. [Data Deleted]
new_translation_vi: Chủ đề: Hướng dẫn tham quan Hầm Averardo (Khu vực lưu trữ ngầm)

source_en:
[Work Log]
 
8:30 AM: Clocked in. Today's task is to perform an inventory check of the artworks inside the depository. Great, let's get to work.
 
12:00 PM: Lunch break. A new guy tried to ask me about the rumors surrounding the "secret cache." It's honestly surprising how long these baseless rumors have managed to stick around. Even if there was some secret cache, it's not like that's something we Level 1 folks are supposed to care about.
 
5:30 PM: Work is wrapping up for the day. On the Echo Train ride back, Jason thought it'd be fun to spook the newbie with one of those corny old ghost stories. Something about a mysterious, unmanned train that only runs at midnight and takes passengers to the Vault's "underworld." There, spirits of the dead rip apart anyone who dares trespass in their domain. I've heard enough of these kinds of stories. If there really were any mysterious trains, I would've seen one by now.
new_translation_vi: [Nhật ký công việc]

source_en:
Bad news. A Chest Mimic somehow managed to sneak into the Vault and has hidden itself among the storage chests.
 
I've already alerted the guards. The Chest Mimic doesn't move on its own, so I suggest you stay away from this room until the guards arrive.
 
(Below the note is a hastily scrawled line in a different handwriting)
 
Don't even think about sending an Echo to inspect those storage chests. They'll just get gobbled up by the Chest Mimic... You really don't want to know how I found that out.
new_translation_vi: Tin xấu. Một Chest Mimic bằng cách nào đó đã lẻn vào Hầm và ẩn mình giữa các rương lưu trữ.

source_en:
[Warning: For Vault Employees with Level 2 or Higher Clearance Only]
 
Due to the security risks posed by Fractsidus activities, the Family has decided to temporarily suspend the Ducat Auction. A date for its resumption will be announced in due course.
 
During this suspension, relevant staff members will be reassigned to other duties. The auction hall will temporarily be repurposed into a banquet hall and ballroom.
 
The official public statement for the suspension will be: "The auction center is undergoing renovations in line with applicable regulations from other regions." Employees are strictly prohibited from disclosing the true reason for the suspension to outsiders. Violators will be considered to have breached confidentiality and will face appropriate penalties.
new_translation_vi: [Cảnh báo: Chỉ dành cho nhân viên Hầm có quyền truy cập Cấp 2 trở lên]

source_en:
Specimen Name: ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇

Specimen Description: A sub-species of the Spearback Tacet Discord obtained from the ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ region. Its strength and agility far surpass that of other Spearbacks. After receiving authorization, the expedition team successfully captured this specimen, with plans to use it for further research.

Specimen Status: Active. A dedicated experimental zone has been established for this specimen by the research team.
Experiment Plan: N/A
Experiment Goal: To reconfigure the frequencies that led to the formation of the specimen's abnormal physique, and attempt to apply the findings to other Echoes in order to enhance their performances.
new_translation_vi: Tên mẫu vật: ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇

source_en:
...We successfully isolated the frequency responsible for the mutation in this specimen. When this frequency was tuned to match another Spearback Echo, it exhibited exceptional performance, far surpassing that of other specimens.
 
Unfortunately, the frequency proved too complex to replicate. The research team plans to secure the Echo specimen within the experimental zone for further combat and endurance testing.
new_translation_vi: ...Chúng tôi đã cô lập thành công tần số chịu trách nhiệm cho sự đột biến ở mẫu vật này. Khi tần số này được điều chỉnh để khớp với một Spearback Echo khác, nó đã thể hiện hiệu suất vượt trội, vượt xa các mẫu vật khác.

source_en:
We found some storage chests that clearly do not belong to the Echo Depository. They likely were left behind during a previous supply transfer.

There are no records related to these chests in the Vault, so their ownership is unverified. The Precious Metals and Artworks Depository has also refused to accept them.

The Echo Depository has no use for these materials, and they take up space here… but for now, there's no other option but to continue storing them here.

(Below the note, in a different handwriting, a hastily scrawled line reads)

These are not Vault assets. Whoever wants them can take them.
new_translation_vi: Chúng tôi đã tìm thấy một số rương lưu trữ rõ ràng không thuộc về Kho lưu trữ Echo. Chúng có khả năng bị bỏ lại trong quá trình chuyển giao vật tư trước đó.

source_en:
(A stack of papers rests here. They appear to be part of an unfinished novel or essay.)
 
...Ziegler was stranded on his private island, with only a coconut tree for company and the occasional Bell Crab scuttling across the beach.
 
Who was he? Ziegler Senior's son? Ragunna's most successful investor? The poor soul who lost everything in a gamble, with all his wealth and titles now gone? A mad artist? A hermit? The unfortunate fool who got caught in a shipwreck?
 
He gazed at the sea, the soft breeze lifting his graying hair while stirring the waves. In the golden glint of sunlight, he seemed to see countless versions of himself scattered through time, broken and incomplete. He felt a loneliness like never before, yet a strange sense of satisfaction.
 
He had no chance of leaving this island. Maybe tomorrow, or the day after, he would breathe his last breath under the scorching sun.
 
He had exhausted all of his miracles. The thought crossed his mind but quickly vanished without a trace. He decided to take some time to observe his island—to engrave all of its details deep into his mind, to fill his fragmented memories with them, and to hope that the coming darkness would not turn them to nothingness.
 
(The writing ends here.)
new_translation_vi: (Một xấp giấy nằm ở đây. Chúng có vẻ là một phần của một cuốn tiểu thuyết hoặc bài luận chưa hoàn thành.)

source_en:
—O Supreme Sentinel, the Great Imperator, I have never questioned you.
 
You led us from the farthest reaches of the sea to this land, teaching us to walk the righteous path and embrace joy.
 
Yet those who claim to be your servants have distorted your teachings. The masses remain silent, while those who stand by the truth are banished here.
 
May you forge our faith into spears, and our suffering into hardened shields. May you… grant us vengeance, or at the very least, a merciful rest.
new_translation_vi: —Ôi Sentinel tối cao, Imperator vĩ đại, con chưa bao giờ nghi ngờ Ngài.

source_en:
Malfunction Report: In the event of an Echo Train malfunction or abnormal operation, there is a possibility that staff members and visitors without Level 3 clearance may be mistakenly taken to this restricted area.
 
Course of Action: All Echo Trains will undergo recalibration, which is expected to be completed within 32 working days. Prior to this operation, a temporary set of instructions for boarding the Echo Train will be issued through flyers. 
 
If any anomalies occur during a ride, efforts will be made to guide passengers to the nearest station, where staff with Level 3 clearance will be on standby to evacuate passengers out of the vault.
 
Although passengers will be unable to enter this area due to insufficient clearance, choosing to disembark here due to rumors about the existence of the "secret cache" could lead to unnecessary complications. Therefore, it is essential to direct passengers away from this section.
 
Comment:
What do you say we create a story? Spread rumors about ghost trains with no return or mutated trains. This way, if passengers notice something unusual, they'll be more likely to seek our help immediately.
 
Response:
Approved. We will include this information in the flyers.
new_translation_vi: Báo cáo sự cố: Trong trường hợp Tàu Echo gặp sự cố hoặc vận hành bất thường, có khả năng nhân viên và khách tham quan không có quyền truy cập Cấp 3 có thể bị nhầm lẫn đưa đến khu vực hạn chế này.

source_en:
This isolation zone was constructed after the completion of the vault. Considering that certain research and specimens might pose security risks, the Family built this isolation zone on the island to house these projects. The zone is divided as follows:
 
Underground Floor 1: Echo Experimentation Area
Underground Floor 2: Item Storage Area (Decommissioned)
Warning: Items in the isolation zone are extremely dangerous. Please do not enter without proper authorization.
new_translation_vi: Khu vực cách ly này được xây dựng sau khi hoàn thành hầm. Xem xét rằng một số nghiên cứu và mẫu vật có thể gây ra rủi ro an ninh, Gia tộc đã xây dựng khu vực cách ly này trên đảo để chứa các dự án này. Khu vực được chia như sau:

source_en:
We ultimately failed to find a way to mass-produce enhanced Echoes. So, this Statue Echo may be the only significant result we were able to achieve. What's worse is that our own Echoes are no match for it in combat, so we haven't been able to collect any combat data.
 
The Family has decided to abandon the research and have us return to work at the Vault. However, I can't help but feel that this deserves a better conclusion. So, I've left behind some equipment capable of collecting combat data, which will be automatically saved to the Vault's server.
 
Whoever finds this, I hope you'll try giving it a go with the Echo. This way, we'll be able to obtain crucial data… Perhaps in the future, this data could be applied to practical use within the field of Echo research.
 
I've also left some rewards behind. If you succeed in defeating this Echo, they are yours to claim.
new_translation_vi: Cuối cùng chúng tôi đã thất bại trong việc tìm cách sản xuất hàng loạt các Echo nâng cao. Vì vậy, Bức tượng Echo này có thể là kết quả đáng kể duy nhất mà chúng tôi đạt được. Tệ hơn nữa là các Echo của chính chúng tôi không thể sánh được với nó trong chiến đấu, vì vậy chúng tôi đã không thể thu thập bất kỳ dữ liệu chiến đấu nào.

…

Nobody can carry on after bearing such a heavy fate. The tragedy deep underground fills us with sorrow. Thus, the wings that symbolize a long journey fold, awaiting the day when the departed will finally find release.

source_en:
The Lifer's Fragility (can be removed with the Stake of Imbalance):
- Growing Loneliness: The Lifer recovers 10% of its Max HP every second after not being attacked for over 2s.
- Desire for Escape: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 25%. Additionally, DMG dealt by the Lifer is increased by an additional 25% every 20s.
- Impending Stalemate: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 20% each time it deals DMG, stacking up to 4 times. If the Lifer deals no DMG within 6s, all stacks will be cleared.
- Decay of Time: The Lifer gains 200% Glacio, Fusion, Electro, Aero, Spectro, and Havoc Resistance. Its Max HP is increased by 25%.

The Lifer's Stability (cannot be removed):
- Chains of Confinement: The Lifer gains interruption immunity when its HP is above 50%.
- Endless Game: The Lifer's Immobilization state duration is decreased by 50%.
- Divine Garden: After taking DMG above 25% of Max HP in a single hit, the Lifer repels nearby enemies and deals DMG to them.

"The Divinity disappeared within the walls one day, leaving only the anguished lifer."
"Follow the paths revealed across the board, where you shall find the Stakes of Imbalance—the shackles that hold the prisoner."

source_en:
Day 16.
They all say that Rinascita's outer sea is riddled with dangers—storms, mist, reefs, and TDs that could swallow a ship whole. Some even claim that the world beyond Rinascita had already died in the Lament long ago, with only our isles left under Imperator's protection.
Pure rubbish.
They've let fear of the unknown take over. They think I'd never dare take a Gondola out to the open waters, saying I'm just a river rat full of big talk. Well, I'll prove I'm no coward like them!
Today I caught a fine fish. A good sign, I'd say, and a nice meal. Now I have the stars above to guide my way, what's to fear? Storms? Waves? Bring them on! As long as I have my Gondola, there is no place in Rinascita I can't reach.

source_en:
A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 

As an island nation reborn from the Lament, Rinascita was long isolated from the rest of the world by relentless disasters and vast distances. It wasn't until recent times that the Rinascitans opened new maritime routes. Ships laden with their spices and minerals began to sail across the world, and in turn, new treasures and wealth began flowing back to Rinascita, enriching its shores.

Rinascita is famed for its unique "Common Echo" technology, which allows Echoes to persist in physical form within the radius of the Genesis Nexus. Through this technology, the Rinascitan people have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."

Rinascitans place great value on the identity derived from bloodlines, and their society is built upon a deep reverence for family ties. For them, the welfare of the family always takes precedence over individual fate.

source_en:
Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel carrying Their divine will.

In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. The city is adorned with magnificent sculptures and paintings at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life. Under the leadership of Fenrico, the current Primus of the Order of the Deep, a series of laws have been enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.

At present, Ragunna's daily affairs are overseen by the Order of the Deep, while prominent families such as Montelli and Fisalia also hold significant influence over the direction of the city.

source_en:
The Carnevale is the grandest celebration of Ragunna, where the masquerades never end, wine flows like rivers, and music pulses through the night. During this time, people cast aside the weight of the world and surrender to the wild, unrestrained joy of the festival.

The Carnevale's origins trace back to Sentinel Imperator, who once guided the people of Rinascita. It began as a tribute to Their grace, a celebration where laughter and performance became the purest form of reverence.

At the peak of the Carnevale, the Sentinel is said to manifest and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel." This honor grants the bearer the privilege to commune with the Sentinel and hear Their wisdom.

Yet, a decade ago, the Carnevale was brought to ruin. A monstrous sea beast, rogue Echoes, and Tacet Discords swept through the festival, turning revelry to ruin. Only when Primus Fenrico intervened did the chaos subside. He proclaimed it was Sentinel Imperator's divine retribution for the Ragunnesi's indulgence and forsaking of their faith. Since then, the Carnevale has not been held again.

source_en:
Those deemed faithless by the Order of the Deep are sent to voyage upon the Pilgrim's Sail, following the ancient path of those who once braved the mist and maelstrom seeking the Sentinel's guidance.

The Order claims that only Imperator can grant absolution to these transgressors. They must endure a grueling pilgrimage, suffering both body and soul until their repentance is complete. At the journey's end, it is said Sentinel Imperator will offer them forgiveness and the promise of new life.

But no one in Ragunna has ever heard of a faithless "pilgrim" returning from this sacred journey. The Order asserts that they reach Imperator's place of dwelling and devote themselves to Their service for eternity. While many still harbor doubts, few dare to openly challenge the Order—none wish to suffer the same tragic fate as those branded Fools.

source_en:
A common boat-shaped Echo in Ragunna.

Ragunna's intricate network of waterways, coupled with its narrow streets and rugged terrain surrounding the city has made Gondolas the preferred choice for transporting both people and goods. For most Ragunnesi, they offer a peaceful, smooth alternative to the discomfort of navigating crowded streets or bumpy countryside roads.

Beneath their unassuming exterior, Gondolas are highly intelligent and deeply emotional. They communicate through distinct vocal frequencies, expressing their moods or responding to the command of their gondolier. Some, through specialized training, can even climb waterfalls.

source_en:
The Order of the Deep worships Sentinel Imperator. In Ragunna tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly envoys, entrusted with guiding the people in Their divine word.

The Order is led by the Primus, and the current Primus, Fenrico, has declared himself the "Enlightened One," the Resonator of the Sentinel. After the last Carnevale, he proclaimed to have discovered the way to commune directly with the Sentinel.

Beneath the Primus, the Priests oversee the rites and sacred duties of the Order, while the common clergy, known as Acolytes, spend their days poring over the Codex, spreading the Sentinel's teachings throughout Ragunna.

To uphold divine order, the Order commands three distinct branches:

Order Tribunal: The Order's secular judicial body that handles civil and criminal matters between families and commoners.

Chamber of Discipline: The Order's executive arm that commands the military to enforce the law. The Chamber heavily employs Echoes in combat, and its enforcers are often called "Inquisitors."

Order Penitentiary: The Order's religious court that trials heretics and faithless who question and defy the divine teachings of the Sentinel.

source_en:
One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit. The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.

The Montelli family also took the lead in introducing and developing Reserved Terminals across Ragunna. While the Order of the Deep dismissed these Terminals as an inferior mockery of the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, the Montellis secured the Order's approval to continue their development in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange.

Unlike the more traditional families, the Montelli family values emotional bonds and shared ideals above bloodlines and social standing. They advocate for the distribution of opportunities and wealth, believing that riches are worth more when they circulate. Though often ridiculed by traditional families as "nouveau riche with Shell Credits running through their veins," the Montellis take no offense—on the contrary, they wear the label with pride.

One of the most powerful, and certainly the oldest and most traditional, families in Ragunna, renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison. Their devotion to Sentinel Imperator is clear to all who know them.

A faction within the Fisalia family believes that the Montelli family's embrace of openness and the privatization of Echoes is a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, threatening to lead Ragunna into an abyss of heresy. They have directly opposed the Montellis through various means, shaking the family's longstanding image of dignified respectability. Yet, the head of the Fisalia family residing in Porto-Veno Castle seems disturbingly indifferent to the repercussions of these bold and provocative actions.

They have directly opposed the Montellis through various means, shaking the family's longstanding image of dignified respectability. Yet, the head of the Fisalia family residing in Porto-Veno Castle seems disturbingly indifferent to the repercussions of these bold and provocative actions.

source_en:
The Sentinel of Rinascita. In the faith of the Order of the Deep, They are often depicted as a being with the upper body of a horse and the lower body of a fish.

According to Ragunna's legends, Imperator guided its settlers to this promised land, offering them sanctuary from the threat of the Lament.

Though Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the world, They maintain a connection with the people of Ragunna through the Laureate of the Carnevale, delivering divine guidance in the form of oracles.

source_en:
In Rinascita, most Echoes can exist independently from Reserved Terminals within the radius of the Genesis Nexus. They are known as Common Echoes.

In Ragunna, the Order of the Deep governs the allocation and use of these Echoes. The people of Ragunna revere them as divine gifts, even as envoys of Sentinel Imperator. They treat them as friends and trusted allies, incorporating them into every aspect of daily life. This deep, symbiotic bond with Common Echoes is what has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."

source_en:
Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty.

Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.

source_en:
The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It manifests as a dark, swirling mass of clouds that gathers and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents like a waterfall. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field.

There have been two significant Dark Tides in Ragunna's history. The first, according to the Order of the Deep, was stopped by Napoli II, the first Primus of the Order. The second was quelled by the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys.

source_en:
The Nimbus Sanctum is the only Sonoro Sphere that exists in the physical world, where mist and clouds are formed by concentrated Remnant Energy.

The sea of clouds that envelop the Sanctum is believed to be the lingering aftermath of the first Dark Tide. As the mist rose, it gradually submerged the former headquarters of the Order of the Deep, the Seminary of the Forgotten, forcing them to relocate to the Cathedral of Mercury in Ragunna City.

Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. Many pilgrims, drawn by this tale, journey here in search of inner peace.

source_en:
The Remnant Creature dwelling within Nimbus Sanctum. Legend holds that it was Lorelei's power that restrained the violent sea of clouds, sparing Ragunna from flooding.

Lorelei has the ability to cleanse the dark frequencies within the clouds, but she is not immune to their corrosive influence. As they accumulate to a breaking point, Lorelei will eventually become the Queen of the Night, unleashing her wrath upon all life that comes near.

source_en: A vault built by the Montelli family on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.

source_en:
The Fools who survived the dragon's assault—whom the Order refers to as the "pilgrims"—drifted on the warm currents, eventually finding refuge in a vast cavern on Penitent's End.

There, the Fools formed a troupe, determined to one day expose the truth hidden by the Order and return to their home. To achieve this, the troupe wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.

For years, they have awaited the return of the Carnevale, hoping to expose the Order's secrets through their performance, claim the Laurel, and earn the chance to commune with the Sentinel.

source_en: In Ragunna, becoming a lover of spirits is far easier than steering clear of them. Every recipe holds a tale, and every tale is traded for a drink. You'll always find something that speaks to your soul—if you can decipher the "codes" of wine. *What follows is an exclusive selection of wines from Montelli *Drinks and Descriptions "Blues Hour" Hey, I've got a deal to talk about with you, but we must wait till the night falls to bring it up. "Crimson Mambo" A burning pain, a spreading warmth, and numbed senses. You're not battling colossal beasts but waging war against life's tribulations. Raise your glass to our hero; at least you've earned this toast. "Golden Years" The past has undergone a long fermentation, turning into this sweet, lingering, taste in your throat. Speechless, you sign and then take another sip, reminiscing the good old days that will never return. In moments like these, I'm the best listener you could ever have. "The Rules of Silence" The very first rule that all Montelli members must adhere to, something etched in their bones and blood, as cherished and unshakable as their beloved families. Alas, you've ordered this; it seems someone needs a "kind" reminder. *You may have noticed that there are no prices on the menu. Nah-uh, that's no oversight. Here, drinks are measured beyond mere coin. *At the right moment, with the right person, come see me here. Remember, the bars in Ragunna are forever open to whoever wants to order.

source_en: Feeling a bit tired of drinks? Ragunna's bars also offer a selection of delightful snacks to refresh your palate. Unlike those drinks full of "codes," these are snacks are simple—and complimentary with drinks. Snacks and Descriptions *St. Domingo Chocolate Smooth and rich, this chocolate teases your taste buds with the bittersweet harmony of orange jam and wine, leaving a lingering aftertaste. *Earl Grey Cake The black tea-infused base, combined with the refreshing scent of citrus, delivers a mellow flavor that lingers without a hint of bitterness. *Wine-Soaked Cherry Sabayon Ripe, crimson cherries bathed in a creamy blend of eggs and sweet wine, lightly caramelized for a smoky finish. The dance of warm and cold, sweet and fresh, tipsy and revitalizing… an unforgettable harmony of flavors. Thank you for your generosity and patronage.

source_en: (Drums beat solemnly as Fleurdelys, Brand, and other Acolytes enter, each carrying relics.) Fleurdelys: Lo, the Dark Tide hath momentarily receded, granting Rinascita a fleeting respite. I doth thank each of you for your unwavering commitment through these trying days. Brand: My lady, you honor us beyond measure. We serve not only thee but also the Sentinel. When Rinascita hangeth by a thread, how could we place our own survival above our sacred duty? Besides, thou didst stand beside us, taking up arms and leading us to face the Dark Tide, endured grievous wounds without faltering. Thou art the very embodiment of the purity and devotion of an Acolyte, and of the courage and valor of a warrior. Inspired by thy fortitude, we are prepared to offer our lives without hesitation. Brand: Yet the glimmer of light emerged in the north was swiftly quenched by the merciless Dark Tide, which surged back like a ravenous beast, devouring our lands. Our soldiers fought valiantly, only to be swept away by the relentless onslaught. Though the tide hath withdrawn for now, its return is as certain as fate itself. I fear that, over time, our strength may falter… Fleurdelys: …Perchance there remains a glimmer of hope. Fleurdelys: Not long ago, as I lay unconscious from my wounds, I was trapped in a relentless nightmare for three days and nights, lost in darkness without end. But in the depths of that abyss, a faint light didst appear—They spoke unto me. Their words of boundless mercy soothed my scarred soul and awakened me. They revealed that the wound upon Their own divine body fuelleth the Dark Tide, and only through a shared bond of strength could this wound be healed. I have been called to journey eastward, to reach the high heavens in the mist, and thus break the curse of the Dark Tide. Brand: Praise be to Sentinel Imperator! My lady, if this oracle is true, and thou hast shared thy strength with the Sentinel… could it be that the prophesied Enlightened One hath already walked among us? Fleurdelys: I dare not presume such things. When I received this divine calling and assumed my role, the Sentinel didst not reveal the truth of the Enlightened One unto me. Brand: But my lady, thou hast wrought countless miracles, lifting our people from suffering and offering prayers on their behalf. To us, thou art the Blessed Maiden. In our eyes, thou art no less than the Enlightened One. Fleurdelys: Be that as it may, I have my duty to the Sentinel. Now that I know the path to Their throne, it falls upon me to stop the curse at its very root, for Rinascita cannot bear further sacrifice. Brand: Indeed! Guards, prepare to escort the lady! Fleurdelys: Nay, please stay. The Dark Tide still looms in the north, and the guards are better placed to protect the people than to accompany me. Brand: But... Fleurdelys: This is my path to walk alone, as entrusted to me by the Sentinel. This journey may well be my last. If I do not return, it will be thy duty to tend the Order's affairs. (Acolytes begin to weep softly in the background.) Fleurdelys: Grieve not. This is the path for which I was chosen. Should fates be kind, the Dark Tide will soon vanish, and Rinascita will flourish once more. When that day comes, remember me in joyful songs rather than somber laments. I verily believe the Sentinel wouldst wish the same.. (smiles warmly) Brand: As thou dost wish, my lady. If thou art to travel east, Priest Fenrico is stationed there with a detachment of the guard. He may be able to aid thee. Fleurdelys: Behold, dawn breaketh anew. No matter how long the night, the daylight cometh. Though our path be fraught with tears, we shall walk it with songs and courage. This is Rinascita's greatest treasure and humanity's strongest shield—our unbroken will, unwavering faith, and unquenchable hope! (exits) Brand: May thy sword be blessed, to calm storms and sever the tides! (exits) To Be Continued Author's Note: This work is incomplete, a humble draft that needs further refinement. According to historical records, the Dark Tide ended shortly after the Blessed Maiden set out. Yet, the Blessed Maiden herself… left us forever, returning to the divine embrace. It is said that she held back the Dark Tide through her martyrdom, using the very last of her strength. These fragments of history inspire endless curiosity: Who, truly, was the Enlightened One? Was the Blessed Maiden indeed the Enlightened One the prophecy suggested? What happened after her departure? Do the legendary high heavens exist? And what could have inflicted such a wound upon the Sentinel that even They could not heal? These mysteries remain unanswered. As all stories are but interpretations, this is merely one version. Should anyone possess further historical insights, I welcome your critique and guidance. My gratitude in advance.

Vault Brochure 1
Why choose us to manage your wealth?
Our unmatched brand influence!
As the leading bank in Rinascita and a successful commercial institution with decades of history, Averardo Bank has earned the trust and loyalty of high-value clients and financial peers both locally and internationally. Our unparalleled brand influence allows us to offer exceptional distribution and underwriting capabilities in investment banking, along with an extensive network of high-value capital resources. We are dedicated to helping clients achieve their long-term growth strategies through diverse market investments. In Rinascita, Averardo Bank is your only choice.
Comment: Got it. The only bank in Rinascita, young but with the Montellis' endorsement. Whether you like it or not, you're stuck with them.

Vault Brochure 2
Why choose us to manage your wealth?
Our personalized customer service network!
Averardo Bank's customer service spans the entire country and is actively working to establish branches across Solaris, ensuring that your travel and spending remain seamless wherever you go. With our future overseas branches, we can stay informed on financial developments throughout Solaris, enabling us to help clients identify investment opportunities with high growth potential and excellent returns, while fostering connections that cater to the diverse needs of our clients.
Comment: Got it. It's like a gym promising nationwide expansion and asking you to sign up for membership, claiming they'll provide you with a personalized plan from a trainer.

Vault Brochure 3
Why choose us to manage your wealth?
Our unmatched financial strength!
Averardo Bank's capital ranks first in Rinascita by market value, demonstrating outstanding financial strength, high liquidity, and substantial capital. This enables us to provide strong assurances for a wide range of client needs, including financing, loans, and underwriting, while also ensuring a robust ability to withstand financial risks.
In addition to our financial services, Averardo Bank operates Rinascita's largest auction trading and collection initiative and is actively seeking external investments. Our dedicated in-house team has successfully completed numerous infrastructure projects.
In short, Averardo Bank is Rinascita's financial system itself, boasting unmatched resilience in the face of risks.
Comment: Got it. It's basically saying "I'm so rich that I can do without your money."

Vault Brochure 4
Why choose us to manage your wealth?
Our exceptional talent pool!
The strength of Averardo Bank lies in our vast reserve of exceptional talents. We have attracted a diverse group of professionals with extensive financial experience from across Solaris. With a team defined by high ethical standards, creative problem-solving, strong R&D capabilities, and outstanding performance, we are able to swiftly adapt to the dynamic market demands and provide the best services in Rinascita. Our expert team offers clients professional, tailored investment advice that aligns with their best interests, ensuring the security and growth of their financial assets.
Comment: Got it. You pretty much scooped up all the banking talents from across Solaris.

Vault Brochure 5
Why choose us to manage your wealth?
Our name.
Montelli. Our name is Montelli.
Comment: Got it. "We are the Montellis, so you should put your money in our bank." That... does make a case...

For those brave enough to venture to the place that inspired the adventurous plays during the Carnevale, exploring the legendary realm of the mighty "giant," listening to the songs echoing from the sea of clouds by the water, or following in the footsteps of knights in pursuit of honor and justice will no longer be mere fantasies. In Egla Town, travelers can immerse themselves in breathtaking waterside scenery, observe the majestic migration of Tumbleyaks, and watch windmills spin gracefully on the plains, while bathing in the golden light of the setting sun. Alternatively, they can simply enjoy a peaceful afternoon tea and indulge in century-old delicacies, all while being surrounded by the vibrant colors of blooming flowers.

[Dreamy Destinations] Nimbus Sanctum!
In this edition of [Dreamy Destinations], we journey to the mesmerizing Nimbus Sanctum hidden deep within Whisperwind Haven. A highlight of the enchanting Gondola cruise, the sea of clouds has long been a must-see destination, captivating visitors with its ethereal, dreamlike vistas.
Yet, few are aware that the Atrium of Reflections—often depicted in romantic tales—is not merely a creation of fiction, but the ruins of the highest spire of ancient Ragunna. To save its people, Napoli the Second invoked a miracle, turning the Dark Tide into the very sea of clouds that graces the land today.
The forgotten ruins of old Egla Town are now submerged beneath the sea of clouds.

[The Journey is the Destination] Embark Today!
It's worth noting that, although the reason remains unclear, the water level of Nimbus Sanctum has been steadily rising over the past decade, forcing the residents of Egla Town to move to the higher ground in the north.
Once, this area was a barren, undeveloped land, scattered with exposed boulders, and known as the Whisperwind Barrens.
However, the resourceful people of Egla Town began to build windmills that turned day and night, drawing water from the lower regions to nourish the land above. Their efforts transformed this rugged place into the thriving Whisperwind Haven we see today, where crops and flowers now flourish in the breeze.

[Column Memories] Voice of Travelers!
Your Egla column hasn't been updated since last Carnevale. It's just the same article over and over. You guys can't afford to pay the writer or something?
Could it be that no one's interested in Egla Town? Really? Am I actually right?

(A short novel published ten years ago.
"An outrageous best-seller, banned by the Order three times!"
"Only one-tenth of readers truly understand it—are you one of them?"
"Incredible! The Russellian's satire remains as insightful as ever, even after all these years!"
So reads the editor's recommendation page… Clearly, this book stirred up quite a bit of controversy a decade ago.)

Far out across the stormy waters filled with jagged ridges and giant beasts on the surface of Solaris lies a group of small, unregarded islands. On this archipelago, the exiles-descended cultures are so amazing that they still think a unified thought is a pretty neat idea. These islands have—or rather had a problem, which was this: most of the people on them were unhappy for pretty much of the time.

After retirement, I kept thinking back to that afternoon when my friend and I first met.
Ford Percival. He was an alien.
On his first day in Egla Town, he ate ten baton bread without paying anything. Before the Divine Envoys could punish him for theft, I quickly paid off his debt.
Since the prayer, the Oracle of Mercy had wandered in my mind in search of something to connect with—until I met him, the poor outlander. He must have been starving.
"Hi, I'm Ford. I'm an alien. I'm analyzing your weapons. Quite odd components."
He said after I saved him. "And what is this place?" he continued.
An alien? Oh, I'd heard this kind of tale once from someone who claimed to be from a federation. He said Solaris was actually a living tomato—a tomato that could turn, breathe, even dance. And aliens, apparently, were from other tomatoes, living or dead.
"Egla Town," I replied.
"Egla Town, good. Wait, what is that?" He pointed at the windmills in the distance.
"Those are windmills. A cluster of Cyclop windmills, Briareos." Born and raised in Egla, I replied almost instinctively.
"C-Cyclops! Ah, I know about those! I've seen them before! But my stars—you actually managed to kill them? How did you people pull that off? Are those auto-rotating arrays made from their dead bodies? And what exactly is Briareos? A cooling device? A propeller engine? Or something to open up a network channel?"

(Continued)

After hearing my explanation, the self-proclaimed alien Ford seemed completely fascinated by the Cyclops. His emotions became so agitated that he plopped down on the ground, muttering some unintelligible words while pointing at the windmills in the distance.
So it was true—no matter where they came from, no matter what "tomatoes" they hailed from, anyone who laid eyes on the scenery of Egla couldn't help but fall in love with the chivalric literature.
So I straightened up, took three steps forward, and adjusted the nonexistent necktie, then explained graciously, "Exactly! That's right! Once, a righteous knight guided us to defeat the giant. Before that, all the people and Echoes in Egla Town were driven to the high ground in the south, fleeing from the giant's threat. Now, that oppressor lies buried beneath the sea of flowers. We built majestic windmills to irrigate the flowers and the farmlands, and named our past home Briareos, in honor of that knight's heroic deeds!"
After hearing my speech, Ford sat frozen on the ground, as if ten thousand Cetus the Tidebreakers had roared at him all at once, shattering his perception.
After a long pause, he asked me in disbelief, "Do you still have knights here?"
What did he just ask me?
Praise be to Imperator!
I could finally deliver the ranked No. 1 answer in the Top 10 Most Satisfying Moments for Egla People.
Putting on a solemn expression like the Acolytes of the Order, I envisioned a halo of nobility above my head, envisioned the almighty Imperator spreading wings before me, envisioned myself crowning a laurel at the Carnevale, envisioned standing in the grand church, wielding a sword as I was knighted, relishing the reverent gazes of the noble lords of Ragunna!
I replied, stressing each word with great emphasis:
"OF COURSE—"
"However, there are too many outsiders who seek the path of knighthood. Are you confident enough to accept the trial?"
The alien named Ford, whose Tacet Mark was blinking along excitedly, quickly grabbed my calf and shook it furiously, as if clinging to a log in the midst of a drowning. He cried out, "I am! I am! Please guide me to the legendary knight! As long as I can return to the planet Russel and save my hometown, I am willing to pay any price!"

(The trial chapters end now. Please make a purchase to continue reading.)

(A feature on the culinary traditions of Ragunna.)

[Top Chef's Super Secrets]
Imagine yourself asking anyone on the streets of Ragunna, "Which restaurant is the best in Ragunna?"
Six out of ten will answer, "Trattoria Margherita!" Three will point to the family restaurant downtown, and the last one will say, "It's the place where the soft-tailed chef works!"
That's right! Such is the clout of Trattoria Margherita in Ragunna!
Amazing!
But what many don't know is that Trattoria Margherita is actually a family-run restaurant inspired by traditional Ragunna cuisine. From our investigation, we found that Egla Town still preserves this classic culinary tradition to this day. To maintain the special flavors of her dishes, Miss Margherita even takes time off to gather ingredients in Egla Town or Riccioli Islands!
Now, you might be wondering: "What? I can understand why Miss Margherita would go to Riccioli Islands for the fish harvest, but Egla Town? Isn't that a backwater town? And can the cuisine of Egla really be called Ragunna cuisine?"
Indeed, life in Egla isn't as thrilling as in the bustling Ragunna. People there live quietly, following the rhythm of nature. The town's trade and logistics are tied to Ragunna City. The people rise with the wind and rest by it, living a life shaped by windmills, wheat farms, and pastures.
But that's exactly why, for hundreds of years, the cuisine of Egla has remained unchanged. Here, the original flavors and cooking techniques of Ragunna have been preserved—using windmills to process crops and cooking food in traditional ways.
"This way, the ingredients and the food are especially precious! The cheese made from local pastures is creamy, and the meat is tender and flavorful! It's the perfect food to fill your belly!"
Miss Margherita commented during our interview.

[Comments from Special Guests]
Former Tax Envoy of the Order: The traditional cuisine is a remembrance of Rinascita's past. To forget it is to betray our heritage!
Orlando the Gourmet: The old man earlier sounded like he was chanting a slogan! What traditional cuisine? The bread from your town is as hard as a lethal weapon!
