Former Privy Councilor's Notes (Part I)
...

At dawn, the Primus and I stood to bid farewell to the Pilgrim's Sail as it prepared to depart. Both the crowd and the acolytes watched with reverence as the believers boarded the ship. Only the most devout and courageous among them were chosen to embark on the Pilgrim's Sail, destined to meet the Sentinel in the distant sea.

For countless ages, Sentinel Imperator has rarely lingered in any one place, choosing instead to roam the seas, aiding vessels on their journeys. The Sentinel's guiding light has always led those lost upon the waves, helping them find their way back home or seek new lands for settlement. The Order believes that to face the storms and tides in search of the Sentinel's heavenly voice is one of the greatest honors a soul can aspire to.

Yet only those with practical experience can grasp the immense cost of each pilgrimage. Taxes and provisions are drawn from the commoners, skilled workers and sailors are taken from prominent families, and seasoned captains and chief mates are hired at great expense. All who embark on these treacherous seas are devout, but only those truly blessed by the Sentinel return with the promised glory and honor. Reflecting on history, the number of such fortunate souls is vanishingly small.

I have never questioned the purpose of the pilgrimage. My only concern is the immense cost it demands. Can we, in good conscience, allow these devoted believers to embark on a journey that burdens both mind and body? And as for our new Primus... What are his thoughts on this matter?

I looked to my side, surprised to find that my former seminary classmate, Lord Fenrico, had his face shrouded in a strange shadow.

...

Former Privy Councilor's Notes (Part II)
...

How has it come to this? After a sleepless night, I retreated to a secluded prayer room, seeking solace as I lay my confession before Sentinel Imperator. My hands trembled as I put these words to paper.

For a time, the Order ceased organizing large-scale pilgrimages, and the burdensome taxes were lifted. Though the people of Ragunna still honored the devotion of those who once sought the Sentinel across the distant seas, the Pilgrim's Sails had become a relic of the past. But everything changed after the bloody Carnevale... No, in truth, the shift began even earlier than that...

I still remember when the Primus delivered the order for correction, and I dutifully transcribed it: the Order would send violators of doctrine aboard the Pilgrim's Sails, stripping them of all official identities and setting them back onto the path of pilgrimage. Who could have foreseen that an act once meant to embody faith would come to serve as a form of punishment?

"The power of punishment and indoctrination shall be returned to the Sentinel," the Primus proclaimed to the assembled crowd. "Those transgressors who embark upon the pilgrimage in sincere repentance will, by their journey's end, be absolved of all transgressions and granted the Sentinel's forgiveness."

Yet no one truly knows if transgressors can fulfill their salvation, for no one has ever returned from the pilgrimage alive. "Those who commit acts of foolishness shall be sent to the Pilgrim's Sails"—this has become a steadfast law of the Order Penitentiary. Vandals defacing sacred statues, disloyal acolytes distorting doctrines, and even troupe members crafting satirical comedies—all have been condemned to the Pilgrim's Sails for their acts of blasphemy. Recently, however, familiar faces have joined their ranks, faces of those who had openly questioned the Primus's decrees.

I could have sworn my integrity on their faith and character, yet I stood by and watched as they were sent aboard the Pilgrim's Sails, doing nothing. No, it's no longer fitting to call them the Pilgrim's Sails. The common folk have given them a more appropriate name—the Fool's Sails, a vessel filled with those who have committed foolish acts.

Oh, Primus Fenrico... Is this the dream world you so passionately spoke of in the seminary?

...

Former Privy Councilor's Notes (Part III)
...

I was surprised at how calm I felt upon hearing the sentence from the Order Penitentiary. Perhaps my heart had grown as still as that of a dead person.

At dawn, like others before me, I was escorted by the Executors to board a Fool's Sail. Before the ship set sail, I glanced back at the port, only to find the Primus absent. Just as I expected, that man, now in control of unmatched power within the Order, has no need to concern himself with a fool stripped of his identity.

The Fool's Sails are nothing like the Pilgrim's Sails of old. Gone are the smooth, spacious decks and well-maintained sails. Instead, all I saw were rickety planks, loose screws, and splintered masts. The narrow cabins clearly lacked food and fresh water. I stared blankly at the other pilgrims around me. For now, we still manage to maintain some semblance of decorum and restraint, but I know that, before long, this ship will become nothing more than a cage filled with rampaging desires.

And even if we do reach the so-called destination, what awaits us there?

I once read the investigation reports sent back by the expatriate acolytes. That Penitent's End, shrouded in mist, is littered with the wrecks of Pilgrim's Sails. During those fateful voyages, the Fools who braved the storms never met the Sentinel. Instead, driven by the sea's undercurrents, they were cast ashore on that island, where the eerie glow of phosphorescence mingles with an unmistakable aura of death. I've even heard whispers of something far more terrifying lurking there, and the "Fire of Judgment"—a force so dreadful that even the Privy Council dares not speak of it.

...

Food is running out... Last night, someone lost control again, trying to lock themselves in the cabin to hoard the dwindling supplies...

O great Imperator, if you can hear my prayer, please grant us your final mercy through a storm. Absolve us from our misery, and let us... find peace at last.

(The remainder of the notes has been blurred by the seawater and is unreadable.)

source_en: A Transgressor's Transcript (Part I) In the ancient era, long before Ragunna was founded, the distant seas of Rinascita were the Realm of A Thousand Islands. At that time, the Fisalia family was already well-versed in the ways of the ocean. We extracted toxins and medicines from deep-sea plants, harnessed vast underwater resources, and reveled in great fortune and widespread renown. Later, with the assault of the Lament, the civilization of the archipelago teetered on the brink of destruction and our family became one of the founders of the Ark, embarking on a quest to find a new settlement. The journey across the sea was treacherous. The fleets of the Ark were either swallowed by thick fog or torn apart by fierce storms. Yet, our family's Ark, guided by a heavenly voice, led the fleet to a lush archipelago, following the faint glow of a distant lighthouse. One of those islands would later become what is now Ragunna. The newly founded Ragunna was still in a state of flux. To strengthen the family's rule, our family head declared that the manifestation of ▇▇▇▇ was a symbol of the deep-sea faith and a response from the marine divinity to our devotion. This proclamation proved to be successful. As the number of believers grew, so too did the stability of our family's power. Later, some fishermen claimed that they had been assisted by ▇▇▇▇ during their fishing trips. This entity, long known as the Giant One, had existed for ages. Its shadow beneath the sea guided Ragunna's fishermen and fleets, helping them weather storms and bringing in harvests far greater than before. The Fisalia family was the original ruler of Ragunna, and we also laid the faith foundation of the Order. Yet, why have generations of family heads chosen to conceal this history? Why can't I remember Its name? Cursed be it, the wound... it is throbbing again. Something must be wrong with the air... I must find a safer place. The soldiers will never think to search for me in the tower. I must document this secret history... before it slips from my mind entirely... A Transgressor's Transcript (Part II) The fishermen referred to the shadow in the sea as ▇▇▇▇, and they would call upon its sacred name to receive its aid. Small miracles began to accumulate, forming a powerful current of faith. The common folk grew increasingly convinced that the Giant One was, indeed, ▇▇▇▇. As the family began to investigate, they were shocked to discover that these miraculous occurrences differed greatly from those recorded in the past. So, what was the true form of the Giant One the people had placed their faith in? And what, exactly, was the true object of our devotion? This mysterious faith was quietly reshaping the history of Ragunna, and it even threatened our family's control over the Order of the Deep. Only the Ark forebears and our family heads knew that ▇▇▇▇ should be the true form of ▇▇. Yet, with the preaching of the Order, the common folk, unaware of the truth, began to place their faith even more in ▇▇▇▇. Meanwhile, rumors spread that the true form of ▇▇▇▇ was that of a fish-like deity. What's even stranger was that those who heard these rumors began to dream of ▇▇▇▇ in the form of ▇▇. Is this text truly the same record I once read in the secret chamber of the family head? I have an unsettling feeling that my hands are writing down the history about ▇▇▇▇ on their own. Beneath the tranquil surface of the sea, a giant dark shadow loomed, and my fishing boat felt like a mere sampan before it... Impossible... That impure, blasphemous form could not have been the object of my faith all this time. I must reveal the truth to the world. Yet, the doctrines proclaimed by the Acolytes were tainted by a dark mist. Everything related to ▇▇▇▇ began to twist—its statues, its anecdotes, and even its proverbs... No one has ever suspected this mass hallucination. No one has ever resisted the dissipation of the form, for "every drop of water will eventually return to the sea." Who is speaking in the "head" on my neck? Silence, you blasphemous thing! Where's my pen? No, it's in my hand. But is it truly my hand? Why is there black... blood dripping from it? Many members of the Fisalia family were tormented by strange nightmares... They all saw the giant fish shadow beneath the sea and awoke in terror, screaming. The ancient blood still flows within me. IT is here... IT is everywhere... Some abandoned the family, becoming devout believers of the Order. Some ventured to Septimont and never spoke of the faith again, while others settled near the seaport, growing detached from the other forces. Oh, the poor Fisalias—once powerful, once surrounded by allies—reduced to this. Cast away the innate fears, and I no longer doubt that It is ▇▇▇▇, and ▇▇▇▇ is It—they are one and the same. In the depths of reason, I feel an indescribable joy. O my glorious Fisalia, the shadows of my people are approaching, guiding me to the deep sea. It is calling me. Praise be to ▇▇▇▇.

We extracted toxins and medicines from deep-sea plants, harnessed vast underwater resources, and reveled in great fortune and widespread renown. Later, with the assault of the Lament, the civilization of the archipelago teetered on the brink of destruction and our family became one of the founders of the Ark, embarking on a quest to find a new settlement. The journey across the sea was treacherous. The fleets of the Ark were either swallowed by thick fog or torn apart by fierce storms. Yet, our family's Ark, guided by a heavenly voice, led the fleet to a lush archipelago, following the faint glow of a distant lighthouse. One of those islands would later become what is now Ragunna. The newly founded Ragunna was still in a state of flux. To strengthen the family's rule, our family head declared that the manifestation of ▇▇▇▇ was a symbol of the deep-sea faith and a response from the marine divinity to our devotion. source_en: Excerpts from The Hammer of Heresy (The pamphlet presents several radical opinions that appear to reflect the theories of an extreme school of thought.) What is witchcraft? And what is its true nature? The power of Resonance wielded by Resonators is known as a blessing from Sentinel Imperator. Devout followers of the Order are granted this blessing by adhering to its precepts, allowing them to channel the divine force through mortal bodies. Witchcraft, however, arises from vain desires—faithless souls, drawn by Leviathan, form a contract to practice forbidden arts. In doing so, they forsake the divine blessing bestowed upon them at birth and abandon their humanity, transforming into witches who seek to taint the mortal realm with profane power. The Divinity has shaped our world, and all that we hold dear flows from Their blessings. Yet witches, seduced by the Arch Enemy, pervert these divine creations into impure, disgraceful entities, crafting a false Resonance with them. The enemy's mark upon these witches is proof of their transgressions. With the aid of the Vessel of the Enemy, they can even transform into Tacet Discords, posing a grave threat to Imperator's faithful followers. Caution is essential, for anyone who craves freedom and worldly desires is vulnerable to becoming pawns of Leviathan. Thus, we must regularly cleanse and exorcise such souls. If we allow these heretics to grow unchecked, wielding their tainted power to defile the mortal realm, they will inevitably bring the Dark Tide upon Rinascita. It is the Order's duty to guide and govern them, ensuring they align with Imperator's divine will. Should they refuse to join the Order, swear loyalty to Imperator's statute, or diligently uphold its teachings, their misguided fate will be set right by the Pilgrim's Sails. We shall pray for them day and night, that they may be saved by our Sentinel Imperator. Praise be to Imperator. The Spy Network of the Order the Deep Ah, my friend, my companion on this quest for freedom and truth, I implore you—open this pamphlet only in a secure place, away from prying eyes. What I am about to reveal is crucial to your safety. Learn now how to identify the spies of the Order the Deep and evade their grasp. All Echoes bearing a golden halo upon their heads are spies of the Order the Deep, serving as "Angels." They are always seen alongside the Acolytes, serving as the Order's minions to take out the heretics. Rinascita, the Land of Echoes? Ha... not even the greatest satire could ever truly capture the utter absurdity of the reality we endure. First, you must beware of those lantern Echoes, known as Lucerna. Though they may appear harmless, they possess the ability to reveal so-called heretics hiding in the shadows of the night. Their light can illuminate the path ahead, yet it also serves as a blinding weapon, causing one to lose their sense of direction. There was once an instance where someone used Fae Ignis's Echo ability to remain concealed, only to be exposed under the unforgiving glow of a Lucerna's light. Next, there are the most commonly seen plaster statues, the infamous La Guardia, the most loyal guardians of the Order. Without commands from the Acolytes, they stand motionless, like silent statues. However, if you find yourself pursued by La Guardia, do not waste time fighting them. Instead, focus on locating the Acolyte of the Order Penitentiary who is issuing the command. Among all these minions, the most detestable is Vox Sanctus, perched high atop the church buildings. They serve as the Order's guards of honor. While they cannot move freely, they use their instruments to preach false doctrines day and night. These sermons infiltrate the souls of the Ragunnesi, poisoning their thoughts. Can you imagine that the children of Ragunna are forced to hear this nonsensical preaching the moment they are born into this world? Oppression by force may still leave room for resistance, but in Ragunna, how can one escape the spiritual chains that seep into every corner of life? A Letter of Complaint on Heresy Esteemed Lord Acolyte, I, Charles Tornatore, hereby report a heretical action—an underground troupe by the name of Panacea, which has dared to reenact the banned play The Flying Ragunnesi, adding numerous malicious metaphors and imagery of blasphemy. I have transcribed the following lines to the best of my memory: "The Primus's words are like pickled spells. Even a Gondola will tingle upon hearing them." —From Act I, Scene 1 Can't the baton bread in my hand be strong enough to smash our enemies of faith? —From Act I, Scene 3 (Note: This line, spoken by an Acolyte, degrades the Order's holy instrument, referring to it as mere bread.) By Imperator above, please witness our love, as beautiful as the morning light. —From Act II, Scene 1 (Note: This line marks the elopement of the male and female protagonists.) ... I regret that I cannot recall all the blasphemous lines from the play. How dare these individuals defile our noble faith in such a manner? Though they hid behind masks during the performance, I was able to identify them by their forms and voices. It is no surprise that they serve the Montelli family (A detailed list of names is attached). Praise be to Imperator.

source_en: The Old Codex of Holy Rituals Chapter 2 Verse 17 2:17 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] And lo, from the storm, the mass heard the voice of Imperator. 2:18 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] And Imperator said, Come ye forth, to the east. 2:19 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] And Sentinel Imperator cast forth a light through the rain and the waves. The mass followed the light and sailed through the mist and the storm. 2:20 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] And the light, it came from the lighthouse upon the distant archipelago, where the warm currents meet, and where spices grow, and where golden fruit trees abound. 2:21 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] But from the mist behind them, dreadful Tacet Discords did pursue and tread upon the thunder, and the people cried out in wailing. 2:22 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] Then said Sentinel Imperator, I shall bring salvation. 2:23 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] And the Genesis Nexus cast forth a radiant light, and the Tacet Discords were swallowed up by the lighthouse. And when Sentinel Imperator called them forth once more, they became Divine Envoys. 2:24 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] And Sentinel Imperator said, wherever the Genesis Nexus shines, there shall the Divine Envoys dwell. The Genesis Nexus shall be my hand. I am the lighthouse of Rinascita, Sentinel Imperator. 2:25 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] For hundreds of years, the multitude hath followed Their precepts. 2:26 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] The Divine Envoys have shown their strength to uphold Their will. 2:27 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] To the followers, regard these as Imperator's blessing and spirit. 2:28 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] Love the Divine Envoys, as ye love your family, your brothers and sisters, and your neighbors. 2:29 [The Codex of Holy Rituals] We carry out the holy sacraments in memory of this. The New Codex of Holy Rituals Chapter 5 Verse 2 5:03 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] They desired to deliver the Oracle, and so They inscribed the sacred words upon the oak tree, and from the Oracle, the first Viscum Berry did grow. 5:04 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] The berry is the essence of Imperator's wisdom. Partake of it, and your eyes shall be opened, that ye may discern between good and evil, and hearken unto its precepts. 5:05 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] Such is wisdom. 5:06 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] They turned the Dark Tide into a sea of clouds, and they cleansed the damaged Nuvola Fruit tree. 5:07 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] The healing resin is the sacred tears; it mends and restores. Breathe in the Mastic Nuvola, and the divinity within shall mend the frailty of humanity. 5:08 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] Such is divinity. (The next two lines seem to have been smeared and are not legible.) 5:09 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] The third sacred meal ascended to the heavens with Them. Such is the transgression of the Fisalias. 5:10 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] They taught us to prick our fingers with ▇ ▇ ▇ and to mix the ▇ ▇ into the sacred wine. And so shall we be as brothers, and none shall be set apart. 5:11 [The New Codex of Holy Rituals] Such is the spirit. The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation Chapter 1 Verse 9 1:09 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] On that day, Napoli's brows and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were as a flame of fire. 1:10 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] And They granted unto Napoli the lantern, like bronze glowing in a furnace, and the lantern echoed with the voices of the Divine Envoys. 1:11 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] Napoli lifted the lantern high in his return, like the sun shining in all its brilliance. 1:12 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] And the Tacet Discords of the Dark Tide bowed before him. He raised his right hand and spoke to the people: "Fear not. I am the Enlightened One of Sentinel Imperator. I am the first and the last, the beginning and the end. I can hear Their voice." 1:13 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] "I died, and behold I am alive forevermore, and I hold the keys to Heaven and Hell." 1:14 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] "Behold the light in my hand. The Lantern shall be the authority that connects us with Imperator." 1:15 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] Let who has ears hear: 1:16 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] And I heard, by the choirs and the trumpets beside Sentinel Imperator, a voice saying unto me, "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this." 1:17 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] At once I was in the spirit, and there before me was a throne on the sea. And a Divine Envoy stood forth and proclaimed, Who is worthy to take this lantern and let its light shine upon the world? 1:18 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] Then I wept greatly, for before the throne of Imperator stood the Divine Envoys, some appearing as though they had been slain, others covered with spikes. Then I heard Imperator say in a voice like thunder, "Come!" 1:19 [The Codex of Holy Rituals: Revelation] After this I looked, and behold, a white horse with only half a body. It commanded me to lift my lantern and pray, that people may come to know one another and be granted victory upon victory.

source_en: A Comprehensive Study of the History of Ragunnesi Drama (with Commentary) A Comprehensive Study of the History of Ragunnesi Drama: The Evolution of Tribal Cultural Fusion and Faith Systems Written by: DeLillo Quentin Proposed Grant: Ragunna Dramatic Association Regional Research Project - Aspire Scholars Grant Avinoleum Theological Seminary, Ragunna, Rinascita Abstract: This paper reviews recent research trends and developments regarding the origins of drama culture in the Ragunna and Septimont regions, with a particular focus on advancements in the "archaeology of drama" over the past decade. Drawing on the diverse research and perspective studies from the New Federation in recent years, the paper also incorporates insights from Huanglong's archaeological experience in studying historical relics. The case studies selected focus primarily on classic plays and significant historical events. The findings suggest that Ragunnesi drama culture originated from narrative performances that documented the history and life of island tribes. The epic begins with pastoral plays that draw on the primitive beliefs and customs of various tribes during the Age of a Thousand Islands. As the story unfolds, these diverse narratives converge under the guidance of Sentinel Imperator. The author employs the perspectives of the Divine Envoys to provide Imperator's view, allowing the characters to assume their roles in classical plays. Throughout the work, recurring symbols of religion and totems appear, echoing metaphors commonly found in traditional plays. The use of these theatrical elements has helped establish the epic as a beloved classic, cherished by both officials and commoners in Ragunna. Furthermore, it embeds the author's profound reflections on the will behind the Oracle delivered by Sentinel Imperator, as well as the social changes occurring in the region of Rinascita. ...(Some of the pages are missing) One of the most commendable scenes in The Golden Bough is the concluding Scene 3, where five storylines dramatically converge at the climax of the Carnevale: the Holy Forest of the Fagaceae Peninsula, the Order of Ragunna, the Keepers of Secrets in Thessaleo Fells, the successor of the governor in Septimont, and the gladiators, all merging in a grand finale. In this scene, the author masterfully interweaves characters and plotlines, capturing the unique allure of a grand historical tragicomedy. This convergence in Scene 3 has served as a template, inspiring countless plays thereafter. The scene's influence owes much to its intricate plot design, which displays a skillful technique that sets a standard in narrative structure. Beyond the theoretical framework of the work itself, this design—where each element reflects the core theme and draws from historical settings—has solidified this epic as a timeless classic, maintaining its relevance and reverence across cultural shifts in literary history. (See Note 23) The Golden Bough is recognized as the earliest work of art to connect tribal folklore with the Sentinel (see Note 24). In the climactic Scene 3 of the Carnevale, the five masks stand together, each pursuing their own faith, when Sentinel Imperator descends from above, bestowing the laurel upon the chosen Enlightened One—the main protagonist on stage. This ritual has since become a lasting cultural emblem in the hearts of the people of Rinascita. From this scene onward, every heroic journey must conclude with the ritual of "being laureated," whether the hero takes on the role of an actor on stage or a playwright behind the scenes during the Carnevale. Laurel and Sword (Part II) Laurel and Sword: On the Divine Imagery in The Golden Bough Journal Title: Ragunna Sea Breeze Drama Society Research Journal Category: Literary Studies, Literary Theory, Theater, The Golden Bough (Continued) The reason for Sentinel Imperator's descent at the climax of the Carnevale in The Golden Bough remains an open question, one largely unexamined in the epic itself or in related research. Historically, the prevailing view in the Seminary held that the Laureate must be the individual who most aligns with Rinascita's ideals and resonates with the Sentinel—not driven by dramatic passion or ulterior motives. For a long time, this perspective dominated studies of The Golden Bough and the broader field of Laureate literature, with the laurel seen as a symbol of immense honor and the embodiment of Rinascita's collective will. (See Note 25) However, following the cultural events after the Seminary incident, the Laureate's symbol and performances are now seen as expressions of the Sentinel's divine will—the guiding force behind delivering the Oracle and unifying the doctrines. The image of laurel has also come to represent this sacred intent. The author raises an intriguing question: given this interpretation, could the selection of the Laureate itself be seen as an indoctrination of freedom—a concept seemingly at odds with The Golden Bough? Can freedom, once indoctrinated, still be considered freedom? ...(Some of the pages are missing) [23] Charlie Welbeck, "The History of Reforms on the Rinascita Drama Aesthetics," published by Avinoleum Theological Seminary Culture Journal. [24] Mario Quentin, "A Study on the Evolution of Drama Costumes and Stage Design," published by Foreign Culture Studies Publishing House. [25] Cosimo Sorrentino, "A Study on the Readership of The Golden Bough," published by Ragunna Dramatic Association.

Timeworn Logbook 1
Logbook_Number_#00
Mom, have you ever seen a Nimbus Wraith? I saw one for the first time today, and it was incredible.
I'm so excited. I don't really know who to share this with, so I'm writing it down here.
Today feels like a real turning point for me.
Starting today, I'm working for the Montelli family. I'm part of the Montellis now, and from now on, people will call me by that name.
The gate to Rinascita has finally opened for me.
Even though I'm in a cabin right now, thousands of miles away from home, as long as I'm working under the Montelli name and wearing this uniform, maybe one day I'll have my own place in the Montelli Quarter in Ragunna.
Mom, I think I finally get why the Montelli name is so well-known across Rinascita.
While other noble families sell positions or goods, the Montellis sell hope.
I'm about to get really busy, and I'm adjusting to the job just fine. The only problem is there's just me as the security guard on board, so there's no one to talk to.
I'm going to work hard, and when I come back, I'll bring you to Ragunna so you can enjoy life here too.

Timeworn Logbook 2
Logbook_Number_#17
Mom, I miss you.
It's pretty misty here, and whenever it's like this, I can't help but think back to when I was little, back when we were together.
We used to live in a house out in the countryside. It was a thatched cottage, and in the summer, I could hear the dried hay on the roof crackling as the sun beat down. In the winter, the walls would get damp.
Inside, the house had a narrow hallway that led to the kitchen, where a broken lightbulb, somehow always mysteriously fixed, hung from the ceiling. The exposed wires were wrapped in black tape.
Along the hallway were two rooms. I slept in the smaller one, the one on the north side. The gauzy curtains, printed with the sacred verses of the Order, always felt a little eerie at night. When I couldn't sleep, I'd sneak out to the narrow hallway. It didn't matter if I kept my eyes open or closed. With my back against the damp walls, it was pitch black, and I couldn't even see my own breath.
The wind tried to sneak in through the cracks, and the door frame seemed to shrink. The old wires were starting to tear, and the damp air pressed against the bricks. My hair brushed against the wall, and behind it, a patch of quilt slowly shifted. All these sounds tangled together in my head, floating from my ears to my skin, then rushing back inside, shaking my bones with a soft, mesmerizing tremor.
I can't shake this feeling of dampness that echoes in my mind. Today, it's here again.
I just passed through the misty barrier on our route. It felt like an unsettling dream.
But don't worry about me. The safety manual says this mist can cause hallucinations, but it's harmless. I've made it through safely. Now, I need to check the inventory again, just in case someone took something while I was dreaming.
I really miss you, Mom. Don't forget what I promised. Once I've made my name here, I'll bring you to Ragunna.

Timeworn Logbook 3
Logbook_Number_#29
Mom, don't worry. I'll be home and see you soon.
The day before yesterday was so cloudy, and I bet the Nimbus Wraiths were feeling pretty gloomy. We weren't supposed to set sail, but with the auction coming up, I have to make sure the item gets delivered on time.
This mission was given to me by the Montellis, and I can't let them down.
It's a bit of a detour, but since all the ships have already left and the Order sent Lucerna on board, I think it should be fine.
Don't worry. The Montelli family added more people to the crew, and with the Order's presence, everything will be okay. Yeah, it'll be fine.
I should tell you something to lift your spirits. Once I'm done with this job, I should have some time off to come and visit you.
Even though my job keeps me in the cabins, I get to see a lot of interesting things along the route.
Here, they don't use words like sunny or cloudy to describe the weather. Instead, they use emotions, which is kind of interesting, don't you think?
When it's "happy," we get to see rainbows, and the Nimbus Wraiths even dance under them.
When it's "gloomy," like today, it's cloudy, and we usually get to take the rest of the day off.
A "forced smile" is when it's sunny, but with a hint of rain. At times like that, the train picks up speed on purpose, and some of my colleagues will start telling loud jokes from the back of the train.
When it's "sorrowful," it rains, and the train moves very slowly.
"Unhappy" weather means thunder or strong winds. On days like that, we definitely take the day off. I just sleep through it.
And then there's "angry" weather, which is the scariest. The entire sea of clouds turns red. If we encounter that in the middle of the journey, our superiors make us wear soundproof earmuffs to work.
According to the route map, we'll be passing through a place called the Atrium of Reflections. I'd never heard of it before, but the seniors say we usually avoid it unless it's absolutely necessary.
I'll be careful, though. Don't worry about me. It's just a small challenge. Tough jobs need to be done, right?
As long as I put in the effort, I know I'll get the reward I deserve. Just wait for me, Mom. I'll bring you to Ragunna.

Timeworn Logbook 4
Logbook_Number_#31
Mom, when I get back, can I just hug you for a bit?
I've gone through the entire safety manual, but I didn't find anything about the situation I'm facing right now.
Do you remember, Mom? When I was little, and the wind picked up at night, I was always scared. It was actually because of the gauzy curtain in my room. It had the patterns of people praying in the Order embroidered on it. When the night breeze blew, the shadows of those figures would flutter as if they might break apart.
I thought I saw them in real life just now. A group of people was kneeling by the side of the train, as if they were praying with their heads lowered.
They were staring at the train, and I couldn't bring myself to look back. They were mumbling something... I finally found the soundproof earmuffs.
It's okay. Maybe I'm just too nervous. The Lucernas from the Order are still here. They'll figure something out.
By Imperator above, we will arrive safely.
(The words are illegible due to being soaked in water.)
...Mom... I will... bring you... to Ragunna.
By Imperator above
By Imperator above
By Imperator above
By Imperator above... I'm safe!
(Trembling handwriting)
I made it! I'm safe now!
But what exactly... are these things...?

source_en:
... very few people, including those within the Montelli family know when the Vitreum Dancers first appeared, even though these unobtrusive, unremarkable Echoes have long served the family. In fact, most of the Montellis do not know of Vitreum Dancers as anything other than their domestic security detail. Thus it remains easily overlooked that no two Vitreum Dancers are alike.

Knowledge gleaned from the stained-glass artwork found in the ruins around Ragunna suggests that Vitreum Dancers were once Tacet Discord frequencies. They appear in stained-glass art along with general depictions of The Order's religion. To this day Montelli explorers have yet to find two identical panes of stained glass. The Order's artists took pains to alter the composition of panes that depict the same story or motif. This suggests that the frequencies of modern Vitreum Dancers each contain unique information, much like their Tacet Discord forbearers.

According to the book "The Wealth and Legend of the Montellis," the origin of the Vitreum Dancer dates back in history to a time when a Montelli ancestor received the Laurel during the Carnevale from Imperator who then instructed him to go to a tower abandoned by The Order. Upon his return, he would not divulge what he saw and forbade all Montellis from approaching the tower again. Undoubtedly this Montelli ancestor brought back the very first Vitreum Dancer. On his deathbed, his last words were that the Sentinel's Oracle would not exert influence over Montellis at present, but would determine their future course of events.

And with that the tower was barred to all subsequent Montelli, and as the family's cohort of Vitreum Dancers expanded, the legend of their origins faded into obscurity.

source_en:
...We still haven't found it today.
 
Such a large creature can't easily hide its tracks. Until we discover the location of its next appearance, we must not approach the shore, and no storm can stop us.
 
The roaring sea, the storm as black as the ink spewed by a dying squid, the deck swaying in the tempest, masts drifting towards the shipwrecks in the Forgotten Sea, sailors with faces weathered by time, as deep and cracked as the ocean's trenches, the hundred-meter-long octopus... And we, the cursed hunters who pursue it to the ends of the earth.
 
Think about it, what do we truly seek? I'll wager you this coin nailed into my leg.
 
Now I will tell you how we shall achieve victory. We will chase it, across the Stormy Sea, through the Forgotten Sea, past every island, both named and unnamed, to the ends of the earth. Its blood and oil will make this coin worth a fortune.
 
You, the spearman from the East, when you offer your spear to the gods, will you hesitate? Will the spear that once drank the blood of gods falter when facing the ocean? Come, raise your weapons high and cross them before me, just as you would in the arena! Let me see what glory you will embrace upon the waves!
 
Bring me wine! Come, let us swear an oath to riches, to our dreams, to all that we've left behind!
 
What we seek, what I seek… is that moment.

source_en: I saw it. There is no doubt. That long horn, dripping with the pitch-black blood of the sea. It has to be it. The boat we launched was capsized, its aft mast broken, and seven spears were lost. Many people were frightened and urged me to turn back... No, I will not stop. Of the seven spears, four were shaken off, but the other three lodged in its body. I saw them in its back, and the shattered crystals fell into the sea. This is day fifty-five. We are not chasing it; rather, it is standing in our way. Don't you understand? Only by killing it can we leave this room and reach the end of the infinite sea, to the place promised to us by the sails. Think! We have conquered every sea! From the Tacetite-eating Wyrm of the New Federation to the memory-devouring Dreadcurl Cuttle of the Forgotten Sea... How many of these things have I killed? Have we killed? Now this thing is in front of us! Every dream and thought that crosses your mind should be how to kill it! Give me that pipe, you old smokestack. I've walked through the haze with you all...I tell you, it took one of my legs, and I'll take it back from its heart! I have already seen the day it dies. Its blood will burn away in the sea, its flapping fins will droop, it will flip over, and finally, patches of milky white and deep red will finally appear... Then, everything I promised you will come true. You will have everything that is mine, be it money, oil, or faith—though I have no faith in any gods. You can take it all, even this ship. We will kill it. We must kill it. This is my fate, your fate, and this ship's fate. Now, I will extinguish your fire, whether it is the fear in your heart or the smoke in your pipe.

source_en: Impossible. Blessed by "Divinity"? I refuse to believe it. It is we who conquer the sea, not it! When storms tear the mast apart, and rocks smash the keel, where is Divinity's voice then? When we haul ropes and tighten sails, where is Divinity's guidance? We conquer it. It does not bless us! No, I will never yield. No god, no matter which one, can ever fulfill my revenge, our revenge and fate! Do not be cowered, do not be deceived! What others promise us means nothing. Only what we seize from the merciless sea matters! Prayers and blessings will not calm these waters, it is we who are the masters of this sea! Never stop! Even if it summons the entire ocean to fight against us, we must still complete our conquest! We must prove, beyond a doubt, that we are the true masters of this sea! Hoist the sails, ready the spears, and tighten the winches, lads! To the whirlpool! This tempest is the great wave pushing us forward, and this fierce wind only feeds our flames! Do not stop! Sail into the storm! Even if it means we must dive into the dark whirlpool and the abyss!

source_en:
"Closer! Closer! Aim at its wound!"

"Its body glows! Hit the glowing parts!"

"Those are stones, you cabbage head! Our spears can't break that!"
 
"Hard to Port!!!!"

"Lower the mainsail! Curses, we're in deep water now! Keep the mast out of the water!"
 
"Where did it go!? Where did it go!? It just disappeared!"
 
"Keep it in your sights! Don't let it escape!"
 
"Face to face at last! Now I can finally kill you!!!"
 
"Hard to Port!!!!"

source_en:
The person who escapes from the lacquered black abyss need not deliver any warnings.
 
It seemed to mock us as it danced within the swirling whirlpool. The blue crystals on its back gleamed, barely a few centimeters above the dark, rushing waters. The harpoons we had sunk into its back were gone, but we did leave three glaring holes behind!
 
Every time we neared it, it swam faster into deeper waters. The deeper it sank into the whirlpool, the faster it swam, but for us, there was no turning back.
 
It vanished first, and when it reappeared beside our port, one mast was already submerged, and the other snapped off.  

Then came the tightening of the winch and the splintering of the keel.

After that, there was nothing but darkness. In that void, I couldn't see my ship, my crew, or it.
 
At first, my "leg" twitched uncontrollably... I thought I had died.
 
I lay on the beach, alone. There was no ship, no crew, and no sign of it.
 
I had none of its blood on my hands, no ship's wheel, no ropes, no harpoons. Nothing to grasp onto. 

But the sea breeze felt unfamiliar. I realized I'd never set foot on this beach before. Since we set sail from Cape Bedford, I remembered every passing port and beach, but this one... this one was unfamiliar.
 
It wasn't until a young man, dressed in foreign attire, kicked my boot to check if I was still alive that I realized I hadn't gone to hell, nor had I ascended to heaven.
 
"Ugh...Where am I?"

"Riccioli Island, Rinascita"

"Rinascita...."

"Did you suffer a shipwreck at sea?"

"My ship... My crew..."

"There's no one else nearby."

"If that's true... then in the end, I only am escaped alone..."

source_en:
...Later, I came to realize that we were "blessed."
 
The people of Rinascita said that whale guided ships and sailors who perished at sea to the afterlife, like a ferryman of the underworld. I heard that the merchants of the Forgotten Sea could weigh memories and souls on their scales, exchanging them for an equal weight of gold.
 
But for some reason, we're all still alive. Or rather, we exist in a state between life and death.
 
Yes, in time, I found Starbuck and Queequeg on this island. They're still alive. "It," the whale they call "Cetus the Tidebreaker," was also still alive.
 
How can this be a "blessing"? This is nothing but a "curse!" I cannot accept this!
 
Once I've had my vengeance, death may take me. But if my vengeance fails, I cannot bear to remain in this world as a mere plaything for those I sought vengeance against! My fate is mine to decide, and only true death can end my conquest.
 
They don't understand. That whale, though it appears tame and gentle, is cunning and violent. It transforms death into an unjust eternity, making my vengeance just a footnote in its mockery of the sea… No, I will never accept this. I will never compromise!

source_en:
All whales carry oil, and this oil can dissolve many things that water cannot. This is the conclusion we reached after crossing every sea.
 
It can dissolve things of every shape and nature into one, and there are even stories of people who fell into a whale's oil-filled brain and drowned, with no bones ever found. But I have never seen what oil this whale holds... Perhaps I never will.
 
More than twenty years have passed, and Pequod seems cursed. No matter what Queequeg tries, we cannot repair her. My crew, those "resurrected" sailors, have long since forgotten how to wield their harpoons. They no longer know how to fight the sea.
 
And it seems as though the whale is toying with me. Since that time, whether at sea or ashore, I have never laid eyes on it again. I do not wish to give up. I refuse to. As long as I can kill it, I will be freed from this curse-like "blessing" to find eternal rest.
 
But I... I am too old now. I can no longer lift a harpoon. I cannot fight that giant creature aboard one of these tiny "Gondolas."
 
Yes, my ideals, my beliefs, my fate, my vengeance—everything is gone. Everything has been swallowed by these foreign seas.
 
You are, of course, welcome to mock me. The rope of that harpoon, while I lived, bound me tightly to that whale. Even now, after death, I am still bound by it. In the past, I was unwilling to sever that rope. Now, I remain unwilling still...  But I can no longer drag it into the black depths of the sea.
 
Sometime later, a young man came to find me. He said his name was Ishmael, a sailor's apprentice, and he wanted to learn how to fish.
 
At that moment, I recalled that before Pequod's final voyage, there was a sailor named Ishmael at the Bedford dock. But he did not board my ship. He stayed at the port, and if he is still alive at sea, he would likely be as old as I am now. How ironic...

source_en:
If it weren't for you and that young girl finding it, if it weren't for the captain of that troupe agreeing to my request, we still wouldn't know when we could truly rest in peace.
 
For people like us, the end of the world is the end of the sea.
 
I was born by the sea, died on the sea, and finally will be buried under the sea.
 
This time, I could not kill it. But next time I will certainly kill it... certainly.

...Thank you, Captain from a distant land.

It can't keep us trapped here forever.
 
We have to wait till Pequod is repaired, then we can leave... never to return.

source_en: Dearest Father, I am writing this letter to you from a corner of the library. Over time, I have slowly adjusted to life at the seminary. During my free time, I often come to this library to read the ancient texts it holds and study the doctrine of Unity. But the deeper I delve into the history of Rinascita, the more I sense that it is shrouded by an unresolved mist. There are too many unanswered questions about our faith, the grace we have received, and the disaster that once befell us. Fortunately, many publicly sensitive topics and even discussions of taboos are regarded as subjects of academic interest in the seminary. I will take time to study and explore them. Of course, I haven't neglected the swordsmanship Mother taught me. Recently, I applied for sparring practice with the Divine Envoys... Don't worry, I won't hurt myself. I remember you once told me that Avinoleum is so vast you'll always get lost. This year, I've walked everywhere in the seminary, except for those places where I'm not allowed to go. I've drawn a simple route map, which is easier to read than the one in the Order. I'll send it to you later. With my sword and lantern, I press on through the fog. My Lord Imperator from above, Rosalie

Trust thy neighbor, else land will stay fallow. Unite the isles, else levees will stay unbuilt.

Brothers and sisters, let the sky, the land, and the seas be united.

The path to righteousness is lit by the sacred fire of <color=#ffd12f>Unity</color>.

source_en:
We have conquered the land and built an impenetrable fortress upon the mountain’s crown.
From the very beginning, the Echoes stood with us—loyal, unyielding, and true.
O Brave people of Rinascita, future warriors. Let this monument bear witness to your courage.
<color=#ffd12f>In the beginning is the lion, peerless in might.</color>
<color=#ffd12f>In the end is the knight, faithful to the last breath.</color>
What we leave behind will one day rise again through you.

"Even in the end… I never found the so-called power of the dragon.
As the knight who served the 17th head of the family, I failed to protect the one I swore to. I failed to fulfill her wish, to redeem her family's name.
I achieved nothing. Died in a foreign land... Ha, what a pitiful, wasted life."

source_en:
Through the initial selection, you must forge ahead. Compete, strive, and fight for your place. Show your strength, wisdom, courage, and perseverance as you journey through the depths to become the Fisalia Maiden.

The Head of the Fisalia family will offer the chosen one an elixir capable of granting any wish—be it eternal beauty or miraculous healing. All desires can be fulfilled.

Candidates:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia, Hebenon Fisalia, Cantarella Fisalia...</color>

Chloe Fisalia, Annis Fisalia, Marina Fisalia...

First Trial:
Poison is the bedrock on which the Fisalia name stands.
Let it test your willpower.
In this trial, you must select <color=RedD>the three most toxic Sea Apples</color> from the depths and bring them back by any means necessary.
Remember: The use of any external tools to determine their toxicity or aid in retrieval is strictly forbidden.

May the power of the Fisalia bloodline awaken within you.

source_en:
Dear Annis,

The Trials are tomorrow! I'm so nervous… but a tiny bit excited too.

The Fisalias are really, really scary… Some of them strut around all high and mighty, while others are just… unsettling, like something out of a bad dream.

They must be really good at handling poisons, right? Just the thought of facing them makes me uneasy.…

I overheard that unsettling Fisalia girl whispering that poison can be medicine too. She said with just the right amount, it won't hurt anyone but actually save them.

Perhaps even if I don't pass the Trials, I could pick up some of their secrets about poisons and figure out the ingredients. Then maybe, just maybe, I could make something to help Jojo.

Thinking about it that way makes things a little less scary. For Jojo's sake, what's a little poison, anyway!

Be careful tomorrow, my dear Annis. We don't have Fisalia blood, and they know a lot more about poisons than we do.

Yours,
Chloe
new_translation_vi:
Gửi Annis thân mến,

Ngày mai là đến kỳ thi rồi! Tớ lo quá… nhưng cũng thấy hơi phấn khích nữa.

Lũ Fisalia thực sự, thực sự rất đáng sợ… Một vài đứa trong số chúng cứ đi lại với vẻ cao ngạo, trong khi những đứa khác thì… thật khó chịu, cứ như bước ra từ một cơn ác mộng vậy.

Chắc chắn chúng rất giỏi dùng độc, đúng không? Chỉ nghĩ đến việc phải đối mặt với chúng thôi đã khiến tớ thấy bất an rồi…

Tớ tình cờ nghe được cô nàng Fisalia khó hiểu đó thì thầm rằng poison cũng có thể là thuốc. Cô ấy nói nếu dùng đúng liều lượng, nó sẽ không làm hại ai mà thực ra còn cứu được họ nữa.

Có lẽ ngay cả khi không vượt qua kỳ thi, tớ cũng có thể học lỏm vài bí mật về độc dược của chúng và tìm ra các thành phần. Rồi biết đâu, chỉ là biết đâu thôi, tớ có thể chế ra thứ gì đó để giúp Jojo.

Nghĩ theo cách đó thì mọi thứ bớt đáng sợ hơn một chút. Dù sao thì vì Jojo, chút poison này có là gì đâu!

Ngày mai hãy cẩn thận nhé, Annis thân yêu. Chúng ta không có dòng máu Fisalia, và chúng biết về độc dược nhiều hơn chúng ta rất nhiều.

Thân mến,
Chloe

source_en:
Dear Annis,

Today I tried four different poisons…

The first one gave me a pounding headache, the second made my stomach cramp up, the third left my bones feeling all achy, and the fourth made me so dizzy I started seeing little dancing figures everywhere!

I'm still feeling a bit wobbly, and the words on this note are jumping around as I try to write.

But that unsettling Fisalia girl gave me some medicine. After I drank it, I felt a little better, just enough to write to you.

You might wonder why I'd ever drink something from a Fisalia, but don't worry. I've been keeping an eye on her. She's… different from the others. They don't seem to like her much, and she's always by herself, mumbling and grinding herbs. What she said last time wasn't a lie, and she didn't hurt me. 

Maybe… not all Fisalias are bad.

I'm thinking about asking her for help. She knows so much about medicine, and since she doesn't fit in with the rest, maybe she'd teach me how to mix the right potion to help Jojo. I know it's risky, but if there's even a small chance, I have to try.

Oh, and one last thing—security is tighter now, so be very careful, okay? If you hear three quick knocks, that'll be me.

Yours,
Chloe
new_translation_vi:
Gửi Annis thân mến,

Hôm nay tớ đã thử bốn loại độc khác nhau…

Loại đầu tiên làm tớ đau đầu như búa bổ, loại thứ hai khiến bụng tớ quặn thắt, loại thứ ba làm xương cốt tớ đau nhức, còn loại thứ tư khiến tớ chóng mặt đến mức bắt đầu nhìn thấy những hình nhân nhảy múa khắp nơi!

Giờ tớ vẫn còn thấy hơi choáng váng, và những dòng chữ trên mảnh giấy này cứ nhảy múa khi tớ cố viết.

Nhưng cô nàng Fisalia khó hiểu đó đã đưa cho tớ ít thuốc. Sau khi uống, tớ thấy khá hơn một chút, đủ để viết thư cho cậu.

Cậu có thể tự hỏi tại sao tớ lại uống thứ gì đó từ một Fisalia, nhưng đừng lo. Tớ vẫn luôn để mắt đến cô ấy. Cô ấy… khác với những kẻ còn lại. Chúng có vẻ không thích cô ấy lắm, và cô ấy luôn ở một mình, lẩm bẩm và nghiền thảo dược. Những gì cô ấy nói lần trước không phải là lời nói dối, và cô ấy cũng không làm hại tớ.

Có lẽ… không phải tất cả Fisalia đều xấu xa.

Tớ đang nghĩ đến việc nhờ cô ấy giúp đỡ. Cô ấy biết rất nhiều về y dược, và vì cô ấy không hòa nhập được với những kẻ còn lại, biết đâu cô ấy sẽ dạy tớ cách pha chế loại thuốc đúng để giúp Jojo. Tớ biết điều này rất mạo hiểm, nhưng nếu còn dù chỉ một tia hy vọng, tớ phải thử.

À, còn một điều cuối cùng—an ninh giờ nghiêm ngặt hơn rồi, nên hãy thật cẩn thận nhé, được không? Nếu cậu nghe thấy ba tiếng gõ nhanh, đó chính là tớ.

Thân mến,
Chloe

source_en:
Dear ████,

The Sea Apples were extremely potent. Even smelling them was enough to make it impossible to breathe, like my throat was being squeezed. I could barely get a word out. When I finally came to, I tasted something metallic in my mouth.

I didn't have the strength to touch one, let alone bring one back. All I could do was watch helplessly from afar.

They were round and red, like apples… or maybe tomatoes. Back in Egla Town, we had fields full of tomatoes…

Is it because I'm not a true Fisalia that I can't awaken any special abilities or immunity to poisons?

No, I can't give up. It must be because I'm not trying hard enough.

Annis wasn't a Fisalia either, but she made it through, even though we'll never hear her voice again. The poison destroyed her vocal cords, and she'll never speak again... 

Now's not the time for tears. I have to be strong too. For Jojo's sake, I won't give up.

Chloe
new_translation_vi:
Gửi ████,

Sea Apple cực kỳ mạnh. Chỉ cần ngửi thôi cũng đủ khiến tớ không thể thở nổi, như thể cổ họng đang bị bóp nghẹt vậy. Tớ gần như không thể thốt nên lời. Khi cuối cùng cũng tỉnh lại, tớ thấy trong miệng có vị kim loại.

Tớ không đủ sức để chạm vào một quả, chứ đừng nói đến việc mang một quả về. Tất cả những gì tớ có thể làm là bất lực đứng nhìn từ xa.

Chúng tròn và đỏ, giống như táo… hoặc có lẽ là cà chua. Hồi còn ở thị trấn Egla, chúng ta từng có những cánh đồng đầy cà chua…

Có phải vì tớ không phải là một Fisalia thực thụ nên tớ không thể đánh thức bất kỳ khả năng đặc biệt hay khả năng miễn nhiễm với độc tố nào không?

Không, tớ không thể bỏ cuộc. Chắc chắn là do tớ chưa đủ cố gắng.

Annis cũng không phải là một Fisalia, nhưng cô ấy đã vượt qua, dù chúng ta sẽ không bao giờ được nghe giọng cô ấy nữa. poison đã phá hủy dây thanh quản của cô ấy, và cô ấy sẽ không bao giờ nói được nữa...

Giờ không phải lúc để rơi lệ. Tớ cũng phải mạnh mẽ lên. Vì Jojo, tớ sẽ không bỏ cuộc.

Chloe

source_en:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia, Hebenon Fisalia, Cantarella Fisalia...

Annis Fisalia…</color>

The above candidates have passed the trial of poison.
Please take a moment to rest and prepare for the second trial.
new_translation_vi:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia, Hebenon Fisalia, Cantarella Fisalia...

Annis Fisalia…</color>

Các ứng viên trên đã vượt qua thử thách của poison.
Vui lòng dành chút thời gian nghỉ ngơi và chuẩn bị cho thử thách thứ hai.

source_en:
Knight Princess, Sorceress Princess, Commoner Princess, Noble Princess, and Angel Princess assembled before the castle!

Knight Princess atop her noble mount took the lead through the castle hedge maze and opened the castle gates.

Commoner Princess consumed poisonous mushrooms which she mistook as edible. Sorceress Princess rendered aid by brewing a curative potion.

Noble Princess, who knew the castle well, elegantly circumvented all of the hidden traps.

Angel Princess followed everyone with a faint smile on her lips.

The Princesses gathered in the castle's main hall where the Queen proclaimed their first task was to find the Gold Apple in the Appletree Forest!

Appletree Forest on the castle grounds, grows apples red and round.
A few land making a thump, knocking heads and raising bumps. 
Apples fall into the earth's hold, most are red but some are gold.
Whose head will the gold apple hit? Who will leave the forest with it?
The Queen sits with her meal in place, waiting for fruit to take its place.
As the juicy bite goes down, behold on her head the Thorned Crown.

In the end, everyone will surely find their own Gold Apple that makes their dreams come true!
new_translation_vi:
Công chúa Hiệp sĩ, Công chúa Phù thủy, Công chúa Thường dân, Công chúa Quý tộc và Công chúa Thiên thần tập hợp trước lâu đài!

Công chúa Hiệp sĩ trên lưng chiến mã cao quý dẫn đầu đi qua mê cung hàng rào và mở cổng lâu đài.

Công chúa Thường dân ăn phải nấm độc vì nhầm tưởng là nấm ăn được. Công chúa Phù thủy đã ra tay giúp đỡ bằng cách pha chế thuốc giải.

Công chúa Quý tộc, người hiểu rõ lâu đài, đã khéo léo tránh được tất cả những cái bẫy ẩn giấu.

Công chúa Thiên thần theo sau mọi người với nụ cười mỉm trên môi.

Các nàng công chúa tập trung tại đại sảnh lâu đài, nơi Nữ hoàng tuyên bố nhiệm vụ đầu tiên của họ là tìm Quả Táo Vàng trong Rừng Táo!

Rừng Táo trong khuôn viên lâu đài, những quả táo đỏ và tròn.
Một vài quả rơi xuống tạo tiếng thình thịch, gõ vào đầu và tạo nên những vết sưng.
Táo rơi vào lòng đất, hầu hết là màu đỏ nhưng một vài quả lại là màu vàng.
Đầu ai sẽ bị quả táo vàng rơi trúng? Ai sẽ leave khu rừng với nó?
Nữ hoàng ngồi cùng bữa ăn của mình, chờ đợi trái cây thay thế vị trí đó.
Khi miếng cắn mọng nước trôi xuống, hãy nhìn xem chiếc Vương miện Gai trên đầu bà.

Cuối cùng, chắc chắn ai cũng sẽ tìm thấy Quả Táo Vàng của riêng mình để biến ước mơ thành hiện thực!

source_en:
Knight Princess: After the Throned Crown is mine, everyone in the castle will live better lives!

Sorceress Princess: Uh-huh... I don't want anything, I'm only here out of obligation to the family. After this is over, I plan to leave this dull place and get some fresh air outside. This time of year, the flowers in the mountains and fields should be blooming quite nicely... maybe I can find a new variety suitable for making medicine.

Noble Princess: I... I'm a bit scared, and I don't want to continue. But... but...

Knight Princess: You can't back out!

Commoner Princess: To cure Jojo, I won't back out. I will get the cure-all elixir and return home happily.

Angel Princess: Everyone's wishes shall come true.
new_translation_vi:
Công chúa Hiệp sĩ: Sau khi Vương miện Gai thuộc về ta, mọi người trong lâu đài sẽ có cuộc sống tốt đẹp hơn!

Công chúa Phù thủy: Ừm... ta không muốn gì cả, ta ở đây chỉ vì nghĩa vụ với gia đình thôi. Sau khi chuyện này kết thúc, ta dự định sẽ leave nơi tẻ nhạt này và ra ngoài hít thở không khí trong lành. Vào thời điểm này trong năm, hoa trên núi và ngoài đồng chắc đang nở rộ rất đẹp... biết đâu ta có thể tìm thấy một loại mới phù hợp để làm thuốc.

Công chúa Quý tộc: Ta... ta hơi sợ, và ta không muốn tiếp tục nữa. Nhưng... nhưng...

Công chúa Hiệp sĩ: Ngươi không được rút lui!

Công chúa Thường dân: Để chữa bệnh cho Jojo, ta sẽ không rút lui. Ta sẽ lấy được thuốc tiên chữa bách bệnh và trở về nhà trong hạnh phúc.

Công chúa Thiên thần: Ước nguyện của mọi người sẽ thành hiện thực.

source_en:
Second Trial:

To claim the title of Maiden, one must demonstrate the strength to make decisive choices.

Excessive emotions are vulnerabilities and burdens for any candidate worthy of the title.

Each participant is required to capture <color=RedD>the most venomous jellyfish</color> from the sea and return it to this location. Upon your return, you will team up with another candidate and exchange your catch. The candidate with the more potent jellyfish shall be declared the winner.

In the event that you encounter an accident along the way, the other paired candidate will be declared the winner by default.

Use your awakened abilities to endure the depths of the sea until the end.

Trust only yourself, and remember that the title of Maiden is worthy of your pursuit.

Team Assignments:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia and Hebenon Fisalia.
Cantarella Fisalia and Annis Fisalia.
...</color>
new_translation_vi:
Thử thách thứ hai:

Để giành được danh hiệu Thiếu nữ, người ta phải thể hiện sức mạnh để đưa ra những lựa chọn quyết đoán.

Cảm xúc thái quá là điểm yếu và gánh nặng cho bất kỳ ứng viên nào xứng đáng với danh hiệu này.

Mỗi người tham gia được yêu cầu bắt <color=RedD>loài sứa độc nhất</color> từ dưới biển và mang trở lại địa điểm này. Khi trở về, bạn sẽ lập đội với một ứng viên khác và trao đổi chiến lợi phẩm. Ứng viên nào có con sứa độc hơn sẽ được tuyên bố là người chiến thắng.

Trong trường hợp bạn gặp tai nạn trên đường đi, ứng viên còn lại trong cặp sẽ mặc định được tuyên bố là người chiến thắng.

Sử dụng khả năng đã đánh thức của bạn để chịu đựng dưới đáy biển cho đến cuối cùng.

Chỉ tin tưởng bản thân mình, và hãy nhớ rằng danh hiệu Thiếu nữ xứng đáng với sự theo đuổi của bạn.

Phân công đội:
<color=PurpleD>Mandragora Fisalia và Hebenon Fisalia.
Cantarella Fisalia và Annis Fisalia.
...</color>

source_en:
Dear Mandragora,

My dearest sister, I cannot fathom anything more heart-wrenching than facing you in this trial, given all the years we have spent growing up together.

As the Fisalia eldest daughter, you were always sheltered, yet you took it upon yourself to welcome me into this world with such tenderness. I still recall the way you would sew my clothes, even adding that little pink bunny design. It was so soft and fluffy, far more lovely than any strange creature from the deep.

If the Fisalias can have only one Maiden, I wish it to be you.

To show my sincerity, I'll share my newly awakened ability with you. My tears are lethal. They paralyze people upon contact and then clot their blood.

I swear by the name of Fisalia that this is true.

Please think of a way to counter my power. When the time comes, I hope you can free me from this fate.

Yours,
Hebenon
new_translation_vi:
Gửi Mandragora,

Chị gái yêu quý của em, em không thể tưởng tượng được điều gì đau lòng hơn việc phải đối đầu với chị trong thử thách này, sau tất cả những năm tháng chúng ta lớn lên cùng nhau.

Là con gái cả của Fisalia, chị luôn được che chở, nhưng chị đã tự mình chào đón em đến với thế giới này bằng sự dịu dàng như vậy. Em vẫn nhớ cách chị khâu quần áo cho em, thậm chí còn thêm cả hình chú thỏ hồng nhỏ xíu đó. Nó thật mềm mại và bông xốp, đáng yêu hơn bất kỳ sinh vật kỳ lạ nào từ dưới sâu.

Nếu Fisalia chỉ có thể có một Thiếu nữ, em ước đó là chị.

Để thể hiện sự chân thành, em sẽ chia sẻ khả năng mới đánh thức của mình với chị. Nước mắt của em có độc. Chúng sẽ paralyze người khi tiếp xúc và làm đông máu họ.

Em thề dưới danh nghĩa của Fisalia rằng điều này là sự thật.

Xin hãy nghĩ cách để chống lại sức mạnh của em. Khi thời khắc đó đến, em hy vọng chị có thể giải thoát em khỏi định mệnh này.

Thân mến,
Hebenon

source_en:
Dear Hebenon,

The head of our family has always taught us that to be born into the Fisalias is to embrace coldness, decisiveness, and ruthlessness. 

For the "greater good" our family upholds, personal sacrifice holds little weight. As the eldest daughter, it is my duty to uphold these teachings. While our ways may seem harsh, they are accompanied by the weight of expectations and the honor of our name. I have resolved to relinquish all personal desires, allowing the family's code to seep into my very soul.

Our impending duel will undoubtedly bring pain, yet we have both come this far. I trust we will become exactly what the head envisions for us. You, too, are a daughter of the senior line, and I implore you not to follow in our cousin's footsteps, who defies the head's will.

Gather your strength and determination, so that when we face each other in the trial, we shall do so as equals.

Should I become the Maiden, I will honor your sacrifices. And if you are chosen, I hope you will do the same.

Yours,
Mandragora
new_translation_vi:
Gửi Hebenon,

Người đứng đầu gia tộc luôn dạy chúng ta rằng sinh ra trong Fisalia là phải đón nhận sự lạnh lùng, quyết đoán và tàn nhẫn.

Vì "lợi ích lớn hơn" mà gia tộc duy trì, sự hy sinh cá nhân chẳng có nghĩa lý gì. Là con gái cả, bổn phận của chị là phải tuân theo những lời dạy đó. Dù cách của chúng ta có vẻ khắc nghiệt, nhưng chúng đi kèm với sức nặng của những kỳ vọng và danh dự của dòng họ. Chị đã quyết tâm từ bỏ mọi ham muốn cá nhân, để quy tắc của gia tộc thấm sâu vào tận linh hồn mình.

Cuộc đấu sắp tới chắc chắn sẽ mang lại đau thương, nhưng cả hai chúng ta đều đã đi đến tận đây. Chị tin rằng chúng ta sẽ trở thành chính xác những gì người đứng đầu mong đợi ở chúng ta. Em cũng là con gái của dòng chính, và chị khẩn cầu em đừng đi theo vết xe đổ của người anh họ, kẻ đã dám chống lại ý chí của người đứng đầu.

Hãy tập hợp sức mạnh và quyết tâm của em, để khi chúng ta đối mặt với nhau trong thử thách, chúng ta sẽ làm điều đó như những người ngang hàng.

Nếu chị trở thành Thiếu nữ, chị sẽ tôn vinh sự hy sinh của em. Và nếu em được chọn, chị hy vọng em cũng sẽ làm như vậy.

Thân mến,
Mandragora

source_en:
<color=PurpleD>Cantarella Fisalia and Annis Fisalia</color> have passed the Second Trial.

The loss of two beloved family members weighs heavily on us all. However, as Fisalias, it is our duty and privilege to continue with the Trials.

For the rise of the Maiden, we stand unwavering, prepared to bear any cost.
new_translation_vi:
<color=PurpleD>Cantarella Fisalia và Annis Fisalia</color> đã vượt qua Thử thách thứ hai.

Sự mất mát của hai thành viên gia đình yêu quý đè nặng lên tất cả chúng ta. Tuy nhiên, với tư cách là người Fisalia, bổn phận và đặc quyền của chúng ta là tiếp tục các Thử thách.

Vì sự trỗi dậy của Thiếu nữ, chúng ta đứng vững vàng, sẵn sàng trả bất cứ giá nào.

source_en:
Twelve jellyfish drift in the sea,
Floating silently as can be.
Two swim slow, their pace a crawl.
Sucked into a whirlpool, they fall.

Ten jellyfish drift in the sea,
Apple-choked they can't breathe,
Two then die, the rest are free.

Lost on the cliffs, falling into the deep sea.

Nội dung:
Lạc trên vách đá, rơi xuống biển sâu.

Nếu trên thế giới này có thần linh, xin hãy lắng nghe những lời cầu nguyện chân thành của chúng tôi:

"Hãy để những hồn ma chìm dưới đáy sâu trở về thế giới phàm trần. Không chỉ vào Đêm Tưởng Niệm, mà hãy để chúng tôi trở về quê hương Egla vĩnh viễn."

source_en:
Hahaha! Bravo! Let us sing another to this occasion! With Ragunna City behind us, at long last we've arrived where the knights once set camp.

Oh, those marvelous knights living the way of Korlacchi—!

We build bonfires at night and admire the windmills during the day. We play music and sing together under their turning sails. The townsfolk call us "bonfire bards."

When the windmills come to rest, we'd go chasing along the rivers and lakes. But above all these, there's nothing like flying across the field on a clear day.

From the air, I glance down at this land wrinkled by time. Sunlight blankets over the pillars of the knight's collapsed ruins, where a thousand-year-old tree stands in its silent vigil, with its roots sprawling across the stone crevices. As the wind carries me across the lake's surface, the reflections of the red roof tiles of the Egla Town gleam and dance like pomegranate seeds scattered on top of a sheet of blue silk. The red-topped windmill overlooks the town, slowly turning and beckoning homebound travelers.
new_translation_vi:

Ồ, những hiệp sĩ tuyệt vời sống theo cách của Korlacchi—!

Chúng ta đốt lửa trại vào ban đêm và chiêm ngưỡng những chiếc cối xay gió vào ban ngày. Chúng ta chơi nhạc và hát cùng nhau dưới những cánh buồm đang quay của chúng. Người dân thị trấn gọi chúng ta là "những người hát rong bên đống lửa."

Khi những chiếc cối xay gió dừng lại, chúng ta sẽ đuổi theo dọc các con sông và hồ. Nhưng trên tất cả, không gì bằng việc bay lượn khắp cánh đồng vào một ngày quang đãng.

Từ trên không, tớ nhìn xuống vùng đất này bị thời gian làm cho nhăn nheo. Ánh nắng bao phủ những cột trụ của tàn tích hiệp sĩ đã sụp đổ, nơi một cái cây nghìn năm tuổi đứng canh gác trong im lặng, với bộ rễ lan rộng khắp các kẽ đá. Khi gió đưa tớ lướt qua mặt hồ, hình ảnh phản chiếu của những mái ngói đỏ của thị trấn Egla lấp lánh và nhảy múa như những hạt lựu rải trên tấm lụa xanh. Chiếc cối xay gió mái đỏ nhìn xuống thị trấn, chậm rãi quay và vẫy gọi những lữ khách trở về nhà.

source_en:
As twilight gilds my cheeks in amber,
Shadows of trees bow down to kiss the bottomless lake.
As birds sweep past these ancient walls,
In the folds of clouds I hide my unfinished poems away.

By the time this letter reaches you, we have already parted ways.
You have embarked on a new journey, and I will be playing a new tune somewhere away from the city, per.

A tale of a girl and a Laureate treading the sea together. The girl imagined herself to be a bird called "Icarus," and with her talents she revealed unspoken wishes of abandoned instruments along the way. They offered aid to children of the Choir, unveiling the true essence of poetry. Yet the joyous girl carried secrets of her own, for she hoped to share her voice, so singers would no longer need to hide behind lies and their creativity would flow freely. In the final moment when she had to make a choice, her childhood memories as a girl who sang without worry and encouragement from the Laureate helped her defeat her doubts.

The caged bird took a fateful plunge out of the cage, but this time, she was caught and raised up by a pair of caring hands.

Just as Mister Faroll once said, "Words and music are a form of miracle capable of transcending the boundaries of time and personal experience." I understood at an early age the meanings their poems conveyed.

And now. Thank you, {PlayerName}, for understanding their messages too.

As the mist of time slowly dissipates in a sigh,
Only traces of remembrance continues to strum these strings.
Should fate's variation sounds, petals of parting may scatter.
As for us...

I think it's better to not express farewell through poetry, as I wish to tell you: We will meet again, sometime in the future!

Đúng như ông Faroll từng nói, "Lời nói và âm nhạc là một dạng phép màu có khả năng vượt qua ranh giới của thời gian và trải nghiệm cá nhân." Tớ đã hiểu từ khi còn nhỏ ý nghĩa mà những bài thơ của họ truyền tải.

source_en:
Do not bring flowers to my grave, for I am not there, bound under this tombstone.
I am in the sea winds at Ragunna's walls. I am dawning lights that break through thorns.
I am a night hawk of wings aflame, soaring towards the Celestial Steed, whose praises I sing and whose true form I behold.
The night sky will be illuminated by wings aflame, and I shall be reborn in immortal poetry.
So long as people draw breath, lift your eyes and see: so long as this poem lives, it breathes life into me.
<alignright/>——End

Looking back at what I wrote in the preface:
This anthology is attributed to the Golden Anthem. We wish these poems might offer a glimmer of hope to those lost in fate's journey, and to readers something to contemplate.
Gather these scattered golden syllables, as they are treasures tempered by fire, and lingering sparks of human thought.
And finally, thank you for opening this book.

Tớ là chim ưng đêm với đôi cánh rực lửa, bay về phía Chiến mã Thiên đường, người mà tớ ca ngợi và chiêm ngưỡng hình hài thực sự.

Chừng nào con người còn hít thở, hãy ngước mắt lên và nhìn: chừng nào bài thơ này còn sống, nó còn thổi hồn vào tớ.
<alignright/>——Hết

Nhìn lại những gì tớ đã viết trong lời tựa:
Tuyển tập này được cho là của Golden Anthem. Tớ hy vọng những bài thơ này có thể mang lại một tia hy vọng cho những ai lạc lối trong hành trình định mệnh, và cho độc giả điều gì đó để suy ngẫm.
Hãy thu thập những âm tiết vàng rải rác này, vì chúng là những kho báu được tôi luyện bởi lửa, và là những tia lửa còn sót lại của tư duy con người.

source_en:
Literary works draw their vitality from two sources: The creator and the readers.

The creator gives it new life, while the readers help extend it through reading. Each time they share a piece of work or publish their thoughts and reviews, they breathe new life into it.

Some may find the term "life of a work" elusive, as it's too abstract and intangible.

However, a parallel can be easily drawn from human life. When discussing the concept of life, one essential topic is inevitably brought up—name. A name is a symbol of existence, one of the most important markers that separate individual lives. If one desires to feel the vitality of a work, the most direct approach would be to feel its name, the various names bestowed by creators and readers.

I once heard an eerie tale from a land in the east that spoke of a lady with skin as fair as snow who would stand in a snowstorm, cradling a wailing baby in her arms, begging the passersby to hold the baby for her. If some kindhearted individual agrees to that request, they'd soon find themselves unable to let go, bound to freeze to death.

Intriguing, isn't it? But, by this point, it's a fascinating tale that evokes many distinct images that cannot yet form the entirety of "life." 

But what if we give it a name? Like... "The Snow Woman." This name alone captures the entire narrative and defines its essence.

However, even with the name anchoring people's imaginations, the unusual nature of words means each person takes a narrative differently.

Hence... The life of a creative work is less controllable than human life.

So, if one day, people's understanding of a work is led astray, then words could turn into a devastating weapon.

What would we do then? Show anger? No, absolutely not! Anger is the cheapest outlet of dissent. As creators, all we can do is believe. Believe that our words can live in their most genuine form.
<alignright/>—Exclusive interview with the Golden Anthem
new_translation_vi:
Các tác phẩm văn học lấy sức sống từ hai nguồn: Người sáng tạo và độc giả.

Người sáng tạo mang lại cho nó cuộc sống mới, trong khi độc giả giúp kéo dài nó thông qua việc đọc. Mỗi khi họ chia sẻ một tác phẩm hoặc công bố suy nghĩ và đánh giá của mình, họ thổi luồng sinh khí mới vào đó.

Một số người có thể thấy thuật ngữ "cuộc đời của một tác phẩm" thật khó nắm bắt, vì nó quá trừu tượng và vô hình.

Tuy nhiên, một sự tương đồng có thể dễ dàng được rút ra từ cuộc sống con người. Khi thảo luận về khái niệm cuộc sống, một chủ đề thiết yếu chắc chắn được đưa ra—tên gọi. Một cái tên là biểu tượng của sự tồn tại, một trong những dấu hiệu quan trọng nhất phân biệt các cuộc đời cá nhân. Nếu ai đó muốn cảm nhận sức sống của một tác phẩm, cách trực tiếp nhất là cảm nhận tên gọi của nó, những cái tên khác nhau được ban tặng bởi người sáng tạo và độc giả.

Tớ từng nghe một câu chuyện kỳ lạ từ một vùng đất ở phía đông kể về một người phụ nữ có làn da trắng như tuyết, đứng trong cơn bão tuyết, ôm một đứa bé đang khóc nức nở trên tay, cầu xin những người qua đường bế đứa bé giúp cô. Nếu một người tốt bụng đồng ý với yêu cầu đó, họ sẽ sớm thấy mình không thể buông tay, bị trói buộc với freeze cho đến chết.

Thú vị phải không? Nhưng, đến thời điểm này, đó là một câu chuyện hấp dẫn gợi lên nhiều hình ảnh riêng biệt chưa thể tạo thành toàn bộ "cuộc sống".

Nhưng nếu chúng ta đặt cho nó một cái tên thì sao? Như... "Người Tuyết". Cái tên này thôi đã nắm bắt toàn bộ câu chuyện và xác định bản chất của nó.

Tuy nhiên, ngay cả với cái tên neo giữ trí tưởng tượng của mọi người, bản chất khác thường của ngôn từ có nghĩa là mỗi người tiếp nhận một câu chuyện theo cách khác nhau.

Vì vậy... Cuộc đời của một tác phẩm sáng tạo khó kiểm soát hơn cuộc đời con người.

Vì vậy, nếu một ngày nào đó, sự hiểu biết của mọi người về một tác phẩm bị dẫn dắt sai lệch, thì ngôn từ có thể biến thành một vũ khí tàn khốc.

Vậy chúng ta sẽ làm gì? Thể hiện sự tức giận? Không, tuyệt đối không! Tức giận là cách rẻ tiền nhất để thể hiện sự bất đồng. Với tư cách là người sáng tạo, tất cả những gì chúng ta có thể làm là tin tưởng. Tin rằng ngôn từ của chúng ta có thể sống dưới hình thức chân thực nhất.
<alignright/>—Phỏng vấn độc quyền với Golden Anthem

ai_reason: Meaning preserved but some poetic phrasing feels unnatural in Vietnamese; requires manual polish for rhythm/flow.
source_en:
"...
Swept away by the storm are the cicadas of the Water Kingdom,
Wheat straws lay adrift in the village's oaken wine mugs.
Prolonged nights of Summer,
Lost souls, wander between streets and alleys.

Withered leaves fall into autumn's abyssal tranquility,
Rust of decay form on utensils of holy communion.
Desolate winds of Autumn,
Acolytes measure the inclination of Divinity with rotten scales.

Frost cover pupils of stained glass,
The confessional fills with silent ash.
Sleepless night of Winter,
A wandering bard holds a frozen lute,
Playing sounds that never reach.

With our bodies to fuel the fire, the ensuing inferno shall forge Ragunna's true gold.
Like the fire that dragged them to hell, these Daemons will spread throughout the land and burn all of Ragunna.
Let this sail take us past the towers, past the surrounding walls, and past the Sentinel's sculptures, as we descend silently into hell.
Till this song drowns into the brilliance of the sunset.
..."
